posts.title: Post Draft Rankings
blocks: These are all so subjective and they may be slightly off due to the fact that the season has not even started. But in the one in a million chance that I fucking nail these and I have the final standings dead on accurate, SUCK it. Now please enjoy as I take you on this season long rollercoaster of what goes on in my sick and twisted head from week to week
12. Team Tsontakis (Ryan)

Is this a bad team? No. Is this a good team? Also no. I think it has a good core, however, I believe there are a few too many question marks and holes that need to be filled. Josh Allen is a stud; he is likely going to carry this team. Derrick Henry is a unit and will most likely carry this team as well, assuming he stays healthy. But your RB2 at James Cook worries me. The Bills don’t run a whole lot and they also run with numerous running backs so his touches may be limited. That being said, Mongomery and Zeke on the bench could easily fill this hole going forward if they are decent. The WRs are good. Kupp is arguably one of the best BUT he is coming off a torn ACL or something like that and he has just recently had another setback. Cooper is also solid but Bill Cosby’s apprentice, Deshawn Watson, has yet to prove he can return to his glory of 2018 so Cooper is a question mark in my eyes. Solid TE, nothing much to say there, he will be top 6 easily. Then for flex and bench, I like Pickens a lot but there is a lot of competition on the Steelers so idk if he can sustain a solid weekly role. If he can, you got a good one tho. The rest of the bench is decent. I don’t love them all, but I also don’t hate them. I think they can fill some holes when needed. My sleeper on your team is Tank Bigsby, I think he has a chance to be pretty solid going forward and maybe make his way into your starting lineup.
11. Team Rivera (Adrian):

This is a solid team and the more I look at it, the more I like it. But it is still kinda booty cheeks. T-Law is gonna be fine and put up 15-20 weekly, Hill is unguardable and could easily be a top 3 WR but the rest scare me. Jacobs had a huge year last year but I don’t think he can replicate it. Even though Jimmy G is sexy af and could have me calling him daddy in a heartbeat, he can’t throw the ball for shit, so this might help out Jacobs and for your sake, hopefully I eat my words (and Jimmy G’s dick). Etienne also has some injury history so I am slightly worried plus the addition of Bigsby makes me think he’ll lose out on goal line touches which could really hinder his score. Christian Watson in my opinion is a flat-out horrible choice. He only had a good year last year bc he had Aaron Rodgers throwing him dimes weekly. With Jordan Love at the helm, and possibly former Penn Stater (WE ARE) Sean Clifford, if Love blows, I don’t think he’s gonna have a great year. Hockenson is a great pick and I think he will be top 3. The thing that sets you ahead of Ryan is the depth at your bench and flex. JK Dobbins is a beast if healthy and that’s a huge if, seeing that he’s played like 4 full games in the last 2 seasons. Jahan Dotson is my sleeper of this team; I think he might take over in Washington as the WR1 or at least be able to consistently put up good enough numbers to potentially earn a starting role. The rest are mid and will likely be switched with waiver wire adds throughout the year.
10: Team (Gabe)

This is a solid team on paper, but they all have issues when it comes to the game. Herbert is due for a huge year, especially with a new rookie WR who is likely gonna pop off. This will likely be the best offense in the league. Joe Mixon is the definition of mid. He is okay and will get like 15 points every week, nothing flashy, nothing special but he’s good to have because he’s consistent. Stefon Diggs is a dawg and if Josh Allen and him pick up where they left off last year, you have a top 5 guy here. Even Keenan Allen is a great receiver who is gonna be top 10 if he’s healthy. However, this man sprained his ankle last year and missed 8 games. Brian Robinson legit got SHOT IN THE LEG and returned sooner than Allen. If he’s healthy, you have a lethal QB WR duo. Despite having Taylor Swift’s last name and an apostrophe in his first name, I don’t think D’Andre Swift is gonna do too hot. He’s a good player but the Eagles legit have like 8 running backs that they use so unless he scores every TD for them this year, I think he is gonna be super risky week to week. At TE you have Kyle Pitts who was supposed to be the next Jesus Christ at TE, he was supposed to be what Travis Kelce is now, seeing that he was the 5th overall pick in the NFL draft like 3 years ago. But he has shit the bed every year and been awful. Idk if it’s bad QB play or that he is garbage but maybe this is his year. Doubt it, but maybe. You have some solid depth at flex/bench. If we are ranking teams based off of sex appeal you win, Jimmothy Garoppolo is a great addition to the team and honestly should give you a free 10 points every week. I love the Aiyuk pick, I was pissed you took him before me, and I think the rest of the bench has potential. Higbee will be good while Kupp is out, Tyler Allgeier has potential to still be solid if Bijan isn’t what we expect. My sleeper for your team is Jonathan Mingo. He’s a rookie in Carolina with a rookie QB, a lot of question marks about that team but if those two connect, it’s gonna be something special.
9: Team Poage (Matte)

I really like the WRs you have here, Ja’Marr Chase is K-Mart Justin Jefferson and Calvin Ridley put it on his daughter’s life that he was gonna have 1400 yards, so if he doesn’t, that’s gonna be a bad look when he has to sacrifice his daughter on an Instagram live. Is Mr. Discount double check Aaron Rodgers washed up? I don’t think so, this man went to the wilderness like he was Henry David Thoreau and spent a week or two there probably just getting unbelievably high and almost seeing God in the process though a plethora of drugs. That being said, I think he is gonna love having an actual WR1 for the first time in like 4 years. Dallas Goedert is a great pick at TE and the birds are notorious for using them well. He’s gonna consistently put up decent numbers…for a TE, so like 10pts a game. The RBs terrify me tho, Sir Walker the third is coming back from a busted ACL and who knows how he’ll be. Last year he was a monster but idk if he can continue on that trend while rehabbing. Dalvin Cook is actually washed unlike Rodgers. Cook is decent for the first like 4 weeks while Hall rehabs his busted ACL too but once he’s 100%, I think Cooks is cooked. He isn’t gonna do shit, BUT, hopefully everyone’s favorite woman beater Alvin Kamara is back by then and you’re set. Once he comes back, I think your team leapfrogs over a few teams on this list. The flex/bench is good, Deebo is slowing down significantly and since adding McCaffery to the 49ers, there are too many mouths to feed and I don’t love him. Slant boy MT and OBJ are both shells of what they once were but maybe they come back and both turn out decent. Idk might happen but the chance is like 6.9%. If I had to pick a sleeper it’d be Pittman Jr. or Campbell. They are okay but it all depends on if Richardson can actually throw the ball downfield.
8: Saquon these nuts (Trevor)

Big surprise here, I have myself relatively low. Should I be lower but I don’t want to admit it……. let’s move on. Hurts is legit QB1 but that’s about all I got going. Tony Pollard is good but who knows how he’ll play without Zeke there. I’d assume he’d do better but that’s a big assumption. Herbert is RB1 for the bears, but it’s the Bears so I don’t have a lot of faith in him putting up a lot of points. I took a risk on JT coming back better than ever in week 5 but until then I’m gonna struggle. The WRs are both WR2 on their respective teams BUT there isn’t a large difference between them and WR1 so hopefully one of them if not both pop off this year. Again, took a chance on Travis Kelce. If he’s healthy, he is undoubtedly the best TE and will give me such an advantage, if he’s hurt, I have legit no one and I will be looking up tutorials on YouTube for how to tie a noose. My flex/bench is questionable all around. I like Drake London and he could easily take over as one of my main WRs, I picked up Elijah Mitchell for WHEN not if CMC gets hurt, and Zach Charbonnet for if Kenneth Walker gets hurt. I swear I want those starters to do well but just in case I have some insurance, no malice towards them. My Sleeper is either Jordan Addison or Nico Collins. Similar to Jonathan Mingo, Collins is with a rookie QB so that’s unknown but could work out and then Addison is on one of the most pass heavy offenses so he should see a good number of targets.
7: Team Bekah (Bekah)

​

Big surprise here, I have myself relatively low. Should I be lower but I don’t want to admit it……. let’s move on. Hurts is legit QB1 but that’s about all I got going. Tony Pollard is good but who knows how he’ll play without Zeke there. I’d assume he’d do better but that’s a big assumption. Herbert is RB1 for the bears, but it’s the Bears so I don’t have a lot of faith in him putting up a lot of points. I took a risk on JT coming back better than ever in week 5 but until then I’m gonna struggle. The WRs are both WR2 on their respective teams BUT there isn’t a large difference between them and WR1 so hopefully one of them if not both pop off this year. Again, took a chance on Travis Kelce. If he’s healthy, he is undoubtedly the best TE and will give me such an advantage, if he’s hurt, I have legit no one and I will be looking up tutorials on YouTube for how to tie a noose. My flex/bench is questionable all around. I like Drake London and he could easily take over as one of my main WRs, I picked up Elijah Mitchell for WHEN not if CMC gets hurt, and Zach Charbonnet for if Kenneth Walker gets hurt. I swear I want those starters to do well but just in case I have some insurance, no malice towards them. My Sleeper is either Jordan Addison or Nico Collins. Similar to Jonathan Mingo, Collins is with a rookie QB so that’s unknown but could work out and then Addison is on one of the most pass heavy offenses so he should see a good number of targets.
6: Team Herbert (Brin)

Great start with Joey B, sexy AND good at football? He is the true GOAT. RBs are really good, I love Saquon Barkley and I think he has the potential to finish as the overall best running back. Najee Harris is gonna have a huge workload but it may get cut into by their backup so that’s my only concern with him. Garrett Wilson is gonna fair well from Henry David Thoreau Rodgers being on his team. He was a top 15 guy last year with the MILF hunter Zack Wilson, I’m sure he’ll do even better this year. Evan Engram is a good TE but I do worry that Jacksonville has a lot of good players and he may get overshadowed. Regardless he is still a solid TE. Now for your flex/Bench/WR2. DJ Moore has yet to prove he is actually good so he is easily interchangeable with any of the bench WRs. That being said I really like Sutton and I think Zay Flowers has a potential to be the WR1 in Baltimore so he can actually be viable if they use him properly. He is my sleeper and I think he will find his way into your lineup on a weekly basis in a few weeks. Raheem Mostert is gonna do decent since he is currently the starting RB for Miami but their problem is they have like 3 or 4 RBs they use similar to the eagles so the RB for Miami is not always the greatest. As of right now tho, they are all hurt so he should be good for the first couple weeks.

5: CheckYourNails (Maggie)
​

Fuck this team. The bitch doesn’t even show up to draft and somehow has a top 5 team. I don’t think she deserves an analysis and I am praying on her downfall. I know your sister was in town but I think your fantasy league should take priority, especially since we moved the draft up at your request, just for you to not even show up. Basic run-down Justin Fields, garbage. Nick Chubb, honestly the worst pick of the draft. Jahmyr Gibbs, a rookie RB? This guy is gonna suck. DK Metcalf is gonna get suspended for using steroids, so a trash ass pick here and Mike Evans is like 40 years old so I wouldn’t be surprised if he retires after one week. Rachaad White is on one of the worst teams in the league so he is gonna gobble more glizzy than Joey Chestnut on July 4th. The flex/bench is trash except JSN since he’s a seahawk. But he did go to Ohio State which everyone knows is a HORRIBLE school (No Penn State Bias at all) so I actually take it back, your whole team is trash and you should trade them all away.
4: Back dat Pass Up (Jess)

This is where it kinda got hard to rank, all these teams going forward is all really good and it was hard to place one over the other. That being said, this was clearly the 4th best team. Austin Eckler is good but is most likely going to regress from last year. No RB has ever been the overall RB1 two years in a row. Still a solid pick and he’s going to put up a lot of points. Rhamondre Stevenson is good and the Patriots run the ball a lot. He should be the main back but I do worry that Zeke might take some carries near the goal line and hinder his score a little. DeVonte Smith is a great add, everyone loves AJ Brown as the Eagles WR1 but because of this, Smith goes under the radar and will still put up great numbers. People forget this man won the Heisman trophy in college which is given to the best player. He legit beat out TLaw, Mac Jones, Najee Harris, Breece Hall, Justin Fields, and Kyle Pitts. The guy is built different. WR2 in DHop is kinda scary, even though he has the best hands in football, he is aging and he is coming off an injury so idk what he is going to look like. I do have hope and I think if he plays a full season, you’re in for something special. The flex/bench is good too. Miles Sanders is the new RB1 in Carolina, big question mark on how he’ll do but I’m sure its good, you have two great options for QB in Geno who is gonna pop off and the sex offender who put up record numbers in assaults. If those numbers translate to the field, you have another stud. The Sleeper on your team is Christian Kirk. A lot of people to feed in Jacksonville but he had a great year last year and I think he can do decent again this year.
3: Jockstraps (Haley)

Is this the number 3 team because the profile picture is a Tom Brady thirst trap? No! Does that help? On to the team breakdown. Kirk Cousins is the baddest mother fucker in Minnesota, don’t fuck with him, he’s throwing for 6000 yards this season and setting the record for most yards in a season. CMC is a LIABILITY at RB. But when he plays, he is one of the best in the league. I personally am not high on him, but a lot of others are. He’ll do fine. AJ Brown is a beast and will literally bully anyone who tries to cover him. He is gonna put up huge numbers this year and be a solid starter all year. Chris Olave is also one of those guys who is going to go nuclear this year. He had no QB last year and still put up over 1000 yards, imagine what he’ll do with a competent QB in Derrick Carr. Mark Andrews is Walmart Travis Kelce; he is a good when he plays but he is kinda hit or miss. Don’t have a lot of faith in him, but then again, I don’t have any faith in any TE who isn’t named Travis Kelce. The flex/bench is one of my favorites in the whole league. Perine is only good for a few weeks until Javonte Williams is healthy but for those few weeks, he should be good. Brandon Cooks is WR2 in Dallas who love to throw the ball, even though he is old, he should get plenty of looks. Kenny Picket is gonna have a great year and if you had a Shitty Starting QB I’d tell you to play him, but Kirko Bango is built different. I think any one of your bench players is my sleeper of the team. Quentin Johnston as WR3 on the best offense in the league will help him produce, same goes for KJ Osborne who is WR3 on the 2nd most pass heavy offense in the league. Jaylen Warren is gonna have a solid role behind Najee and could surprise a lot of people. I think overall this team has a lot of potential and should stay here if not move higher in the rankings as the weeks move on
2: Team Liz (Liz)

With the first pick in the draft, I’d hope you have a good team. JJettas is the best WR and will put up crazy numbers every week. Jaylen Waddle is overlooked because he is on the same team as Tyreek Hill but he is still a really good WR and should put up good points every week too. Breece Hall is a good RB but worries me a little coming back from a torn ACL. No one aside from the GOAT Adrian Beaterson (he beat his son while he was playing and got suspended) has come back from an ACL tear and done well but I think hall should be fine come mid-season. He may slump a little but eventually will come back. James Connor is on the worst team in the league but he is legit the only good plater so someone has to produce and I’m assuming it’s him. Pat Freiermuth is a dawg and will benefit from Kenny Picket taking a step towards greatness in year 2, solid option, he should finish top 5. The flex/bench is good. Jamaal Williams will EAT while Alvin Kamara is suspended but when he comes back, I think his value falls off the face of the earth. Brain Robinson is probably the RB1 in Washington and I really like him. Assuming he stays out of gang violence and doesn’t get shot in the leg again, he could possibly become a weekly starter. A bit of overkill with both Boyd and Higgins since they’re on the same team and the same position but if one of them does well over the other, that’s great but probably don’t need both. The QB situation is wild but I think fine. Dakota Prescot is a gunslinger and throws the ball like a madman which gets a lot of points and TDs but at the same time this man is likely going to throw the most interceptions ins the league this year so it’s a bit of a double-edged sword. Anthony Richardson on the other hand is a rookie so we don’t know how he’s going to perform but from what I have heard he is ass at throwing and super inaccurate BUT he is possibly the most athletic QB ever to come out of college so he is a real threat to run the ball which will score him a lot of points. Definitely worth watching as the season goes on. My sleeper is Roschon Johnson, I think he starts the year slow but could take over the Bears backfield because he is an outstanding natural talent. The only issue is Justin Fields is the QB and he runs a lot too so that takes away from some value. Overall, really solid stuff
1: Team Zissu (Max)

Max put on a masterclass on drafting, don’t be surprised if you see this draft in the Louve someday. Bijan Robinson is only a rookie but every rookie who was drafted in the first round has finished top 10 and Bijan and supposedly a generational talent so I think this will work out great for him. Then he has Aaron Jones who just lost his QB so now the young Jordan Love is most likely going to be throwing a lot of checkdowns as well as handing it off. I wouldn’t be surprised if Aaron Jones finishes top 10 as well. Then to add to his running back situation, he has Lamar Jackson. The best running QB in the league, he just signed a new deal too so he is gonna go out there and show the NFL why he is worth hundreds of millions of dollars. At WR he has Amon-Ra the Sun God Saint Brown. He had a great year last year and I think it only gets better this year, he will kick ass. Then at WR2 is Dionte Johnson, he was ass on paper last year but this was due to the fact he didn’t catch a single touchdown. This will 100% chance, especially in the improving Steeler offense he will be a great WR2. At TE he has Dalton Schultz who just signed with one of the worst teams in the league in the Houston Texans but the thing is they have a rookie QB and they have no WR1 so he could easily take over that role and have a huge workload. Then for Flex/Bench, not my favorite but also not the worst. Scary Terry is a great flex, he is WR1 in Washington but that doesn’t mean a whole lot since their QB is garbanzo beans (garbage). He should still put up goodish numbers weekly. Max also has both KC RBs since no one knows which one will be used, this is some good insurance, Danny Dimes is a great replacement for Lamar is he is on Bye or out. Then the sleeper for this team is Elijah Moore, he is on a Browns team who is all over the place but if he and Mr. Masseuse Molester can link up, he is gonna have a solid year. Overall, I think this is the best team and unless I have more brain damage than Antonio Brown, I don’t see you losing many games this year. It’s your championship to lose.

posts.title: Week 1
blocks: Week 1 Rankings

The first week of football is officially over. What did we learn? Is Aaron Rodgers the biggest sellout in NY history? Are the 49er actually legit? Do the seahawks have any relevancy moving forward? To be honest I don’t know. I have been on suicide watch ever since the Steelers got absolutely raw dogged. They got fucked harder than Adam22’s wife and I had to sit there and watch the whole time, so I guess maybe this football thing isn’t for me. ANYWAYS, I digress, let’s dive into the rankings and see if any of your teams were less dogshit than they were the week before.

 

*Side note, there is this thing called trading which I highly encourage. A lot of you could use the help and a lot of others (ME) in the league could benefit from this being a trade friendly league. AS LONG AS THERE ARE FAIR TRADES. I don’t wanna see some bullshit like Justin Jefferson for Aaron Rodgers. That is what is called (and excuse the poor terminology, but this is what it is commonly referred to, I didn’t make it up, I just follow the trend) a Trade Rape and we do not do those around here*

12. Team Herbert (Brin)
Weekly Change: -6

I am to blame for this. I paid all of Brin’s players to do horribly so that I could win my week 1 matchup. If you look at the scores, there is only one other person who put up less points than me. It ran me about $1,000 since these multi-million-dollar athletes aren’t cheap to pay off, but well worth it. Regardless, I think Brin may be in some trouble. Joe Burrow had a down week but he will come back to normal soon and the same can be said about Sir Saquon Barkley. The rest of the team is kinda scary. Najee and the Steelers looked horrible plus Jaylen Warren got a handful of touches which only takes away from Najee’s value. Being a Steelers fan, I hope this turns around, but it looks pretty bad as of right now. Garrett Wilson just lost a first ballot hall of fame quarterback 4 plays into their game so he is now catching passes from MILF Hunter Zack Wilson. He didn’t look great, but he also didn’t look terrible. The 2 Wilson’s paired together are going to struggle. DJ Moore as well makes me worry. He is the clear WR1 in Chicago but the bears suck at throwing the ball so unless he takes every pass from Justin Fields, he might be in trouble. Like I said the other week I was worried about Engram because of the number of players they have who want the ball and I was about right. He put up 7 points which is to expect and honestly if he does that all year, you should be fine with it. Courtland Sutton did alright however, the Broncos are brining back their injured WR Jerry Jeudy so his targets should go down which could be problematic. Like I predicted though, Zay Flowers popped off and had himself a good first week. Is he WR1 in Baltimore? Or did he just benefit from Mark Andrews being hurt? Hard to say, but I think going forward he is possibly worth starting over some of your other WRs or flex players. I would love to see you turn this around since everyone loves a true underdog story.

11. Team Tsontakis (Ryan)

Weekly Change: +1

I play Ryan this week, however, I will be spared a thousand dollars because this is a team that I am not worried about having to pay off. Josh Allen took the biggest shit of his life on Monday night but he was playing a Jets team who has a supposed top 5 defense so I can’t blame him too much. He should return to normal next week against a weak Raiders defense and lead this team in points. Derrick Henry also kinda had an unusually bad week, he still managed to put up 16 points and I am not too worried that he should hopefully score and get back to the King Henry we all know and love. However, there is concern that he is getting slightly older and the backup played more snaps throughout the whole game. Henry was way more productive but still something to keep an eye on. James Cook in Buffalo looked like he owned most of the teams RB plays but I still worry because like I mentioned the other week, the bills don’t run a lot and there is still a committee. Amari Cooper is the WR1 in Cleveland but they didn’t utilize him as much as I hoped. He should still be played since he is an elite guy but wtf, he is really underperforming what I had expected, I hope he has another poor game this week since they play the Steelers but following that, I hope he turns into the true WR1 I had anticipated from him. David Mongomery looked good and he was the main goal line back which bodes well for points but as the season goes on, I anticipate the Lions made fade him a little in light of Gibbs taking over. That being said the lions produce the most points for RBs in the league so even if they utilize both, they should be fine. I see George Pickens coming alive since Johnson got hurt for the Steelers and he is definitely a guy to keep an eye on. The Cowboy’s defense is good but don’t expect them to bail you out every week. I think that was honestly a fluke BUT they are playing the Jets who have Zack Wilson who is arguably one of the worst backups. They are a lock to start again and I wouldn’t be surprised to see them put up another 25 points. The bench is solid, Darren Waller is still an injury concern, but some added running back support and the surprising Bourne and Meyers combo could be good going forward if they actually turn out to be viable fantasy options.

10: Team Rivera 
Weekly Change: +1

I know, you’re 1-0, I know, you scored the most points in the league. BUT let’s take a deeper look at this. You had the highest scorer of the week on your team in Tyreek Hill putting up fucking 39 points. That’s literally half of the points that your opponent, Liz, scored. Without him, you’re toast. Only 2 other players put-up double-digit points and I don’t see that continuing to happen for Etienne. Not to mention your other running back blew out his ACL on the first drive of the game so you are in trouble when it comes to depth. I like your starters and I think the RBs should hold up as long as the WRs and TE do their job but if not, things could go south quick. I see Christian Watson coming back from injury and I think he should be decent but at the same time idk how that Packers offense is going to play against a team that isn’t the Bears and actually knows how to play defense. I do like Sam LaPorta but idk if he is gonna be reliable to put up more than 6 a game and same with Sky Moore, the chiefs just had a horrible game where Kadarius Toney dropped like 6 critical balls so maybe Mahomo will look to Sky Moore more frequently and he could pop off. But with Kelce returning this is doubtful. I’ll keep an eye on this team and I think I am just bias because I have no faith in either Josh Jacobs or Travis Etienne, but if they can be consistent until week 4 or 5, then maybe I’ll switch my tune and move you up the ranks. But if you’re winning, who gives a shit if you’re ranked 11th, as the famous war general, Geroge Washington once said, a win is a win.

9: Team Poage (Matte)
Weekly Change: 0

New Yorks Lord and savior did not even last 15 minutes into the game. If we pretend that’s seconds, I can last longer than that in bed…. that’s pitiful, on Rodger’s part, not mine. Maybe both. Anyways, back to football. It seems you’ve picked up Mr. Irrelevant in Brock Purdy. I think he should be okay every week. He’s not flashy but he should put up at least 12 points a week since his whole offense is stacked with a million ways to score. Enough jerking off to the mid 49ers I wanna talk about your WR situation. Clavin Ridley is him, that man will be kicking ass all year and should consistently be in your starters. Jamarr Chase had a down week since Joey B did. Could be problematic if Burrow’s injury lingers and this becomes a frequent thing but I think that the Bengals should be fine and Chase should also be fine going forward. Your bench/flex is loaded with Deebo, Thomas, and Pittman. They are all still a little unproven and it’s hard to tell if they’ll continue putting up good numbers but they should all be considered in the starting lineup weekly. OBJ is washed, get rid of his old ass, Chase Claypool is the biggest BUM I’ve seen since your mom’s dump truck of an ass (Boom roasted), and then Parris Campbell is on the Giants so hardly any value there. The RBs are interesting. I think (hope) that Walkers game was a fluke, Detroit has a bad run defense and he should tear them up. He saw majority of the caries and their backup didn’t get much action at all. Dalvin Cook tho is in a committee and he is going to lose shares as the year goes on unless Breece Hall tears his ACL again which I really hope doesn’t happen. Aside from that you’re fucked until Kamar comes back. Good luck, keep your chin up, OR here’s an idea, look at your fucking trade offers and accept something from someone who is offering you a RB since your team needs help. Just a thought <3

8: Saquon these nuts (Trevor)
Weekly Change: 0

This team is sketchy as fuck. Hurts had a bad week but I’m assuming he’ll return to the top QB he is or at least I hope so. If he doesn’t and the Steelers continue to lose, and the 49ers continue to win, then I’m really gonna need you all to be texting me daily making sure I am okay and don’t hang myself. But that’s quite unlikely that all three of those things happen, right? RIGHT? The RBs worry me. Apparently, Tony Pollard is good, I have 0 faith in him and the cowboys but he did put up 21 points so I guess I can’t complain. Herbert got railed and going against the Bucs this week I think the same is gonna happen so that’s unfortunate. I need Jonathan Taylor to be traded asap so that he can play and save my team. I feel like all the WRs are 2nd stringers and not one of them feels like a safe play every week. Travis Kelce looks to return tho so hopefully that’ll be my light at the end of the tunnel and turn things around for me. The bench is decent and I’m hoping to maybe trade some players and fill some holes. Idk I really actually don’t love it, BUT I am confident and speaking it into existence that I have nothing to worry about since I am facing Ryan this week. 2-0 here I come!

7: Team Bekah (Bekah)
Weekly Change: 0

Jackson Mahomes may be the throat goat (closeted) but Patrick Mahomes is the actual Goat. He is gonna carry this team weekly and I don’t worry at all about him. The WRs are also 2 of the best who I believe just had a down week, tho it is a bit concerning Adams was out targeted by the 2nd or 3rd string guy Jakobi Meyers. Hopefully that’s a one-time thing. Kittle is okay, the only hesitancy I have is that the 49ers have a million other dudes to score so Kittle gets lost in the shuffle. But he is a TE so in reality, him putting up 4 points a game is normal and no one will bat an eye at it. The problem I have is the RBs they are both on bad teams and they also haven’t really proved they’re good at this game of football. I think Pierce will do good eventually but the problem is he has a really tough schedule and makes it unlikely he'll pop off weekly, plus with a rookie QB, who knows what he’ll do. Cam Akers is splitting time with someone who no one even knew of until last week and if he doesn’t score touchdowns, I think he’s kinda useless. Overall, this team is a bit worrisome since out of the total 16 players drafted, only 3 of them scored over 10 points. And the worst part about it was that 2 of the 3 were QBs so in reality you can only play one of those a week and it doesn’t matter what the other does. Then my favorite part was that the other player to score over 10 points……WAS A KICKER. When we get to the bye weeks in the NFL, I see this team struggling a lot.

6. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Weekly Change: -1

My manifestations are coming through. This team is dropping in the ranking. Justin Fields is going to be referring to the Packers as daddy for the rest of his career, Nick Chubb Struggled, Gibbs got like 4 carries all game (lol fucking sucker). Mike Evans is TD dependent, DK Metcalf is a freak of nature but it doesn’t matter if the Seahawks sucks so nice job playing his big dumb ass. Your TE is useless especially since Fields is the QB. Big yikes there. Rachaad White doesn’t actually know how to play football 17 times for 39 yards. You could literally stand at the line of scrimmage and fall forward and I’m pretty sure you’d have more yards than he did. And the Dolphins defense got you negative points, so big claps all around for Maggie. The bench has Kadarius Toney who single handedly lost the chiefs their game week one so I doubt Mahomes will be throwing his way anymore. JSN is literally a knockoff DK so idk why you have 2 seahawk receivers, kinda dumb. The only thing I’m pissed about is you picked up Joshua Kelly because I wanted him. Ain’t no way you knew to do that on your own, so tell your little boy toy that you’re asking for advice that he can go fuck himself. If I catch you in person consulting anyone else about fantasy, you’re getting your ass beat. This could have all been avoided had you actually drafted with us and maybe I would have given you some actually thoughtful insight but instead you chose this path and I hope you’re learning that your actions do indeed have consequences. After all is said and done if you lose to Brin this week, who is last place, I am automatically moving your ass to last place and you’ll stay there all season. Wishing nothing but the worst, hugs and kisses, xoxo -Gossip Girl

5. Jockstraps (Haley)
 Weekly Change: -2

Honestly still a pretty good team, Kirko Cousin fucker is solid but his matchup against the Eagles scares me because they legit own the Vikings, regardless he’ll probably still play well.  McCaffery kicked the shit out of the Steelers and I imagine he’ll do the same to the Rams who also don’t have the best run defense. Mattison makes me hesitate a little, he hasn’t gotten a whole lot of work but I’m sure he can still put up respectable RB2 numbers and get you at least 10 points a game. AJ Brown is gonna pop off this week and for sure should be your starter. He should put up at least 20 points and be the leading scorer on this team alongside McCaffery. Olave is solid and I think he gets a lot of targets against the shitty Panthers D. Hopefully mark Andrews actually returns to the lineup and if so, I think he should produce a fair number of points. Zay Jones in the flex is a great choice, I thought he was WR3 on that team but turns out he is actually WR2 so that’s hype and he should get a good number of targets and if he scores a TD then you’re extra in luck. The bench could use some work but if you play the starters every week, they don’t matter that much. I’m sure you’ll figure it out going forward and this should be a playoff team

4: Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Weekly Change: 0

Another really solid team. I struggled placing you and Haley. You were both pretty much neck and neck the only thing that gave you the leg up was that your bench was better and deeper. Your QB may be a predator, but he is a predator who is good at football. He is looking like the guy from 2018 who was in the running for MVP, obviously he is a much-diluted version of what he once was, but he’s still good. The RB situation is chillin. Eckler is a dog and even though he wanted a reduced work load, he still produced a lot of yards and in turn, points. This should continue and he’ll carry this team. Stevenson had a tough week last week but he’ll do well against the Dolphins who suck at playing defense as Maggie learned last week. Even at the flex if needed Miles sanders is a great option. I expected more against the leagues projected worst defense but maybe this week he bounces back and can be viable as the season progresses. The WRs are good, Smith is literally AJ Brown Jr so he’ll get points but maybe not as many as Brown, still keeps you competitive. DHop looked good. The titans didn’t look that great but some of my worries about Hopkins are going away. I am interested to see what happens in the redzone, do they throw to him who is arguably one of the best redzone threats or do they give it to Henry who is the biggest power running back in the league and just let him bull it in? Who knows but I think that very much impacts his value on this team. Kirk was a bit of a disappointment but maybe that was a one-week thing, but Gus the Bus is your hidden treasure. With Dobbins hurt, I think this guy will take over and hopefully can be of some value. It might be on your team, it might be in a trade, but there is value to be found.

3. Team Liz (Liz)
Weekly Change : -1

Is this the number 3 team because the profile picture is a Tom Brady thirst trap? No! Does that help? On to the team breakdown. Kirk Cousins is the baddest mother fucker in Minnesota, don’t fuck with him, he’s throwing for 6000 yards this season and setting the record for most yards in a season. CMC is a LIABILITY at RB. But when he plays, he is one of the best in the league. I personally am not high on him, but a lot of others are. He’ll do fine. AJ Brown is a beast and will literally bully anyone who tries to cover him. He is gonna put up huge numbers this year and be a solid starter all year. Chris Olave is also one of those guys who is going to go nuclear this year. He had no QB last year and still put up over 1000 yards, imagine what he’ll do with a competent QB in Derrick Carr. Mark Andrews is Walmart Travis Kelce; he is a good when he plays but he is kinda hit or miss. Don’t have a lot of faith in him, but then again, I don’t have any faith in any TE who isn’t named Travis Kelce. The flex/bench is one of my favorites in the whole league. Perine is only good for a few weeks until Javonte Williams is healthy but for those few weeks, he should be good. Brandon Cooks is WR2 in Dallas who love to throw the ball, even though he is old, he should get plenty of looks. Kenny Picket is gonna have a great year and if you had a Shitty Starting QB I’d tell you to play him, but Kirko Bango is built different. I think any one of your bench players is my sleeper of the team. Quentin Johnston as WR3 on the best offense in the league will help him produce, same goes for KJ Osborne who is WR3 on the 2nd most pass heavy offense in the league. Jaylen Warren is gonna have a solid role behind Najee and could surprise a lot of people. I think overall this team has a lot of potential and should stay here if not move higher in the rankings as the weeks move on

2. Team (Gabe)
Weekly Change: +8

Our big winner of the week! I never doubted that your team would be here, I totally just wanted to gas you up when your team turned the tide and won. Justin Herbert is daddy and can get it on and off the field any day, you still got Jimmy G which is so valid, I can’t even be mad about it. Joe Mixon shit the bed but holy shit Tyler Allgeier. I thought he would be used for a little in that offense but I did not expect him to get this much work and actually be one of top 5 fantasy options for RBs. God damn I wish I had picked him up in the draft. The WRs are all study as fuck, Diggs is gonna ball even when Josh Allen has a bad game so I can’t wait to see when he has a good game. Keenen Allen is Herberts favorite target and with their WR2 getting hurt, his role is only going to grow. And then fucking Brandon Aiyuk I knew that little fucker was gonna outperform Deebo but holy shit again I did not expect it to be by this much. He will most likely come back to earth next week and I doubt he’ll put up 28 but he is definitely a guy to keep in the starting lineup. Even the TEs in Ferguson and Pitts are 2 very solid options (as far as TE goes) and I think this is a really well-rounded team. Your backup RBs are the only place I have a little worry but I think Swift should have a bigger role and even Dillion did okay last week sharing a good portion of the Green bay RB touches. Good shit, maybe next week you’ll take over number 1, I just gotta see some consistency since it feels like a handful of these guys had surprising weeks to me. But only time will tell, I guess.

1: Team Zissu (Max)
Weekly Change: 0

Big Dawg staying atop the rankings. Lamar sucked but that’s not gonna happen often, he’ll probably want a redemption week and go crazy against the Bengals. Bijan was outscored by his teammate but that doesn’t matter since they both scored a shitload of points which should consistently happen since they play for the best running team in the league. Aaron Jones was Jordan Love’s safety valve and should continue that way all season. Amon Ra put the team on his back in their win over KC so he’s gonna have a huge head going forward and continue on his tear throughout the league. Dionte got hurt but Scarry Terry is a great replacement until he gets back, hell he may even be a starter going forward. They are both about the same level in my eyes and it’s purely based off of matchup going week to week. I still don’t have a lot of love of Pacheco but there are a bunch of guys to plug into that flex. If it’s Moore, he had a solid week and looks to impress going forward, Gainwell looked like the lead back in Philly, but you can never trust a birds back, and then even Bateman may be decent. Looks like he lost the starting WR role in the offense but still who knows. This team faltered a little with the injury to Johnson but still no doubt this is the best team in the league. Best core, solid bench, all around a lot of good things going here.

posts.title: Week 2
blocks: Week 2 Rankings

What a week, there were 3 games that all finished within a singular point of each other this week. That is absolutely insane. For reference, if your QB takes a knee at the end of the game, that counts as -1 yard and -0.1 points, this would have changed the outcome of 2 of those games, that’s how close this week’s matchups were. Absolutely ELECTRIC!!!

 

Getting to real football, there were hella injuries this week, Nick Chubb is lucky to still have his leg attached to his body and at least 3 to 4 starting running backs all sat out this week with some form of injury. The fact that everyone and their mother is injured is definitely taking a huge effect on these rankings and you’ll see some decent teams take a dip due to that. This is where depth and trading/wavier wire adds is gonna come in clutch, seems like that may be the only way for some teams to stay afloat going forward. I know it’s only week 2 but going 0-3 is hard to turn around and it may be time to sink or swim for a handful of you fools. With all the injuries and Bye weeks will be coming up soon, things are gonna get wonky to say the least. Strap in, not on, and pray for the best.

12. Team Herbert (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -6
Weekly Change: 0

Not a whole lot going on here. Saquon who was carrying this team has found himself among the injured and will probably be out 3 weeks, Najee and the Pittsburgh offense looks like complete dogshit so unfortunately, he’s not gonna be putting up a lot of points weeks to week. The one shining star of your team and the IRL team, at least last week, was that Steelers defense. Single handedly got you the W against Margarette and I could not have been happier for you. Joe Burrrrrrr looks like he forgot how to play football and he is battling injury so again you seem to be shit outta luck there. Fortunately, there are a handful of QBs on the waiver wire that you can pick up or you can try to trade with someone. Garrett Wilso surprised me and got a handful of points but I will be shocked if this happens every week. Me personally I’d try to trade him away for someone else to fill some holes but at this point if you like him and think he’s a cutie, keep him. Zay Flowers and Courtland Sutton both underwhelmed in last weeks games and unfortunately it seems like that might be the norm for them going forward. They both had their WR1’s out week one and then when they came back, they both took a hit to production. I could be wrong, and I hope I am, but it doesn’t look too hot. The bench is where you need the help, your starters are all viable, however the rest of the team is kinda struggling, aside from Mostert, I probably wouldn’t roster most of those guys. Good luck on the waivers and may the odds be ever in your favor!

11. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -6
Weekly Change: -5

First and foremost, prayers up to Nick Chubb. Homeboy may never walk again after that hit. NOW to my favorite part of these rankings, tearing apart this team. I have never been so happy to drop someone so fast in the rankings. Did I exaggerate where you should be? Should you maybe be a spot or two higher? Absolutely not, this team is going nowhere, except bottom two. Hope you enjoy being handcuffed to someone for a whole night, dweeb. Going into the season I thought Justin Fields was that guy, I thought he was HIM; I was wrong. He is not Kenough and frankly he is just not that good at football is seems. Makes sense, he came from Ohio. Once teams figured out that he can’t throw the ball for shit and he can only run it, he became much easier to stop. Nick Chubb is out for the year so your best player and number 1 draft pick is basically worthless at this point. On draft day, I was mad that the computer auto drafted him for you, I thought you got a steal, but now I know that AI knew what was going to happen and they were actually trying to fuck you because you blew off the draft. You got so fleeced on the Khalil Herbert trade; I can’t believe you were dumb enough to take him from me lol get fucked nerd. Your two shining stars are now Mike Evans and DK Metcalf. I swear to got Metcalf is an alien or at least he’s taking more steroids than the liver king. Regardless he continues to do fine and he is putting up decent numbers, it’s just unfortunate that him and Tyler Lockett seems to switch off week to week on who does well. Evans surprised me so far, I think he’s gonna come back down to earth soon but so far so good for him. Zack Ertz is goated, I just like saying his name in sentences. On such sentence could be, “I was talking trash to Maggie and then, because she has anger management issues, along with many other deep rooted, childhood traumas, she kicked me in the balls. Now I can’t stop crying because my ballZach Ertz……..” ba-dum-tsss. I’m gonna tell myself someone found that funny and continue writing as if my whole personality doesn’t revolve around making others laugh. Back to business, ummm the usual, your team is garbage and the players who did well this past week only did well because they played shitty teams. Keep up the bad work and I hope that soon, you’ll surpass Brin for last place

10. Team Bekah (Bekah):
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: -3

This team will live and die by your receivers every single week. Fortunately for you, you have two of the best receivers in football. CeeDee lamb and Dallas look unstoppable at the moment and Devante and the sexiest man in the world are developing some chemistry, so going forward, he should continue to pop off. Patty Mahomie is gonna probably be your most constant piece every week and George Kittle is probably gonna be your most inconsistent. The running back situation is abysmal, Pierce is good, but he is on a trash team so unfortunately, he isn’t gonna be putting up a whole lot of points, like ever. The only chance he has is if he scores a touchdown which his team doesn’t do a whole lot of. Williams is in the same situation, except his team is perhaps worse and uses him less so he is a K-mart version of Pierce who is already a K-mart version of some of the best RBs in the league. One could say that Williams is perhaps a dollar tree running back. Cam Akers is getting absolutely fucked in LA. While that may be some influencers dreams, as a fantasy owner, that is very unfortunate. He was projected to be the starter and their coach even said he was going to have a huge role going forward. His coach is a dirty liar and Akers is not even getting a singular snap during the game. Maybe hold him and hope that someone trades for him but it’s unlikely he finds much use going forward. Once again, I will tear into this bench. I apologize in advance but this is legit beyond my comprehension. Sure, having Tua is good, but he’s useless if he sits on your bench every week like he is going to do bc you have Mahomes. You have a TE who is also super inconsistent, the backup to your K-mart running back who is getting hardly any work, 2 decent WR’s so I’ll give you some praise there, but then I’ll rip that praise right away because you have a second kicker and a second-string running back who is on the IR? FOR WHAT? I just don’t get it. Maybe the angle is that you want to be handcuffed to someone at the end of the year. If that’s you kink, I’ll buy you a pair of handcuffs for Christmas, otherwise, 0-2 does not look good for you rn.

9: Team Poage (Matte)
Post Draft Change: 0
Weekly Change: 0

Perhaps the most consistent team in these rankings, you have not moved once, but you have been leapfrogged in both directions on this list. I think this team is sitting here in this spot due to its lack of performance. I have no doubt that you’ll move up this list, it’s just a matter of when. You current RB situation is not ideal but once Kamara comes back, you’ll be okay until your bye weeks. The WR’s are fine, but they just aren’t producing. Chase has suffered from Joe Sheisty’s amnesia of how to throw a football but I believe that is slowly, very slowly turning around. Ridley is fine, just had a bad week. Goedart is also struggling but I think eventually he’ll turn that around. I anticipated him to be top 5 by the end of the year but not at this rate. Then aside from Deebo who is boom or bust every week and Pittman who is sneaky good, you have a lot of longshots on your team. MT, OBJ, Claypool, Campbell, they are not going to start often or at all but they may be some value every once in a while. I think they’re destine to sit on the bench and piss you off when they have a 25-point game once or twice throughout the year while you played Chase who put up 4 points. The come up is coming, it’s just disguised as Jonny Sins and gonna take a long time to cum 😉

8. Team Rivera (Adrian):
Post Draft Change: +3
Weekly Change: +2

After putting up a shitload of points week one, this team came back down to earth faster than that guy from red bull who jumped from outer space. Tyreek only put up 12 and this week TJ Cockenson was the hero of your team putting up an outrageous 22. Unfortunately, the rest of your team sold. Jacobs and the Raiders look HORRIBLE on the ground, the Jags got railed by the Chiefs sneaky D. I’m not talking about Bill Cosby’s sneaky D in the sense he gotta drug you to get what he wants. The Chiefs had their way with the Jags with no alcohol or roofies involved and that took a heavy toll on your team in terms of both Etienne and TLaw. I don’t think that’ll happen too often but when it does, I didn’t realize the severity to how it effected your team. The WR’s seem like a crapshoot at this point. Is Dotson, Williams, Watson, Moore, or Shaheed going to go off this week or will they be a dud? Stay tuned for next weeks episode of boom or bust, hosted by yours truly Adrain Rivera. Overall, I think there’s a few holes but they can easily be plugged by Tyreek going nuclear every other week. You’ll be just fine going forward.

7. Team Tsontakis (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +5 
Weekly Change: +4

I talked all that shit on this team only to get bent over a table and spanked while Ryan asked me, “Who’s your Daddy?” This team is blowing my expectations out of the water so far, it’s a ragtag group of guys just being doods but it’s working somehow. Josh Allen is maybe returning to what we expect and even though Henry is putting up way less points than I expected, he is still putting up enough to be a top 10 RB. I was sleeping on James Cook and apparently, he’s good now so that’s kinda hype for you going forward. Mr. Mongomery is busted up and gonna miss a few weeks but no need to fear, you have Kyren Williams on the bench who has taken over in LA which no one saw coming. I guess it pays off to suck week 1 and have first grab at the waivers. The WR situation is where my confusion is, they shouldn’t be good, none of them were expected to be relevant aside form Pickens and Cooper yet here they are putting up double digits weekly. I don’t get it! I think you have been the biggest winner so far due to your defense and kicker situation. You have the best defense in the league and your kicker puts up more points than a lot of starters. If that falls off, so may your team, but for the moment it is sustainable. Even though you beat me, I’m still putting you behind me mainly just because I’m better at shot gunning beers than you. Get your money up, not your funny up, see you in a month.

6. Jockstraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: -1

I moved you back only because I am better at fantasy than you are, lol get fucked. Nah but for real, it was pretty tight between 5th and 6th, you have undoubtably the best RB in the league followed by possibly the worst starting RB in the league. If it weren’t for CMC, you’d probably be in a little trouble rn. You also got dummy lucky with your win the other night winning by 0.06 points. Needless to say, The White Mamba, Big Dick Nick’s twice removed cousin, Kirk “You Like That” Cousins is gonna pop off and get you hella points. This is the most pass heavy offense and they will be in shootouts every week so he’s good for at least 20 every week. AJ Brown is a hit or miss depending on how Jalen Hurts is feeling on game day. Sometimes its him, sometimes its Smith, there’s no rhyme or reason, you just gotta ride the wave and hope for the best or hope for your team to make up for when he slacks off. Olave is solid and is putting up good numbers, he is just lacking the TDs but those will come. The thing that sets me above you, is the bench. Zay Jones is your guy and the rest are bums. I know you like Lazard because he’s a hometown hero, but without Rodgers, he’s looking like he works for paw patrol and that’s the only hero duty he’s gonna be doing anytime soon. Warren may be viable but that’s a big maybe. Two defenses aren’t my favorite thing to do but if you have some attachment to Tampa or your good old Cheeseheads, then you keep them. You gotta think though, am I saying this because I want you to drop one so I can pick them up? Am I in your head? Is this mental gymnastics? Reverse psychology maybe, because you’re like no he doesn’t want them, but then again maybe he does, but then he’d not say anything so does he actually want one? The world may never know. Enjoy 6th place loser, seems like you’re dropping slowly every week, let’s hope that stops soon, doubt it tho, unless….

5. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor):
Post Draft Change: +3
Weekly Change: +3

Honestly still a pretty good team, Kirko Cousin fucker is solid but his matchup against the Eagles scares me because they legit own the Vikings, regardless he’ll probably still play well.  McCaffery kicked the shit out of the Steelers and I imagine he’ll do the same to the Rams who also don’t have the best run defense. Mattison makes me hesitate a little, he hasn’t gotten a whole lot of work but I’m sure he can still put up respectable RB2 numbers and get you at least 10 points a game. AJ Brown is gonna pop off this week and for sure should be your starter. He should put up at least 20 points and be the leading scorer on this team alongside McCaffery. Olave is solid and I think he gets a lot of targets against the shitty Panthers D. Hopefully mark Andrews actually returns to the lineup and if so, I think he should produce a fair number of points. Zay Jones in the flex is a great choice, I thought he was WR3 on that team but turns out he is actually WR2 so that’s hype and he should get a good number of targets and if he scores a TD then you’re extra in luck. The bench could use some work but if you play the starters every week, they don’t matter that much. I’m sure you’ll figure it out going forward and this should be a playoff team

4: Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: 0
Weekly Change: 0

Your team is my spot-on prediction of the good teams. I predicted Matte would be ass at the bottom of the rankings and he’s stayed there since the draft, and now I have hit your ranking on the head 3 weeks in a row as the consensus 4th best team remaining constant while everyone else shifts all around. This team is good but it does scare me that they won’t be consistent weekly. Stevenson is good but with Eckler out, you may struggle a little bit. That being said, Gus the Bus was a unit last week and got you 12.2 points which was huge, if only he had gotten you 12.3 tho…..a true tragedy. Anyways the WRs are pretty solid too. It’s hard to say but Smith may be becoming the WR1 on his team but this may just be an over reaction to one week. DHop hasn’t shown me enough this year to make me believe in him but he has the best set of hands in the league so if Tannahill throws the ball to him more, he is gonna be super solid every week in this lineup. Boobie Sanders is also solid but he has been struggling on that offense to actually do anything so going forward I’d for sure keep an eye on him, he is definitely a flex guy at best. The bench isn’t terrible, Kirk is a boom or bust guy and the rest of the WRs aren’t great aside from Atwell who is gonna put up decent numbers until Kupp comes back. I love the Geno pick and I think he just had a horrible week 1 and going forward is going to dominate this league.

3. Team Liz (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change : 0

This team probably has the best RB core in the league. Connor has been a workhorse and Robinson popped off too last week. It was in part due to 2 TDs but that’s neither here nor there. Jamall Williams may be hurt from what I’m hearing but she has Breece Hall on the bench who I am hopeful for but worried. He lost his starting QB in Aaron Rodgers so you’d think he gets more work, but in fact it was the opposite and he only got 4 carries this past week which is atrocious. The WRs are nothing to complain about either, JJetas is once again the best in the league and as I say every week, is gonna be your breadwinner. Waddle is good but similar to Hall, I am still holding out hope. Tyreek Hill was normal this week but Waddle still didn’t see a whole lot of work. Still 10 points is nothing to cry about but I want to believe his ceiling is higher. The bench is not too shabby either. A handful of plug and play options exist such as T Higgins who dropped 24 this week after dropping a big old goose egg last week. If needed he can suffice and then Thielen showed up and this week and looks like he may be relevant on that stagnant panther’s offense. I’m gonna bitch about it weekly, but why do you have both Higgins and Boyd on your team. That is WR2 and WR3 for the Bengals, you’ll likely never play them together, and if you do, you must be down worse than Maggie after she got her heart broken, fired, and then played by like 6 boys, who might I add, aren’t even cute. The girl says “he’s so hot” and then when she shows everyone, everyone proceeds to tell her he is so ugly and she should never text him again. I got on a tangent there, but my point is, I never want you to be that down bad where you have to play both those guys.

2. Team Zissu (Max):
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: -1

Oh, how the mighty have fallen! Not far, but still a slip up perhaps as you have been displaced upon the top of the rankings. I mean not much to complain about at this point. Lamar returned to normal, Bijan is turning out to be unstoppable on that falcon’s offense, and Amon Ra is still doing that thang he does where he puts up a good amount of points every week. Even with Aaron Jones out, you still have a good starting lineup. Don’t love Pacheco but for a week or 2 he is fine. Scary Terry is honestly a little Scary at this point. The Commanders aren’t that great and without TDs Terry might be trouble for this team. The flex and bench are still a little soft but as soon as Johnson comes back, it revitalizes your team a little. Same goes for Gainwell though the situation in Philly is so suspect and no one knows what is going on with who is going to lead that backfield. I feel bad because this is short in comparison to others, but there is legit nothing to complain about. This is still a good team and you’re gonna still be contending every week.

1. Team (Gabe)
Post Draft Change: +9 
Weekly Change: +1

My first request is fix your fucking name. Give it a name rather than just Team, I can’t have the winner of this league being “Team Team”. You have so many players on your team that you can make a pun from. I’m in the Pitts, Catalina Wine Mixon, I like Diggs in my mouth, to name a few, idk check the good old fashion internet for help if you need, there are probably a million puns. On to ranking tho, congrats, you have taken over the number one spot. I feel this may be temporary and perhaps recency bias, but your team looks good. The Stack of Herbert and Keenen Allen is unreal, those two alone could almost outscored some teams on a weekly basis. Diggs is fine as long as Josh Allen is fine and Aiyuk is still good even if he isn’t the center of attention on that 49er’s powerful offense. I don’t love the RB situation mainly because the Eagles RBs are wack and Joe Mixon has almost been nonexistent this year, but you have some decent help in Allgeier and Dillion who can easily fill in for one of those and put up 5-10 points a week so it could be worse. I don’t think you’ll ever start Jimmy G this season, but perhaps because he is on your team, you’re winning. That theory is yet to be proved, but you are indeed the only undefeated team in this league through 2 weeks, so to that, I say good luck and I hope that next week when you play Max, we see if your team is fraudulent or fabulous.

posts.title: Week 3
blocks: Week 3 Rankings

Yet another week of football goes by and yet another week where I really question if I know anything about not just fantasy football but also regular football. This weeks irl games saw the Mr. Unlimited (Russel Wilson) and the broncos looking like Riley Reed about to star in Pornhub’s newest BLACKED segment.  The dolphins’ players all put up +30 points in fantasy and most of them didn’t even play the full game. This most likely isn’t sustainable long term but holy shit you single handedly won your weekly matchup if you had any of those guys on your team.

 

In other news, football just because the most popular sport in America. Was it due to the fact that the Cowboys, who were Superbowl favorites going into this week, lost to one of the worst teams in the league in the Cardinals? Of course not! It was solely due to the fact that T-Swizzle showed up in arrowhead to support the corniest motherfucker in the league. As if Taylor Swift didn’t already have a chokehold on America, now she has infiltrated football. The mojo dojo casa house in crumbling as we speak and the men are losing everything, we once held dear. Next year Taylor is gonna headline the Superbowl, and at that point, you might as well put her in as the opposing team’s quarterback. I guarantee that 90% of people watching at that point will be Swifties and it’s just going to turn into a concert and no football will be played.

 

THOUGH, the conspiracy theorist in me has head whispers of a devious deed that Taylor may be cooking up in the lab. As any Swifties knows, Taylor is from Pennsylvania and presumably, a diehard Eagles fan. Going back to last years superbowl, the Chiefs beat the Eagles. Now I’m not saying she is going to date Kelce until the superbowl, where the Eagles and Chiefs will indefinitely meet again for a rematch, BUT if she follows through with this and then BREAKS UP with him right before the big game, he would be devastated! How could he possibly play well, and with that, it would give the Eagles all the momentum and an easy win. So, if that is indeed her plan, I applaud you Taylor and I take back all the mean things I have said about you and your fans.

 

Seems I may have gotten off on a bit of a tangent there, back to analyzing out league. The first thing I would like to note, is that there were a handful of name changes. Big applause to all of you who have not just your last name but some pun, there are still 4 of you who have just your name, and one of you who has the worlds dumbest team name, you know who you are. If we could bump those numbers up to 100%, that would be, Travis Scott, aka sicko mode. Like I had previously mentioned, this week was wild for fantasy and really makes me question if I know jack shit about football because as I look at some of these rosters, I question why in the world would I have them ranked so high or low last week, clearly their roster is championship caliber. So, with that, let’s take a peek at the rankings and we can all make fun of me at the end of the season for how silly my rankings were the first few weeks.

12. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -7
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 1-2

You hate to see it, unless you’re me, then if that’s the case, you love seeing you in dead last. In previous weeks your rankings may have dropped slightly due to the fact that I was a little butthurt, but at this point, I genuinely think you have the worst team here. Justin Fields and the bears are one of the worst teams in the league. We’ll find out this Thursday when they play the Broncos who is actually the worst, but I wouldn’t be surprised if that game ends in a tie, it would only be fitting. Regardless he is absolutely booty cheeks His RB, Khalil Herbert is also turning out to be a fraud and then you have Josh Kelly as your replacement for Nick Chubb, may his soul rest in peace. Your other RB options are Rachaad White who like I’ve been saying this whole time, is a bum, and the Eagles 3rd string guy in Rashaad Penny. Fortunately, for you, since your team is so trash, you will have first dibs on the waivers and if you don’t end up with Achane, you’re an idiot. The WRs are your saving grace rn, Metcalf is solid and Evans somehow finds the endzone every week which salvages his score. My grandmother who has Alzheimer’s could probably have picked a better rest of the team than you. Your bench is forgettable to say the least. As much as I love shitting on you, I shall move to the shadow leader of this team, show this review to your little itty bitty boy toy, who is helping you pick all this shit, and let him know that he has the IQ of Forrest Gump. Honestly, him giving you this advice is a huge red flag and should make you question if he has your best interest in mind. Stay Shitty, love and kisses always -Big Dawg

11. Team Herbert (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 2-1

Yet another week goes by, and yet again, you are bailed out by someone on your team going absolutely apeshit. Last week the Steelers, this week Raheem Mostert. I was lowkey praying on your downfall since I gave you a lot of advice mainly based around not using Sam Howell and you basically said, “I trust my 8-year-old brother more than you”. How did that work? Sam Howell finished the game with 0.6 points, for a majority of that game, he was in the negative for points!!! That’s unheard of for a QB unless your name is Zack Wilson, who you had mentioned “looked cute and maybe you’d add him instead.” No matter, you still clutched up somehow and have a better record than I do, so my shit talking should remain at a minimum. The WRs aren’t doing terrible, Zay Flowers is a decent WR2 for your team and Sutton is somehow becoming a WR1 at this rate which is pretty amazing. Wilson is still trouble since he has Zack Wilson throwing him the ball but there are rumors that the Jets are going to trade for a QB and if that’s the case, he might be worth keeping. Saquon should be coming bac soon and he can hopefully replace the way underperforming Najee Harris. The bench is still not great but it could honestly be worse. I can see some of these guys consistently making it into your starting lineup. I still think a glance at the waivers would be pretty helpful and you might be able to add a piece here or there if they fall to you.

10. Team Bekah (Bekah):
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 1-2

I don’t know if I understand how math works at this point. I am looking at last week’s matchup and somehow you put up 129 points which doesn’t make sense to me. I see Mahomes and Adams combined for 60 points but I still can’t fathom how the rest of your team put up 70 points. However, it happened, a win is a win. The RB situation is abysmal though there could be a light at the end of the tunnel. Cam Akers was just traded to the Vikings so maybe he can somehow turn it around and actually be relevant this year, but I doubt it. You also still have a 3rd string RB on your bench who is on the IR meaning he is not playing any time soon and is a wasted space. Me seeing this makes me question if you are reading this or taking my advice because he should have been gone long ago. Also, you have not answered any of my trade requests nor have you made any acquisitions on the waiver wire, so are you really giving this your all??? So, I’m gonna write some bs here like pee pee poo poo caca in my butthole, and if you don’t call me stupid for this, then we’re throwing fisticuffs the next time I see you in the kitchen. Lol I’m only kidding, unless I’m not. I would highly recommend upgrading your team though or at least changing your lineup weekly because if not, you are going to end up handcuffed to someone at the end of the year. If you’re into the handcuff kink tho, good for you, but there are other ways you can do it rather than playing the long game here and losing our league. But truly this team could use some help. I think there is some hope, your team has a lot of potential with the WRs and even TE, but they are just super shaky and seem to not do nearly enough on a week-to-week basis to keep you competitive. Me saying this though could jinx your team and going forward I wouldn’t be surprised if they somehow turn it around and do decent. At least to the point where you finish middle of the pack and not dead last.

9: Back dat Pass Up (Jess):
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: -5
Record: 1-2

I really liked this team the first few weeks, but it seems this team is slowly falling apart. Taking a fat drop in the rankings here, I question why I originally had you so high. I think my vision is very clouded at the moment due to the fact Austin Eckler isn’t playing. If he is healthy again, I think you should move up a spot or two but right now, this team is struggling heavy all around. It seems that every week you have made the wrong decision at QB and the one that you bench always outperforms the other. And while this is funny, it makes you think that maybe you could use another QB since both these guys seems to fluctuate so much on a weekly basis. One week they’re the goat, next week they’re the woat. The RBs are decent but Stevenson has kinda fallen off a cliff and Gus the Bus is not sustainable long term. Boobie (Miles) Sanders is getting a lot of work and I think at the moment he is your best option but again it’s hard to say since that Carolina offense is not great. I do like your WR situation though, Smith and Atwell are both solid choices though Smith seems to suffer the same fate as Watson and Geno where he is super spotty and idk if week to week, he is going to put up 25 points or 5 points. Regardless I feel like he has to remain a starter. Hopkins has been super disappointing and I had hoped that he would have a good year but it seems he is really struggling. I know it’s probably just because Tennessee sucks more dick than Tiana Trump but still, I thought he would be viable. Last week you picked up Tank Dell and unfortunately sat him on your bench. But good news for you, he popped off again and is the number 1 target for waivers in many leagues. So, you got yourself a keeper there and I think his production is going to be pretty constant as the season goes on. You could use a little depth but overall, I think you still have a solid team who can definitely bounce back once Eckler stops posting videos about positivity on TikTok and gets his ass back on the field.

8. Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian):
Post Draft Change: +3
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 2-1

Very similar to Brins team, you are super boom or bust heavy. You do have a 2-1 but I feel that you have been bailed out twice and both those wins come from the Dolphins drafting and trading for players like they are preparing for the Olympic 4x4 rather than playing football. The difference with this team compared to Brin is that you actually have a pretty decent base. So even when these players don’t pop off, I still think this team is good enough to beat a handful of teams in this league. Though you are in for a little bit of a tough battle going forward since you just lost Mike Williams for the season. You have a handful of players on your bench who can replace him, but there is no way in hell they can fill in the clown shoes that he was wearing. Those are some massive shoes and you may struggle a bit going forward. I think I may also have you this low because I am genuinely disappointed in these players and I’m taking it out on you. TLaw was projected to be top 5, wtf happened to him. Josh Jacobs led the league in rushing yards last year, this year through 3 games he has a total of 108 yards. 15 players have run for over 108 yards this season in a SINGLE game. Etienne has far surpassed my expectations this year and been one of your most consistent pieces. Dotson is for sure being slept on but he is still a solid guy to have. Idk if I’d play him weekly but maybe he starts to do well as the season progresses. TJ Cockenson is doing exactly what I expected and is currently the overall TE1 so good on you for that pickup in the draft. Like I said before, the bench is kinda sketchy but maybe one of those guys pops off and can turn into someone that fills the role of Mike Williams as the season goes on. I personally think Shaheed could be that guy but with Derrick Carr hurt, I don’t think he has that same chemistry with Jamis Winston. Only one way to find out though so good luck with that.

7. Team Liz (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: -4
Record: 1-2

I talked your team up so much last week and then this week I am going to tear it down as you have taken a big ol’ dookie and may be a fraud who does not deserve top 3 in the league. I know it’s not sexy but Dak at QB is sufficient until Richardson comes back. Richardson is still in concussion protocol though and he may Tua 2.0 if he keeps being an idiot when running the ball, Regardless, he is the better option at QB on your team it’s just a waiting game for how long it takes until he returns. The RBs who I thought were so sexy last week, are kinda not that great anymore in my eyes. Aside from James Connor who belongs in the Salty Spitoon, Brain Robinson belongs in weenie Hut Jrs. And Hall and Johnson both belong in Super Weenie Hut Jrs. These guys all play for 3 of the worst 5 teams in the league and aren’t getting the usage they deserve because the team is always losing and has to pass the ball to make a comeback. The WRs on the other hand are pretty legit. Jefferson is legit the best WR in the league, who the fuck can put up 150 in every game??? I wouldn’t be surprised if he sets the record for most yards in a season this year. Waddle needs to hurry back too and get his concussion figured out because he is a top 15 guy when healthy as well. Had he played in this week’s gangbang against the Broncos, I guarantee he would have put up at least 35 points. Tee Higgens continues to be a rollercoaster of emotions and I am beginning to lean towards the side of him sucking. Watching the game, the other night, he dropped like 4 passes. I doubt that’s a normal occurrence, but kinda scary to have him in the weekly lineup if he continues to do that. Adam Thielen turned back the clocks and reverted to what he was in 2018 when he finished as a top 10 WR. Idk if this is going to continue or if it was a fluke, but I think he is definitely someone you want to keep an eye on as you go forward week to week. Again, you still have Tyler Boyd on your team who is serving you no purpose. Pick either him or Higgins, it is so dumb to have both of them as long as Jamar Chase exists. And one last thing, I know similarly to Maggie, you are using your little boy toy to help you with this fantasy league. Ask that mother fucker how his team is doing and if you have a better record than him, that’s embarrassing, do better, major red flag. You probably shouldn’t be taking advice from someone who is in last place in their own league. So, stop taking advice from the Sloth, from “The Goonies” and learn how to trade with others and make wavier wire pickups on your own. I personally can’t trade with anyone in this league because you all have to “consult” with another party who was probably an education major in college and can’t count higher than 69 without having to break out a calculator. I know you’ll show this to him and that basically ruins my chance of ever making a trade with you, but that was my TED Talk, thanks for coming.

6. Jockstraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 2-1

This may be due to spite since you bent me over and pegged me in our matchup, but there is no way in hell I am moving you above me in the rankings, I am fully convinced I should have won and no one can tell me different, except of course ESPN who scores it and clearly showed that you had a better team…for this week. Christian McDaddy is that guy and going to put up ridiculous numbers every week. The 49ers have shown that he is their number 1 back and they haven’t really used the backup at all. I don’t know if he can sustain that heavy of a workload for the duration of the season or if he is going to get hurt but for now, he is chewing bubble gum and kicking ass, and he’s all out of bubble gum. Mattison had a phenomenal week by his standards, however, that is likely going to tail off since they just traded for Cam Akers. To be honest, they are both kinda shit so going froward I think they’ll split the work and still suck so if each of them puts up 6 points a game, you’ll be lucky. AJ Brown showed up this week unlike last week which really helps but as I have said, he is very much a rollercoaster guy who is good one week and garbage the next. Still, you have to keep him in your starting lineup since he is pretty good. Not much to say about Olave, he’s good, but with a Derrick Carr injury, his status may fluctuate and he may lose some value until Carr returns. Regardless, he is still pretty solid and worth taking that risk since you don’t have many other options at WR. The bench is…curious.
