posts.title: Week 13
blocks: Week 13 Rankings

We are 13 weeks into the NFL season and this season full of twists and turns (mainly of ankles and elbows) is not disappointing me. My team, the Steelers on the other hand are, I genuinely cannot stand to watch another game. I know some of you don't feel that way seeing that your teams have been kicking ass, specifically the 49ers beating the brakes off of the fraudulent Eagles. This week we also saw a couple upsets with the Jaguars losing to a backup quarterback, however, I can't blame them too much because their start quarterback, Trevor Lawrence, also went down late in the game. This did lead to a riveting overtime period where we got to see not one, but TWO backup quarterbacks, that no one had ever heard of, dueling to the end in a sudden death situation. After all of that, it was the Bengals who managed to somehow squeak out a win. Another upset that happened was the Packers beat the Chiefs. It's always good to see Kansas City losing. They finally experienced what all the other teams in the league face when playing them and they had to play against the refs. There were a handful of blown calls, but none more egregious than the blatant pass interference at the end of the game. This did happen to follow an unnecessary roughness call where the defender hit the QB while he was still completely in bounds. Some may call it a makeup call, some may just say refs are blind, but one thing is for sure, the NFL needs to fire all these old geriatrics, roided out refs, who are clearly betting on the games. Similar to what’s happening in our league, the NFL playoff hunt is heating up, will your favorite team stay in? Or will they fall out like many of your fantasy team?

 

Diving into our league recap, first and foremost, I would like to extend a thank you for playing to Jessica Rice. She's the first player eliminated from playoff contention, your team will forever be remembered and we look forward to next year where hopefully you will have better luck. Now that we've had our moment of silence, let's look at the rest of the teams. By some miracle of God every single other team is still in playoff contention, while it may only be 1% for Becka and 6% for Liz, there's still some feasibility. I, myself, have managed to lock up a playoff spot and joined the ranks of Gabe and Adrian. Adrian has also managed to lock up a first round by which is huge, so congratulations on that. It's super exciting to see that the playoffs and this fantasy season will be determined by this last week, you can ask for a better last week that is going to be full of unbelievably crucial games. Now, Let's dive into the rankings and take a peek at who shit the bed this past week and who managed to somehow keep their playoff dream alive!

12. Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 5-8

You're the first team eliminated from the playoffs, so I'm sure you saw this coming, last place. Though technically you aren’t 100% eliminated, you just need to outscore every team this week by 200 points and have a Matte, Max, and Brin all lose. Totally feasible!!! Okay back to reality, while your team did play decent this past week, it wasn't enough. I know you can look back at it with 20/20 hindsight and say if I played Chuba you would have won. But overall, this whole season has just been pretty disappointing for you. Your first three draft picks in Eckler, Stevenson, and Smith all have not really played to what their expectations were this year. Smith has been the best of any of them, but he still hasn't been what you would have expected to see from your third-round pick, he was supposed to be your clear WR1 and carry your team. At the beginning of the year, I really liked this team, but none of these players turned out to be halfway decent. I think this team had a lot of upside and I was super hopeful for this team to be really good, but none of your players lived up to the hype. You made a lot of moves on the waivers this year, in fact the most in the whole league, so I applaud you for giving it 100%, especially even now that you're out of the playoffs, you're still trying to win which I have to smile and be proud of. I'm glad I seemed to have hooked you on this wonderfully addictive world of fantasy football and I’m excited to see where this goes next year. In all honesty (and reality), it can only go up from here!

11.  CeeDeez Nutz (Bekah)
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 5-8

Not that I expected a whole lot of reading of the power rankings to be done, but this team is struggling as expected. The only good thing is CeeDee Lamb. I think your unwavering devotion to the Seahawks is kinda screwing you over since you’re playing their defense and players who consistently suck. Unfortunately, your team is also facing some of the harder teams down the stretch and none of your players seem to have any good matchups. If you win this week, congratulations. But if you lose, you're for certain for the handcuffs.

10. Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 5-8

“Dear fav roommate, I am so proud of you for getting out of last place. You also had such good game sense to play the Colts over 49er defense even though you’re a 49er fan. James Conner absolutely killed it just like you absolutely do every week in flag football. Your chance of making the playoffs is super low, but I am shocked you weren’t the first eliminated.”

 

This is how this idiot thinks I should write her week 13 report. Let me pick some things apart, first, I am proud of you for turning this team around after your atrocious 1-6 start. Secondly, good job playing the Colts over 49ers even though you’re a 49ers *Bandwagoner* and you got that hot tip from the league commissioner (who always gets yelled at for offering his advice to other teams, but it’s fine when it’s your team I guess). Third, James Connor did slay, but you are not him, in flag football you played more like Johnu Smith (your TE) who had 2 catches for 10 yards and only put up 2.0 points. I would never in a million years draft you in fantasy. Overall, this was a solid year and I think had you not been one of the two teams that had over 1400 points scored against them, you might have had a better season. In fact, I took a little look and if you had Adrians schedule (he had the least points against) you would be 8-5 and rivaling me for 3rd place. Fantasy football sure can be a bitch sometimes, better luck next year (literally it’s 90% luck and 10% skill).

9. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: -4
Record: 6-7

Tough loss this last week, a lot of your players didn't show up and Pickett getting hurt really didn’t help either. This is the furthest down this team has been all year and as much as I would love to say it’s just one slip up, this team is on the verge of missing the playoffs. You’re gonna make me look dumb by saying you had the best team at the beginning of the year and then miss the playoffs. I should have expected that though, this team has been the team of under performers all year long. Lamar has been good, he's not been a top five guy that everyone expected. Bijan has done well as a rookie, but it looks like he's going to be the first rookie who's been drafted in the first round who's not going to finish as a top 10 running back. That is unbelievable for all the hype that he had coming into the year and especially since he is on the team that runs the ball the most out of any other team. Pacheco has been a stud for the most part, but he still fluctuates here and there. Amon- Ra has been one of the best WRs in the league, but your backup wide receivers in Scary Terry and Diontae have both been so trash. For being the WR1 on both their teams, Terry McLauren has only put up over 10 points five times. That is atrocious and I think it can be blamed on the fact that Washington is horrible, but for a guy you expected to be your consistent WR2 on your team, he was ass. Dionte as well has only put up more than 10 points 4 times this year. Granted, he was hurt for a majority of the year and he did have to deal with the atrocious Matt Canada offense, but I think the expectations were much higher for what they both did this year. You're sitting right on the outside of the playoffs and you're going to need some luck to get in. I would love to see you make the playoffs solely because I think this team is so inconsistent and would be an easy W compared to some of the other teams. You need some luck for sure, but you also need to win or else you're eliminated. You have a big week against Gabe and I'm rooting for you because if he loses, then I get the number two seed. If ever is the time this team is going to show up, be this week, give him hell!

8. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 6-7

This was a really unfortunate week for you, you put up 120 for the second straight week and caught a second straight L. Had you won both of those games and not been paired up against one of the high scorers, you would likely be locked in for the playoffs. It is what it is, I guess. If there's anything you can take away from this, it's that your overall points for have been going up, which has really allowed you to have some leeway in the standings. Following your trade, I'll be honest, I thought you got railed, but after this week I have to eat my words. Apparently, Brock Purdy can still play ball. He dropped 29 points this past week and Michael Pittman who you also traded for dropped 22. While that was the season high for both of them, you can't knock the trade because it seemed to work out. You'll definitely be needing it seeing that tank Dell went down this week with an injury and will be out for the rest of the year. You hate to see it, especially since he's been on a rampage recently. Again, 20/20 hindsight would have been great because I wanted Tank Dell last week and was willing to trade. Imagine, you could have had Kyler Murry and Nico Collins. But again, it is what it is. At this point, you’re in control of your own destiny this week. If you win, you're in, but if you lose, who knows what will happen. If anything, you need Max and Ryan to both have bad weeks. If those two struggle, even if you lose, you'll be fine. I'm excited for this team, but I'm also low-key terrified of this team. It seems to get better and better every week and having you miss the playoffs might be a relief for me.

7. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +7
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 5-8

Valiant effort, but I just want to ask you one thing... Who's your daddy? Say my name! Say it! I had a huge power trip this past week and I thought I knocked you out of the playoffs, but it seems that you still have a small chance. You have arguably three of the best running backs in the league on your team. Henry worries me a little bit, but it seems the Titans are finally using him the way he has been used in the past, which earned him the title “King Henry”. If they keep that up, you could be a very dangerous team going forward. Having Josh Allen also really helps, my only worry is your wide receiver situation. Pickens and Kupp are both good, but they have both been so up and down in these past couple weeks due to varying quarterback play and a lot of competition on their own teams for who gets the ball. I really like some of your guys on the bench for wide receiver, however they face the same issue and I don't know if any of them are more reliable than who you have starting now. I don't particularly want to see this team in the playoffs because, like I've been saying, it's really good and you've just had some really shitty luck this year. You have the most points against you by far and I can't help but wonder what your team would look like if you were in Adrian's position who has the least points against and is currently sitting in the number one seed……one can only wonder, except I actually looked into it and you would be 7-6. Still not the number one seed, but you would much more likely have the playoffs on lockdown. I wish you the best of this week, but it looks like you better start doing your research now for next year. If anything, I think this team can win the consolation bracket, so good luck to that.

6. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 6-7

It's crazy, this team has been so up and down over the past couple weeks. Interesting that now you're starting to take interest in your team after all season of not paying attention and playing the shitty guys. Somehow you got away with it and it looks like you’re very far cleared of last place. I know there's some backlash/irritation within the league about you auto drafting and hardly paying attention, yet you're still in a position to make the playoffs. I think it's hilarious, but this team is actually looking pretty dangerous now that the pieces are falling into place. You have arguably two of the best quarterbacks in the League right now in terms of fantasy. You have one of the most explosive running backs in Achane and you have absolute studs at wide receiver in both Mike Evans and DK Metcalf. Any one of those four players can easily put up 25 to 30 points on a good week and if they happen to have a good week at the same time, shit you don't even need to play the rest of your team. Those four alone can put up 120 points. Thank God, because the rest of your team sucks donkey dick. Rachad White is not very good at football, however he's been surprisingly decent and consistent at fantasy. My only suggestion is taking Jerry Judy out, he is the biggest bum in this whole league and he's been playing like trash all year. I think you can take a bet on someone who is on the injured reserve to probably score more points than him. I'll be honest, this team is pretty scary and I don't want you to make the playoffs because of how good some of these players are. You're going to need a lot of luck though if you do want to make the playoffs. Obviously winning is the first part but you also need two of the three between Brin, Matte, and Max to lose. Unfortunately, you're not going to beat anyone out on points because of the fact that everyone was hurt at the beginning of the season and also you had numerous weeks where you decided to omit playing players at all and instead went with someone who put up a big fat 0. Because of this, you have the third lowest points in the league, yet somehow there's still a chance and my gut is telling me I might be seeing you in the playoffs. Good luck this week, fight off the haters, also good to see you set your lineup by yourself this week.

5. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +4
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 6-7

I'll give props for props are due, you were the high scorer of the week and it was pretty impressive. That Brock Purdy trade seem to have worked out for you since you got Evan Engram and Jordan Love who both put up great numbers this past week. Garrett Wilson was super mid, but he's been like that all season. I think you and I had the same thought with wanting to trade for him (I was also in Brin’s ear trying to work a trade but she said my team was too good and she didn’t want to give me anyone else), if Aaron Rodgers does return, even if it is only for one week, Garrett Wilson turns into a top 10 receiver no doubt. Speaking of top 10 receivers, you have both Deebo and Jamar Chase who popped off this past week. They are rather terrifying and combined with Alvin Kamara, this squad is finally coming into place and looking like a legit contender. I hate to say it and I don't want to increase your ego, but this team scares the fuck out of me. All of your players are hitting their stride at the right time and they seem to all have favorable matchups for the playoffs in the next couple of weeks. Your destiny for the playoffs is in your own hand, if you win, you're in. You lose, you would need either Brin or Max to also lose for you to have the chance to make the playoffs. Regardless, I think you're still pretty set, and playing Liz this week definitely helps since her team blows more than the wind in a tornado. I'm genuinely terrified of this team and I hope for my own sake that you lose this week and miss the playoffs. I want a cakewalk to the championship, another contender is the last thing I need!

4. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 7-6

Congratulations, you're all but locked in for the playoffs. For you to miss the playoffs, you would have to put up maybe 30 points and lose, but I don't see that happening, especially not with CMC on your team. Also, AJ Brown is going to want a redemption week this upcoming week so the two of them combined will put up well over 30 points no doubt. I know you have had your struggles with quarterback recently, but I think you found a diamond in the rough in Jake Browning. I don't know why everyone has been sleeping on him and he's the backup, this man was arguably the best high school football player all time (he threw for 92 TDs in his Senior year, the most ever in the NFL is 55)  and one of the best college football players, but because he's not flashy no one wants him as their starter. I think he's going to continue to light up the scoreboard in Joey Bs absence. The rest of your team is just pretty solid all around. There aren't any stand outs, but everyone seems like they're going to put up at least 10 to 15 every week which of multiplied by 9, is 135. Not many teams are putting out more than that every single week and I think this team should only continue to roll. While your team has been solid, I think your special teams and kicker have really been stepping up recently and putting the team on their back. My two little sprinkles of knowledge to you are that since the Texans lost Tank Dell, I think that makes Noah brown all the more important and he's going to likely repeat one of the past weeks where he put up 20 points, he is almost a must start. Also, I have heard whispers that Najee Harris is not healthy and if that’s the case, Jaylen Warren takes all the snaps and probably puts up 15-20 points. Keep those in mind when you're trying to decide, who do you want to put in your flex. I don't really want to see this team in the playoffs since you have CMC and AJ Brown, but I don't think there's really much that's going to change that at this point. Fortunately for me, you're on the other side of the bracket so the next time I would be facing this team aside from this upcoming weekend is the championship. This weekend really doesn't mean a whole lot to either of us, but maybe I'll see you in the championship (I hope not)

3. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor)

Post Draft Change: +5

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 8-5

Not too much out of the ordinary going on here. Jalen hurts is still balling, Nico Collins is only going to get better now that Tank Dell is gone, and finally Justin Jefferson is making his return and hopefully making a difference on my team. I also have Adams who is a phenomenal receiver, however, he does worry me because he has been struggling recently. He does have a nice playoff stretch though so that'll be interesting to see where that goes. My running backs do scare the shit out of me and I need Jonathan Taylor to come back ASAP to calm my nerves a little bit. No worries though, I locked up a playoff spot and with a little luck can lock up the number two seed this week. That's asking a lot though, better not get greedy. Buckle down and get ready for the playoffs baby because shit's about to go wild.

2. Herbalicious (Gabe)

Post Draft Change: +8

Weekly Change: -1

Record: 9-4

2 weeks in a row putting up under 90 and 2 weeks in a row of losses, what's going on Big Guy? I thought this was the dream team? This team started off so hot, but is it falling apart in the final stretch of the season? Are you worried that you're going to lose not just your second seed, but also in the first round? You hate to see it, but this team's trending in the wrong direction. Herbert has been very underwhelming recently which translate to Keenan Allen also putting up poor numbers. Swift has been so sketchy all year long, but he's probably due for a good game in these next few weeks. Although he does play Dallas this upcoming week, which might be tough, he plays some super soft defenses in the playoffs. So, if you can manage to make it that far, you should be set. Surprisingly, Mixon is the one that's been carrying this team. I don't think he's very good at football, but he's been doing surprisingly well at running back in terms of fantasy. I think he's definitely benefiting from Joe Burrrrrr being out and I only see this role continuing to grow. Aiyuk is still one of the best wide receivers, however, when Deebo has his good weeks, Aiyuk struggles. I still think he's a solid receiver, but he's definitely going to be hit or miss depending on what Brock Purdy is feeling that day and which receiver he likes the most. I think if anything, you're still fine and Stefon Diggs will be back this week, so hopefully that will add a little bit more consistency to this team. Maybe for the first time in a few weeks you can actually have a defense put up more than five points. But then again, I want to see you lose, so maybe you should play the Chiefs against the bills. If nothing changes, it looks like you and I are trending towards playing each other, so I'll save my shit talking for then.

P.S. “Ur mom’s a bitch” -Liz

1.Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian)

Post Draft Change: +10

Weekly Change: +1

Record: 10-3

I'll start things off nicely by saying congratulations on securing a first round by. Also, congratulations on beating Gabe and locking up the top seed in the league and the top spot among my rankings. While it was a nice win, his team also played like shit and had his worst game of the season so I can't give you too much credit. Now onto my favorite thing, making fun of your team. This is the biggest boom or bust team I have ever seen and I think you're going to get exposed in the playoffs. Tyreek Hill is literally the only player who consistently puts up good numbers. However, it seems like every once in a while, someone else puts up a good game to add to Tyreek’s dominance while the rest of your team does nothing. You do benefit from the fact that your team has had the least points scored against all year so you have had some luck in playing shitty teams, or just playing them when they have a bad week. Trevor Lawrence going down is going to significantly hurt you seeing that there aren't many good quarterbacks to pick from. However, if there is one player that is going to benefit from this, it's Travis Etienne. With the quarterback down, the running game should reign supreme and he should see a heavy workload next week. I would like to talk shit on Christian Watson and Sam LaPorta for both having their best week of the year, but I think either one of them could easily replicate that this upcoming week against both the Giants and Bears who have defenses worse than the Greeks who let in a massive horse that obviously had Trojans who were waiting to slaughter all their people. Despite all my complaints about how this team sucks, you have blocked out the haters and secured yourself a first round by and likely the number one overall seed seeing that you're playing Jess this week, who I doubt will give you too much trouble. Congratulations on winning the 14-week championship, but the real shit starts now, buckle in because I doubt you'll have any more cupcakes following this week.

posts.title: Week 14
blocks: Week 14 Rankings

NFL week 14 is complete. There were a lot of good games this week, a couple upsets, and a couple games that left me a little upset. Mainly, the Steelers losing to the Patriots. This is the first time in history that a team has lost back-to-back games against two teams that are eight or more games below .500 isn’t that just a wonderful record to hold in the history books? Another absolute shitter of a game was the Vikings versus the Raiders, this game was accompanied by 19 punts, three turnovers, and one field goal which of course, were the only points of the whole game. This was absolutely atrocious football. I wish I could say it was a great defensive standoff, however, t's not like either of these teams have a good defense, they're just horrible on offense and it showed. Now on to the good games, first, I have to acknowledge the Seahawks versus the 49ers was surprisingly entertaining, it brought a lot of drama and even a fight, which is always exciting to see as a fan. Following the game, everyone seems to love to run the narrative that DK Metcalf is to blame for the fight, however, Fred Warner had the dirtiest hit of all time on him and deserved what came to him. Another phenomenal game was the Ravens versus Rams. This game ended up going to overtime and the Ravens won on a walk-off 95 Yd punt return. You hardly ever see this and I’m sure Raven fans everywhere had to be jumping out of their seats. With this win and other teams losing, the Ravens have jumped into first place in the AFC. There were two or three upset games this week, depending on how you look at it. First, the Cowboys smacked the shit out of the eagles, I don't know if this was expected, but they looked like they owned them and it wasn't even close. Really makes you wonder if the birds are actual contenders or if they're fraudulent against good teams seeing that for the second week in a row they lost to another contender. The Dolphins vs. Titans game was also surprisingly close and we saw a team that looked unstoppable (the Dolphins) choke a two-score lead in the fourth quarter with only 3 minutes left to one of the worst offenses in the League. Will Levis did play his ass off, but I don't think anyone saw this coming. Then my favorite game of the week was the Bills vs. Chiefs rematch. The bills ended up winning due to an offsides call where the Chiefs had scored a touchdown. All of the Chiefs players were fuming mad that he was called offsides, but you can't blame the refs for making a correct call. The best part for me was getting to see pussy Pat Mahomo argue and complain about reffing when his whole career has been made because of poor reffing and missed calls. If we want to go down that rabbit hole, we can look at the Super bowl last year as well as numerous games this year where there have been many questionable calls that have gone in their favor. If he wants to get technical about reffing, they should be down a Superbowl and would probably have another two or three losses on the season and barely be over 0.500.

 

In our little world of fantasy, it was an exciting week until the very last snap! We have finally got the playoffs all figured out. It was a riveting finish and super exciting to not only see who made it and who missed it, but also the last place teams were all coming down to the wire to determine who would be handcuffed to each other. Spoiler alert, Jess and Liz finished in last place. Thus, they will be the ones who will be handcuffed to each other when we all decide to go out and celebrate. Congratulations to Haley, Matte and Brin who all punched their playoff ticket this week. To all those who missed the playoffs, good try this year, get em’ next year, there's a lot of luck involved and it seems you all feel a little bit short and some (not all) can be attributed to just sheer bad luck. This will for sure be the easiest power ranking for me because it's the end of the season and these ranks are final. Good luck in the playoffs. I'll do one final recap at the end!

12. Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 5-9

Hey, I guess it wasn't your year. To be fair though, this was your first year and you had a lot of injuries and bad luck go against you all year. Your team looked good from the start, however, none of them seem to perform. You had the least amount of points scored in the whole league, but you always had a fiery spirit and never missed a game. Even if you were down 50 you still thought you had a chance which I admire. Looking at your week 1 to your week 14 lineup, you only have three players who remained the same throughout the season, those being Austin Eckler, DeVonte Smith, and your kicker, Dustin Hopkins. You still had a lot of the same players; however, it seems you lost faith or they got injured and they did not deserve a start in the final week. That's a shame too because had you played DeAndre Hopkins, you probably would have won your matchup. Not that it matters though because you still would have been in the bottom two. I also think it's funny how you got on Maggie's ass for not playing a tight end for a couple games, yet in the last game of the year, you did the exact same thing... Interesting, almost as if you were throwing your game and trying to ruin the integrity of the league. Regardless, great effort this year, I think I'll be hilarious to see you handcuffed to Liz for a handful of hours, but then again maybe I don't want that since Liz actually has a pretty decent chance of going home with you.

11. Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -9
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 5-9

Tough year to be you, expectations were unbelievably high, especially since you had the first pick in the draft, but it seems that even that can't save you from bad luck. You have the second most points scored against you in the league and the next closest person to you was about 100 off so it wasn't really even that close. Not only did you have bad luck in that department, it seems like your whole team managed to get hurt at some point throughout the season. Looking at your week 1 roster, James Connor was out for a handful of weeks, Justin Jefferson is still hurt, Pat Friermuth was out for a while, Brian Robinson was gone a couple games, your quarterback Anthony Richardson got hurt early and missed most of the season, and Breece Hall also missed a couple games. Those are only your crucial guys too, there were a handful of other role players who missed a bunch of games that I didn't think were worth mentioning. You legit had the most injury prone team and I think that’s one of the main reasons you ended up in the second to last place slot. I really thought this was a solid team and if you hadn't had such shitty luck with who you're playing and injuries, I wholeheartedly believe you would have been in the playoffs. It is what it is, hopefully next year you managed to draft better and find a little more luck throughout the year. Regardless, you being handcuffed to Jess is going to be the highlight of my season. I think you two will be a menace together, but at the same time it'll be funny. Just don't get any ideas, the punishment was only to joke about getting a threesome with someone, you better not actually take my girlfriend home with you.

10. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +2
Weekly Change: -3
Record: 5-9

You my friend had a very solid team; however, you seem to have been on the receiving end of a long +8-inch shaft every single week. You had the most points scored against you by just shy of 100 points to the next person (Liz) and then the next closest person behind that was also about 100 points away. Excluding you, the average points against for the league was 1,408.71 and if you do some simple subtraction, you were 230.83 points above average. It's hard to win in a situation like that, no matter how good your team is. It sucks because you had the six most points scored for your team, and that was factoring in a bunch of injuries as well. Cooper Kupp was out for the first half the season and even when he did come back, he wasn't all that great, Kyren Williams who finished as the 7th overall running back, missed five games in the middle of the year, it’s hard to think that had he not missed those games and actually played, he probably would have finished as a top three RB on the season. David Montgomery who was also a stud for you missed a handful of games and then there was just very poor utilization of Derrick Henry for the first half of the year. I think this is a great team and I would pick this exact same team next year and be confident that you could finish top three. I'm glad you joined our league and I'm glad I was able to kick your ass, hopefully this consumed all of your time and your addicted, can't wait for next year! Pussy <3

9. CeeDeez Nutz (Bekah)
Post Draft Change: -2
Weekly Change: +2
Record: 6-8

Not a bad season but also not a good one. At the beginning of the year, you had two of the best wide receivers as well as two of the best quarterbacks, while that's all good and dandy that doesn't really do you shit when you have zero running backs who were relevant this year and can only play one QB at a time. I think some trades could have helped and you could have probably done better, but you did have the second least points scored for your team, so in reality this wasn't all that great, you just got lucky with 6 matchups this year where the average score in those games was 86 points. The league average points per game was 102 so every game you won, you were 16 points under the average which I would say is pretty good luck for you.

8.  CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 6-8

For Little Miss Auto draft, I'm so happy that this is where your team ended. I would have loved to see you in last place, but 8th place and missing the playoff will have to do. This honestly turned out to be a pretty decent team. You have two of the best quarterbacks in the league in terms of fantasy as well as the most explosive running back. Your wide receivers were solid but very much hit or miss and boy did they miss a lot this year. I think if you would have paid a little bit more attention this year, this could have been a lot better of a team, but overall, this was a pretty solid season for you. I would love to kick your ass next year again, but I don't know if the whole league would love that. There were certain complaints of losing to a team that auto drafted as well as hardly set their lineup, it seemed you were hardly trying yet winning which is a tough pill to swallow for those who continuously lost to you. I thought it was funny, but certain people were frustrated due to you having a bunch of solid players and not even playing them lol. Overall, I think this is a solid year for you and you finished right about where I had expected.

7. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -6
Weekly Change: +2
Record: 7-7

This was a very disappointing season for you. As I'm sure you're aware, I had this team as the best team in the League post draft. I didn't think there was a way you could possibly lose. You had one of the best quarterbacks, two stud running backs and two stud wide receivers as well as a solid tight end. Even on your bench, you had another solid running back and wide receiver who could both fill in for flex or during a bye week. Unfortunately, it seems none of these guys actually played to their potential or what I had expected. Bijan Robinson was good, but definitely didn't live up to the hype that was put on him. Aaron Jones had a complete flop of a year as well as Dionte Johnson happened to be injured for half the year. The only two players that were consistent on this team were Isaiah Pacheco and Amon-Ra the sun god, without those two, this team might even have been lower in the standings. Although Lamar did finish fourth overall in terms of fantasy QB, he hardly had the explosive games that we both anticipated. He had two games over 30 points and only four others over 20. This is very solid but for a guy that you expected to lead your team, it's not all that great. Get em’ next year I guess and hopefully you can have a mediocre draft and turn into a playoff team rather than having the best draft and falling short of the playoffs.

6. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: 0
Weekly Change: +2
Record: 7-7

Congratulations Girly Pop, you made the last spot in the playoffs. Last week was a huge win and putting up 140 points secured that spot. This team has for sure had it struggles. Looking back at your day one roster you had Joe Burrow (who got hurt), Najee Harris and Saquon Barkley who were both mediocre at best all year long, and Garrett Wilson and DJ Moore as your two starting wide receivers. DJ Moore absolutely balled out this year and Garrett Wilson was unbelievably underwhelming. Your guy Cortland Sutton has had a great year as well and was perhaps the most consistent person on this team. On your bench too, you had Raheem Mostert as well as Devon Achane. These two Miami running backs finished as two of the best across the board this season. Unfortunately, you dropped Achane, but keeping Mostert was the best thing for this team as he finished as the RB2 on the year. Looking at your team now, I'm terrified to play you this week for the first round of the playoffs. I think any one of your players could put up 40 points and ruined my chances of even getting a whiff of winning my money back. If you do happen to beat me though, I'll be rooting for you since I would love to see you in the championship and I would hate to have to hear Gabe talk about how he won the fantasy playoffs for the rest of the time I live here (especially after he did some shady shit). Overall. great season, but jobs not done yet. I'll see you this week and hopefully I'll be able to give you these hands, there's no more easy wins from here on out.

5. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +4
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 7-7

Congrats on locking up the five seed in the playoffs. As much as I didn't want you to be in the playoffs, I guess this was deserved. You have a really good team and I am so glad that you are on the opposite side of the bracket compared to me. If I do have to end up facing this team, it will only be in the championship so at least at that point I would be getting my money back. Your team is full of studs, you have Kamara, Ford, and now Kenneth Walker is coming back, so three solid running backs. Then on top of that you have Chase, Deebo, Wilson, and Ridley who are all super dangerous and could easily put up 20 plus points every single week. Then on top of that you have Evan Engram who has been going absolutely ape at these past few weeks. I think your weakest spot is quarterback, but even at that Jordan Love isn’t all that bad. Worst case scenario, the rest of these guys can all make up for where Love slacks. Overall, this is looking like a pretty tough team to beat and I think that Haley is going to have some trouble this weekend unless they all shit the bed like they did a couple weeks ago when they only put up 56 points. Good luck going forward. I hope I don't encounter this team again, but if I do, suck my Gooch, I’ll dick you down like I did last time we played.

4. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 8-6

What a year you have had, I think we've known that you've been playoff bound for the past couple weeks, but it must feel good that finally lock that in, especially in the four seed. This is a really solid team and I like the looks of it going into the playoffs. Obviously, you have the touchdown machine CMC as well as AJ Brown who has been a little lackluster recently, but still one of the best wide receivers in the league. You've made the best out of a bad situation of losing your quarterback and I think Jake Browning is a great pickup who shows some real promise. This team certainly had its ups and downs and even though you had the third most points scored against you, you managed to be the fourth highest scoring team which really balanced that out and got you to where you were. I think you have a really tough matchup this week against Matte, but whoever ends up winning this week, I wouldn't be surprised if you won next week against Adrian and made it to the finals. I'm glad you're on the other side of the bracket compared to me and the next time I would see you would be in the championship or perhaps the loser's bracket, but let's not talk about that. Regardless, good luck this next week, you're going to need it. Catch you in the championship?

3. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor)

Post Draft Change: +5

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 8-6

Bitch I'm a dog WOOF! I'm just built different; this team is unbelievable. I put up the second most points in the league and clearly have one of the best teams if not the best. Things have been a little crazy recently and I've had some injuries/ bad play, but I think the only thing I can do now is cross my fingers and hope that these guys put out this upcoming week. I ended up with a top 10 player in pretty much every position which really just only goes to show that I'm the goat of drafting and trading. If I don't win this week, I'm going to kill myself. In my suicide note I’m going to blame Liz specifically just because the fuck Liz, she’s a dirty cheater. If I do win though, maybe I'll throw her like a dollar for pity.

2. Herbalicious (Gabe)

Post Draft Change: +8

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 9-5

This for sure was the hottest team in the League the first 10 weeks of the season, however, there's definitely a little room for concern right now. You're down a quarterback (this was written pre-shady trade), your best wide receiver is hurt, and you're running backs have been very lackluster. I think this team might be in trouble in the upcoming weeks, but you don't have to worry about that this week since you have a bye. Overall, this is a solid year and you did put up the third most points scored in the total league, so I guess you do deserve this number two spot. I should probably apologize a little bit because I had this as one of the worst teams coming out of the draft but I was proved wrong and we can only see where it goes from here. Good luck in the playoffs, enjoy the bye, you need it.

1.Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian)

Post Draft Change: +10

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 11-3

Mr. First place, not too shabby. You did put up the most points in the league, which I guess you do deserve the number one overall seed, BUT you also had the least point scored against you this whole year by about 60 points. So, while your team was putting out, you just happened to have every other team play poorly every single time they played you. While I can be salty about that, I can't be salty about how well your players have played. Tyreek Hill has been arguably the best there in the league and in my opinion deserves to win the MVP. A couple of recent injuries have definitely thrown a little bit of a wrench into your plan, but I think overall this team is fine and I don't really see you struggling too much. I think a bye week will be really nice for you, but as soon as you have to play again in a week, you're going to have one of the toughest matchups in the league against either Matte or Haley who have both been balling out recently. Enjoy it while you can, but shit's about to get real in the next week or so. I doubt I'll be seeing this team again, but if I do it'll most likely be for the championship.

posts.title: 2024 Post Draft Rankings
blocks: Post Draft Rankings

Welcome back to fantasy football 2024! For those returning, glad to have you back, I can't wait to make you all my bitches again. And for the newcomers, that previous sentence was something we call a joke, I love all the people in this league and cherish each and every one of them. I am exited to begin this year on the right foot and actually have a league full of people I like!

 

However, it seems this year it will not be a 12-person league, in fact some of you have taken a page out of Drake's book (no I'm not talking about leaking a video on you playing with your gargantuan dong) and you have gotten some ghost writers, or should I say ghost managers. Let’s clear the air here and now so that we have a place to direct our anger and we don’t lash out on someone who is simply a vehicle for their ghost writers poor decisions. Below is the manager in our league as well as their exposed ghost writer. I had Drake's buddy Kendrick Lamar do the digging, so you can be certain that this info is accurate

 

Maggie - Codename: Margarine Butter                Ghost Manager: Bf Brody – Codename: Brodizzle         

Brin – Codename: Brian Vandepump                   Ghose Manager: Her cousin – Codename: Cuzzo X

Liz – Codename: Lizzo                                          Ghost Manager: Her revolving door of men - Codename: Mike, Matt, Tim, etc.

Jess- Codename: Jessie                                       Ghost Manager: Her chill af bf – Codename: Douchebag

Molly – Codename: Molly                                      Ghost Manager: Sleeper.com - Codename: Ur dead to me 

Matte- Codename: Motts Apple Sauce                  Ghost Manager: This mf has inside info I swear - Codename: Skete Carroll

Trevor – Codename: TT                                         Ghost Manager: His Sister, can’t blame me if I lose - Codename: The lesser twin

 

With that out of the way, lets take a look at who drafted who and give my expert, totally unbiased opinions on where I think these teams rank going into the season.
12. Baby Choda (Brendan)

I hate to do it, but someone had to have the worst team here. If it makes you feel any better, it was a toss up between you and the team in front, I just think they have slightly more depth and the QB wide receiver stack they have going in the only thing that saved them from being in this spot and not you. Regardless, you would have ended up down the bottom two no matter what. If it makes you feel any better, ESPN has you ranked at 11, so that’s gotta be a win, right? I guess the silver lining is it makes for a good underdog story, and you can laugh in my face when you go 3-3 on your fantasy football championships. Anyways, lets take a look at why I have you all the way down here at the bottom of my power rankings.

​

Starting from the top, you must be confused because you have arguably the best fantasy QB. I agree! However, the team starts to fall apart once I continue to check out who else is on the team. Your RB1 is Derrick Henry, King Henry. I think this is a great pick and he’s going to ball out on a stacked Baltimore team. I do worry a little because he is turning 30 this year and generally that’s a dangerous ago for RBs. However, he is a freak of nature and I think if anyone can combat father time, it’s him. He may lose some touches and goal line work to Lamar, but overall, solid pick. Mostert on the other hand is one that I am not very high on. He is 32 years old and he is unlikely to beat father time. Last year he did so well because the Dolphins were unbelievable explosive and he scored 21 TDs. What a phenomenal year, the only issue is I don’t think he will have a repeat of his best season at the age of 32, plus they now have Achane who is in his second year and much more reliable, quick, and overall better. The only shot Mostert has is that they share a lot of the work and hopefully they’ll be winning a lot of games, so he’ll get a lot of garbage time touches.

 

On to WRs, I think they are both mid as hell. Deebo is a good receiver, but as long as Aiyuk, McCaffery, and Kittle are there, there are too many mouths to feed for him to consistently pop off. I think Kittle is a great addition to your team too but the two of them will seldom score more than 20 points combined. Ridley is also a guy I have little to no faith in. He did okay in Atlanta a few years back, got suspended, went to Tennessee, sucked dick, and now I’m supposed to believe he’s going to have a great year since he is Jacksonville with T-Law? I just don’t buy it. He has to compete for targets with a handful of younger guys and I just don’t see him having a great season all around. Expect maybe 10 points max from him every week. Sutton on the other hand is a guy I like a lot. He had a phenomenal year last year with and aging Russel Wilson and I think Bo Nix is a huge upgrade. I could see him breaking the top 15 WRs since there aren’t that many other options on that team.

 

Final part of this is your bench. MR. PRESIDENT, A SECOND KICKER HAS HIT THE TOWERS!!! I’m not here to judge, but actually, I am, wtf are you doing with 2 kickers on your team??? Unless Nick Folk is the second coming of Mark Moseley (the kicker who won the NFL MVP in 1982), there is no reason to have him on your team and not someone else. Outside of Jerry Jeudy and MAYBE Adam Thielen, I don’t see any of these guys staying on your bench long term. None of them are going to have a large roll on their team and I feel like after a week or 2 there will be much better options emerging on the wavier wire than bum ass Alexander Mattison or Chubba Hubbard.

 

Overall, this team is likely going to go through a major makeover in the next couple weeks and I look forward to seeing how you spend you free agent money, that’s going to make or break this team. Goodluck, I look forward to seeing this team rise the ranks and make me eat my words.
11: Saquon My Balls (Gabe)

A familiar place for you on my power rankings, last year I had you near the bottom and you proved me wrong by winning a fuckload in a row. Let’s see if you can run it back and do the same thing this year. If there is 1 win, I can congratulate you on, it’s that you have a team name that isn’t team team team.

 

I think this team has a lot of potential, but it also has a lot of players who I think can flop. Obviously, the raining MVP is a great snag by you, but that’s about the only sure thing on this team. Saquon is on a new team, and while it is the eagles, you never know how they’ll utilize him. I think losing Jason Kelce, that O-line regresses a little, but honestly not that much. Also, Jalen hurts and the tush push was a hit last season, but without Kelce that might not become so much of an option. Why risk your QB getting injured when you can give it to Quadzilla in the backfield and let him either plow it up the middle or break some ankles. He’ll probably ball out, but I just worry a little because of the mobile QB and other studs on this offense who may take away from his workload. Montgomery as well is another guy I have my hesitations about. He played well last year but that was because the lions had a rookie that they were still exposing to the NFL. Montgomery was the lead back last year, but I don’t believe that is the case this year. He’ll still get some good touches and have solid goal line work behind arguably the best O-line in the NFL, but that’s his limit. He isn’t the pass catcher on this team, he isn’t the explosive guy, he’s the 3rd down role player who is gonna give Gibbs a chance to catch his breath on the sideline and then switch right back out.

 

Looking at the WRs on this team, this is my biggest hesitation. I do like that you have the Lamar/Flowers stack, but I just don’t know if Flowers is that guy. I think Derrick Henry going to the Ravens helps because teams are going to have to crowd the box and leave the WR’s a little more open, but I haven’t seen enough from Flowers to convince me that he is the main guy in this offense. Every team is going to put their best CB on Flowers and I think the best pass catcher on this offense is Mark Andrews. Not to say he’s not good, but I thought that was a little early to take him in the 5th round. Waddle is a little better, but he faces the issue that he isn’t the main guy on his team. Sure, Tyreek is going to take some focus from the defense, but Waddle is unlikely to become an alpha and dominate targets. His only balls are going to come when Tyreek is completely covered (which isn’t often). He can still produce, but I don’t think he’s going to be consistent at all. Your final WR is Tank Dell. I like him but similar to Waddle, he isn’t the go-to guy on his team. They have 2 other WRs who are known for dominating targets. Fortunately, Dell is known for the deep ball so if he is getting the ball, it is likely going to net you at least 3 to 4 points every single catch. I just don’t see consistency there, but then again who knows, that Texans offense is going to be lethal. Obviously, CJ Stroud can produce tw0 1,000-yard receivers, but idk if he can do three. I do like the TE option, with Diggs out and a rookie WR in as well as a few new guys that came from other teams, Kincade is the only piece Josh Allen has that he is familiar with. This will for sure play in his favor and I expect Kincade to be a top 3 TE.  

 

The bench is the last thing I’ll critique here. I think it’s alright. Ford is a great addition, but the rest are likely to be on the waivers in the coming weeks. Addison is good and had a great year last year, but he is dealing with a possible suspension as well as losing a good QB, he’ll now have Bradford who as we know, isn’t good. The only other player on this bench that I think is valuable, outside Cousins, is maybe Chig Okonkwo. He has sneaky potential and with a second year QB in will Levis, I think he becomes a favorite check down target and could produce.
10: Jockstraps (Haley)

I had a tough time placing these teams in the middle/back of the field. There was a clear top 4 or 5 but after that, 6-10 were all a blur and they are all so close to each other. You could be 10th this week and 6th the next, who knows. Though, I do think this is the worst of the mid-tier teams, but just barely.

​

You have Joe Shiesty, so if this team was built off sex appeal, you’d be first, however it is built off talent. He has that, but he also has injury history, and he isn’t mobile like the other guys in the NFL, so he loses some points there. PLUS, he may be missing his number 1 receiver to contract disputes so who knows how he does at the start of the season. Your RB room is what scares me the most on this team. I know you’re super high on Josh Jacob Jingle Heimer Schmit, but I am not. He’s getting old and he’s going to be splitting work in a GB offense that is very pass heavy. He should be alright this year, but I doubt he’ll be a top 10 guy at the end of the season. Zamir White too is a guy I have no faith in. He is on a shitty team that is likely going to lose a lot of games and not run the ball a whole lot due to that. Fortunately, he has Garner Minshew, the moustache god, as a QB so defenses will have to respect the run a little more than they usually do, but it still isn’t something I would count on.

​

Your WR core is probably the strongest aspect of this team. Hill should be a top 3 WR if not the best in the league. He was on pace to break the single season receiving yard record last year, but the dolphins were pumping the breaks and sitting him in the 4th quarter of games because they were often blowing teams out and there was no need to risk injury. This year I think he balls and breaks that record and not by like 50 yards. I wouldn’t be surprised if he had close to 2,500 yards this season. Diggs as well is a dawg, but I do worry about him on this new team. He is still the same alpha WR he has always been, however, there are now 3 other monsters on that offense that will challenge him for targets. He should be good, but I wouldn’t be too shocked to see him have 1 or 2 games of 15 points followed by 1 or 2 games of 5 points. I just worry that there are too many mouths to feed, and his points will be more volatile than the stock market under sleepy Joe. Aiyuk has a very similar problem to Diggs, he isn’t the number one guy on his team, plus he might not even be a 49er for long. If he does get traded, his value likely goes down. The teams he is in talks with are the Patriots, Browns, and Steelers. While they may be decent, none of them have the offense that the 49ers do, and his production will likely tank. If I were you, I’d wait for him to have 1 or 2 good games in a row and then trade him away to some sorry sucker for a fat price tag. I also really like the pickup of Kyle Pitts. He has been the laughingstock of TEs for the past 3 years, but now that he has a competent QB and offensive coordinator, I think he is gonna have a great year. He was a freak of nature coming out of college and Kirk Cousins is known for throwing a lot to TEs, so I think this is the perfect situation for him.

​

My last point of contention with this team is the bench. It’s honestly not terrible, I think it’s just not great either. I like Zeke, Allgeier, Palmer, and Kmet. They can all have a roll on their team, but I just don’t know how big it’ll be going into the future. Kmet is a good TE but with 3-star WRs I don’t see him having the breakout season among them. Palmer is on one of the best passing offenses, but I am unsure who the #1 WR is going to be in that locker room. Palmer is the most experienced and has the most chemistry with Herbert, but he was relying on Keenan Allen to distract the defenses last year and he was capitalizing off that. With Allen there no more, I am unsure who takes over. Allgeier and Zeke are in similar situations where they are both kinda backups or goal line backs? I really don’t know what their usage will be on their respective teams, but they are worth keeping around for a few weeks to find out.
9: San Diego 69ers (Liz)

For someone who had the first overall pick, you kinda fumbled the bag here. The team isn’t trash, thus, you’re not at the very bottom of the list, but for getting the best player in the draft, I just thought this would be a super team. You have 3.5 players I like in the starting lineup, but the bench is abysmal.

 

First thing I notice is the QB, CJ Stroud. He’s solid and I think with the new weapons he has on offense; he is going to ball out. I think this is a solid pick BUT I think you wasted a QB pick way too early. He is going to throw the ball a lot, but he doesn’t have the mobile upside as much as other QBs going in this range. For example, there is Lamar, Richardson, Hurts, who I’m sure were all taken, but it feels like you saw QBs going and just ripped the next best thing. I will stop harping on this pick because he is going to be good, but me personally, I would have waited a little longer and grabbed a better role player. RBs obviously will be carried by CMC, he’s going to ball out as always, but I think Joe Mixon is a little worrisome. The Texans are not a team known for running and even though Mixon had a great year last year, I don’t see that repeating. Especially on the Texans team where they have 3 dominant WRs and a super solid TE, he is less of a priority than he was in Cincy, and I think he’s going to struggle a little. He’ll probably be top 20 but not anything to write home about. Not that it matters tho because CMC literally puts up enough points for 2 RBs so in all honesty, it probably evens out fine.

 

Your WR room is a little scary in my opinion. I think the best pick here was Cooper Kupp, people are quick to forget that he was the best WR in the league prior to getting hurt. Sure, he has a little more competition with a young Puka Nacua on the team, but Matt Stafford is still the same gunslinger he has always been and both of them can eat on this team. Olave worries me because he plays for the Saints. They are likely going to be playing a lot of close games which usually means decent passing opportunities; however, he has Derek Carr throwing to him. Carr is getting old and is the QB that does the most checkdowns to his RBs. This doesn’t bode well for Olave who is a monster over the top. I’m sure he will still get some good usage, but I just don’t see him being that start you are looking for when you draft someone in the 2nd round. Keenan Allen also is a guy with some concerns. Age being number 1, he is 32 years old which is basically a boomer in the NFL. He is also going from one of the most pass heavy offenses in the league to one that ranks in the middle. Sure, they have a new rookie QB who looks REALLY good, but he also has a lot more competition. In LA his only competition was Mike Williams who is the king of injuries and Quinten Johnson who literally has bricks for hands, the guy couldn’t catch a cold in a blizzard. He goes from that to Chicago where DJ Moore is coming off the best season, they just added a rookie WR that they drafted in the top 10 picks in the NFL draft, and they also have a solid TE in Cole Kmet. I’m sure Allen will be alright, but there’s just too many mouths to feed for me to be confident that he is going to have a similar season to last year. I fuck with the TE pick though. I truly think he is going to have a breakout year in this Dallas offense. They did nothing to address their WR concerns and outside of CeeDee Lamb, there aren’t many other options for places to throw the ball. Ferguson is one of Daks favorite targets in the redzone, so I expect he is going to rack up a lot of TDs this year.

 

Now my favorite part of this review, your bench! I know you don’t know half of these guys and you were likely just picking them because you needed some backups, but I know every single one and am going to love to tell you why each and every one of them is ass as if you should have known this before drafting them. Singletary literally was balls in Texas last year, there were games where he would have 5 or 6 rush attempts and still be at 0 total yards. I know I give you shit for being slow, but I think even you could get 1 yard in an NFL game. You might snap in half the second one of those guys would hit you, but I believe that the half of your body holding that football would fall forwards to get 1 yard. He is in an ideal situation though; he just joined the Giants who no longer have Saquon. The RB room is wide open, but I have very little faith in him to produce. Pat Freiermuth is the other pick who I kinda agree with on this bench. He is one of the few players on the Steelers to eclipse 50 targets last year so while he doesn’t do great, he is a consistent option on that offense. They do have a new offensive coordinator who hates using TEs, but he might be worth keeping around. Okay now for the speed round! Moone, never was all that good in Chicago, in Atlanta he is the 2nd or 3rd option, I don’t think he’ll be great but lowkey if anyone makes me eat my words its him. Douglas plays for the Patriots who suck…. enough said (I did hear decent things coming out of training camp about him tho so keep an eye on him). Ty Chandler literally sucks more dick that a flesh light in a frat house, I have nothing positive to say about him. Marvin Mims, Denver is not great and of all their WRs, I think he is 3rd or 4th in line so I doubt he’ll be good. And then last but not least, you really wanted to make a statement here with choosing Deshaun Watson. He sexually assaulted 24 women and here you are encouraging that by drafting him. I am honestly disgusted with this pick, and I think just for that I might have to revoke your first round draft pick.

 

Overall, this team is just mid in my eyes. They have good players, but I think they are all touchdown dependent.
