I think the addition of Amari Cooper really helps this team out. Obviously, your players are going to have a bye week in the very near future, and I think trusting in Amari Cooper on the Buffalo Bills is a lot safer than W’andell Robinson for a shitty, inconsistent Giants team. Sure, Robinson has had his weeks of stardom, but they are few and far between. Don't get discouraged by Cooper's poor performance these first two weeks in Buffalo, he's still learning the playbook and I think within the next two weeks, once he figures it out, he will quickly become Josh Allen's favorite Target and put up some solid fantasy numbers. The only thing about Cooper that worries me is that he has some of the most drops in the league. But who can blame the guy, you'd probably be dropping balls too if they're coming from Deshaun Watson. Those things had to be oiled up by Mr. Massage hands and it's probably stupid hard to catch a ball that's been touched by him. Talking about the Browns though, you have one of the most elite tight ends in football right now. I don't usually mention tight ends because they seem to be an irrelevant position this year, but Njoku has been great these past couple weeks since Amari’s been out of town. It also helps that Jamis Winston is throwing him the ball rather than massage man. I wouldn't be surprised if he consistently puts up 10 to 20 points every single week and finishes as a top three guy by the end of the year. He's one of the few shining stars of that team and I think he will continue this path for the next couple weeks. 

 

There's not much left to say about this team. I've already given you your kudos and I've already taken the L in a head-to-head with you. I might still be a little bit skeptical because I personally was never on the hype train for half these guys. Apparently though I’m in the wrong and you are leading the standings in terms of points and wins. So maybe I should just stick a sock in it and watch greatness from a distance. Next time, do you want to write these power rankings since clearly, you're all knowing and can draft better and know more about football than anyone else in the league. Good luck the rest of the season, unfortunately I won't be getting my revenge game during the regular season. You better watch your back though because if it comes to playoffs I'm going to DM all of my players and ensure them that they pop off the week I play you because I can't have 2 losses to you. That would be purely embarrassing for me as a person and the commissioner of this league.

posts.title: Regular Season Recap (Weeks 9-14)
blocks: Regular Season Recap

What a season! It's been! 14 weeks of pure chaos where no one knew what the fuck was going on. We had games that finished within a point, and we had games that finished about 99 points apart. There were good teams, there were bad teams, there were happy teams, there were sad teams, but at the end of the day we only have one loser, LIZ!!! Hope you enjoy the waffle House or wherever you decide to go, I'm sure all of us will look forward to watching that either live or getting hourly updates. As expected, it came down to the VERY last week to determine the playoffs. Katie had the first-round bye locked up and Brin had a SPOT guaranteed, but outside of that, the other 4 spots were all up for grabs. Obviously, Molly and I were sitting on the outside and it seemed that only one of us would be making it. Though there was the fat outlier of Haley who was “statistically” still in contention. Nevertheless, ball don’t lie and there was some witchcraft and wizardry that went on leaving Max out and Molly and I in.

 

Sorry this is so late, homeboy was chillaxing at home this whole past week, so this is going to be a ragtag group of comment put together with the hope of finding some coherent sentences along the way. Just because the regular season is over and the playoffs are set, don’t expect my rankings to follow that of ESPN. That would defeat the whole point of this “blog”, why would I just copy and paste the BS that they spout and take that for gospel. Last time this site made its prediction was at the end of the draft and let’s look at how that played out. ESPN predicted that Liz would be the #1 overall team……what a fucking whiff. Maggie as the #3, Molly as the #4, and Matte at #7. In fact, they could not have been more wrong seeing that the 4 most bottom teams are all in the playoffs. Liz, you should have known your season was over when ESPN said you had the best draft. That’s why I was stoked to see myself at the bottom, I know ESPN doesn’t know ball and me being ranked dead last meant I was a LOCK for the playoffs.  With that. Let's peek at my honest to God, totally accurate, power rankings for the rest of the season. Peep the superlative I give your team, everyone was known for something whether it was good or bad, that's to be determined.

12: San Diego 69ers (Liz)
 
​Post Draft Rank: 9th
 
​Quarterly Change: -1
 
​Record: 4-10

You hate to see it Liz, you really do. If nothing, you're at least consistent. Last place 2 years in a row, you're my goat. You’ll go down in history as the freest of money every year. You sure you want to play again next year? I understand now why you only wanted the buy-in to be $15, you knew from day one there was 0% chance you would be fighting for a chance to win it all. All jokes aside, I think you just had some bad luck. That bad luck being named Christian McCaffrey. It's a tough lesson to learn, but it's a lesson you'll learn eventually. Never draft someone from your favorite team because it only leads to extreme disappointment. I stray far away from all Steelers because I know that I'm going to be pissed if not only do the Steelers lose, but my fantasy team loses too because one of their bums didn't do any good, it's called hedging your bet. You did have some surprise ballers on this team. Those being Darnell Mooney and Nick Westbrook over these past couple weeks. The rest of your team was rather forgettable outside of Joe Mixon who was your only stud. 

 

The superlative I'll throw this team is the biggest bust. I mean I could have told you this being that the ESPN predictions are almost always wrong. After the draft you were projected the number one team, they thought you were going to have the best season. They thought you had the most stacked team in the league. Whereas me, Brendan, Brin, and Gabe were all the bottom four ranked teams. All four of us made the playoffs, you see any correlation there? I don’t know that I expected you to do good, but honestly you did the best you could with what you were working with, but damn you hate to see it. Hopefully next year, you don't draft Christian McCaffrey or someone who's going to have a bust of a year. Unfortunately, there is someone every single year who drafts a guy in the first round that doesn't play, and it just happened to be you this year, there's always next year, I guess. I would mention that you could run it back and win the losers bracket, but I do not see this team being remotely close to doing that. I know you pulled some wizardry last year, but this is a much different team, and I would be shocked to see you win two of the last three playoffs weeks.

11: Hit It From The Dak (Jess)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 7th​ 
 
Quarterly Change: -1 
 
Record: 4-10
 
​

You know what I should have expected nothing other than this from you. A season full of tears, highs, lows, rage fits, hype wins, that's fantasy football for you though. And like many other teams, you were fighting until the bitter end. Oddly for you, you weren't fighting for a playoff spot, but you were fighting to be out of that last place spot. I liked the team you drafted. I thought it was super solid, you just had some flops, and I think there's definitely a learning curve for next year. We learned not to draft five players from the same team, I think Packers wide receivers are definitely something we should avoid next year. Fuck Jonathan Taylor and Jaden Reed, those two caused you and me so many headaches debating if you should play them, should you bench them, should you trade them, or should you drop them. It was a bit of a wonky year, but you made out and I think this is still a solid team. I don't know that you have the greatest shot in winning the losers bracket, but there is potential. 

 

The superlative I will give this team is you were the waiver wire warrior. There were teams in this league who hardly touched the waiver wires. Brendan was the lowest changing team only making three moves throughout the year, the average in the league was 16 moves per team. That means through 14 weeks everyone pretty much added or dropped one player every single week. You, on the other hand made 36 moves this year. You lived and died by that waiver wire. Every single week you made one, two, or three moves, adding or dropping the most random people, calling me and giving me grief for telling you to do certain things. Who am I to give you shit for it though, you're not in last place and that's all that matters. I know players are up and down but maybe next year pick some guys you really have faith in and rock with them all year. That's what Brendan did, and it looks like he's the number three team so who knows. You're my favorite waiver wire warrior though and there's no one else I would rather spend an hour on the phone with every week talking about who's good and who's not. It was super fun playing a game of roulette every single week with you to find out who was going to put up five points or who was going to put up 12. Can't wait to do it again next year!

10: Butker?I HARDLY KNOW HER (Maggie)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 6th
 
​Quarterly Change: -4 ​
 
Record: 4-10

I don't even know what to think of this team. I know last time we checked in with the power rankings I was giving you the sloppiest of toppy. I thought this team was playoff bound and I thought this team was sick nasty. Sure, you had some injuries, but this is a solid squad all together. I think you had some bad luck despite having a decent draft. Breece Hall was the biggest flop ever, Achane was injured and didn't really pan out. Evans and Pickens have both missed a handful of weeks with injury, the only decent one was Devonta Smith, he was your king of consistency. I still do stand by this being a good team, I think you just had some poor luck. 

 

Though that leads me to your superlative, this was the least attended team. By that I mean you did not give this team the attention they needed to grow. Everyone knows flowers need water and sunlight to grow. Similarly, fantasy teams need constant waiver additions and lineup switches. There were 3 weeks where you played people who were not playing, and I know there was at least one week where someone had to remind you to set your lineup. I don't think any of that would have made this a playoff team anyways, but it is something to note. I also think it's just funny to give you this superlative seeing that I know you try your best, but you're not locked in like the rest of us who are addicted to this. I don't know that you can win the losers bracket, but hell you can at least give it a try. Strategy number one, I would recommend switching out George Pickens who is again, not going to play. I know you though and it would taint your legacy as the least attentive team to change him out now. Good luck kiddo. This might all be a divine punishment for drafting Harrison Butker, which I don't completely disagree with, but the rest of the league seem to have beef with it. Here's a little joke and totally a joke ~wink wink~, but do you know why I didn't buy Jess a watch for Christmas? Because there's a clock on the stove and that's where the women belong. Big praise to my man Harrison

9: Jockstraps (Haley)
 
​Post Draft Rank:10th
 
​Quarterly Change: +2​
 
Record: 6-8

Tough year for you, I thought you drafted well, but I should have known with Kyle Pitts and Aaron Rodgers this team was doomed. Losing six of your first eight games hurts like a bitch, but you did a great job to turn it around. This team doesn't have a whole lot of depth, but you did pick up a couple people and drop some throughout the year which really seem to help. Your biggest gain was me dropping Chase Brown at the beginning of the season. This allowed you to pick him up and from there, the rest is history, he was one of your better players and helped cement you in a really good turnaround of this season. I know it was a long shot, but the fact that you even had playoff viability last week is outstanding. 

 

The superlative I'll give this team is the biggest comeback to no one's surprise. 2-6 is a tough look and I think I had you in dead last in the rankings due to the fact that I thought you were so far behind. I thought you'd be lucky to catch a couple Ws to get out of last place. Little did I know you'd be fighting for a playoff spot and have a pretty solid team going into the playoffs. There are a handful of other really good teams, but I think you do have a shot at winning the losers bracket if Tyreek and Chase Brown continue their dominance. Good luck out there, I'm curious and excited to see where things go from here. If nothing else, you can say at least you didn't get last place despite having arguably one of the worst starts in league history.

8:*Great Fantasy Name (Matte)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 8th​
 
Quarterly Change:+1​
 
Record: 4-10

What a season you had. I know I had to talk you off a ledge numerous times, but for how this team turned out, you had a really strong finish. Bo Nix is one of the better quarterbacks in the league, CeeDee, Puka, and Collins are for sure the strongest three wide receiver combination in the League. Kelce too is someone that had a rough start but panned out towards the end of the year. I wouldn't even say your running backs are weak, but on this loaded team they're your softest spot. Can't be mad about that though, seeing that they both finished in the top 30. 

 

The superlative I give this team, and I think we all saw this coming, is the unluckiest team of the Year. You had so many injuries to so many key guys which stunted your chance at winning. Not only that, but through the first 7 or 8 weeks you were getting absolutely shafted by matchups. You played the high score almost every other week and at one point you had over 100 points scored against you to the team in second place. Things slowly evened out towards the end of the year, but you still finished as the most shafted team. I do really like this team's chance in the loser’s bracket, and I think if not the favorite, you are one of the two teams I expect to be in that loser's bracket final. Don't prove me wrong, see you next year, hopefully in the playoffs.

7: Chubby Ducker (Max)​

Post Draft Rank: 1st​

Quarterly Change: -6

Record: 8-6

Call this team the 2016 falcons the way you just choked. I thought this team was a lock from day one to make the playoffs. Sure, you had some ups and downs and injuries, but I thought this team was phenomenal. You had great players all around and despite some unlucky play, you were in a top spot pretty much all year. Two fat L's at the end of the season led you to miss the playoffs by 13 points, but damn that shit hurts. I know I had you ranked stupid high all year long and I was the last person to see this coming. Even just watching the standings the last week, I thought it was Molly and I fighting for the last spot. I didn't even think twice about you missing the playoffs but here we are. 

 

I could give this team the biggest choke as the superlative, but I'll be nice, and I think this is the most well-rounded team. Sure, Mahomes has sucked this year, but for how bad he's been, the 11th overall quarterback is not terrible. He was undoubtably your weakest link. Outside of that you had Gibbs and Connor, two top 15 running backs. AJ Brown and Scary Terry, who despite not finishing in the top 20 are two super solid wide receivers. Even as a flex you had DK who I personally think might have been the biggest flop of this year. I mainly say this because I drafted him in most leagues and he did not produce like I thought he would, but still not a bad Flex option. Then on top of that you had the best tight end, I know he finished as TE2 technically, but Brock Bowers has been an absolute stud. Then even on the bench you had Jameison Williams, Mark Andrews and Nick Chubb all willing to go at a moment's notice. This team was super well-rounded, and you had some great depth, but I guess at the end of the day the football gods wanted to make you look like a fool. All that being said, now you play a bunch of teams that were lucky to get four wins on the season, so realistically, if you're not picking where you draft next year, I don't know what went wrong.

6: Gridiron Gupta (Molly)
 
​Post Draft Rank: 5th
 
Quarterly Change: -5
 
​Record: 8-6
 
​

Brother, I thought you were dead in the water. This team looked phenomenal through the first 9 weeks of the season. There was no doubt in my mind that you were going to be in the playoffs, in fact, I think at one point you were almost 99% locked in for the playoffs but then you looked away for 2 weeks and you lost two games by under five points because you failed to set your lineup and you dropped drastically in the standings. I thought up until this last week that you were cooked. I was fighting for my life for the playoffs because I was afraid that if I lost you were going to kick me out and get that last spot. Little did I know, Max would have the biggest choke of the century and only put up 92 points. This allowed both of us to squeeze in narrowly. 13 points made the difference between you fighting for a $200 prize or a pat on the back and a choice for your draft pick next year.

 

The superlative I give this team is the" locked in" team of the Year. By this I mean your lineup stayed the same pretty much all year long. Bijon and James Cook where your Rb1 and 2 every single week except for the byes. Similarly, Drake London was your WR1 and David Njouku was your TE almost every single week. The only players you switched up here and there were Maserati Marv and Jaden Daniels or Kyler Murray. Aside from that this team’s lineup was locked in almost every single week. I would advise you (and it might be a little too late by the time I post this) but check your lineup because in the Njoku is going to be out and I would hate to see you lose yet another game by under five points because you weren't paying attention. Regardless, this team is super solid, and I feel that if you do advance, this team has a shot at the title. You just got to get through to that stupid bitch Brendan first. You're in the tough part of the bracket so even if you do win, you have to face Gabe who I believe is the favorite to win the league. Good luck out there kiddo, hopefully you figure things out before it's too late.

5: Baby Choda (Brendan)​

Post Draft Rank: 12th​

Quarterly Change: +3​

Record: 9-5

Well, well, well, what a year you had. I thought you were free money at the beginning of the year when you took Josh Allen as your first pick. Little did I know, he would be your best player. Somehow, he is not the QB1, but any QB who puts up 51 points in a game is well worth the first-round pick. Throughout the year, this team has been super strong despite the 9-5 record. Your second and point scored only to me, though you are also the team that has had the 2nd least points scored against them. Regardless, this team has been balling all year. 

 

The superlative I throw to this team is you were the sleeper team of the Year. Not that I thought your team was bad, but you managed to pick up some really good sleeper pics in the draft or all free agency. Chuba Hubbard has been the goat (drafted 12th round) and without him, this team is not anywhere close to making the playoffs. You had another sleeper pic in Cortland Sutton (9th round) who has sneakily become the wide receiver 11 on the season. He had a bit of a slow start but after week 6 this man has been putting up hella points on a weekly basis. And then your last notable starer who you picked up that has made this team the powerhouse that it is, is Jonnu Smith (Waiver add). Again, after a slow start to this season, this man has worked himself up to the tight end #4. Sure, being TE4 isn’t terribly hard, but in a league where tight ends regularly get under 10 points, for you to have two tight ends that both put up well above 10 points gives you a huge advantage. I'll throw in an honorable mention to Baker Mayfield (13th Round) as another sleeper. Obviously, you haven't had the need to use him since you have Josh Allen, but this man has gone crazy all year long. All three of those players you picked up either all free agency or after the 100th pick. Great draft value for a guy who I thought was a moron by taking a QB first. 

 

My second superlative, which really is me just making fun of you, is that you are the biggest Jew aka the richest in the league. By that, I mean you spent $0 on waiver wire acquisitions. You also made the least moves in the league, only three times throughout the season did you add or drop someone. I guess if it isn't broken, there's no need to fix it. I don't particularly want to run into this team again, but if I do, at least I know I'll be getting my money back. Not saying I’d abuse my powers, but if we’re in the finals together, I'm going into the lead manager settings and I'm benching all of your players, suck a dick bitch

4: Hurts So Good (Katie)​

Post Draft Rank: 2nd​

Quarterly Change: 0

​Record: 11-3

I will admit this is a good team, however, you have been the luckiest team in this league. Out of 14 weeks, only four times did someone put up more than 100 points on you. I wish I could say this team struggled and you had to fight, but you were pretty much a top three team in the rankings all year long. Sure you had that injury to Rashee Rice, but outside of that you have been pretty blessed.

Your captain, your king, the man who your team is named after, has been the backbone of this team and without Jalen hurts, I don't know that you even make the playoffs. Maybe that's being a little exaggerative but having a top five quarterback goes a long way in this league. While you might not have the best players at every position, you had a top 10 ranked guy in every key position. I think the running backs are solid and picking up. Guerendo is probably your biggest move of the season, especially this late. Aaron Jones has been shaky at best, so I think Guerendo is a good potential fill-in where he may fall off. K9 is a beast, and I don't really see him slowing down, the only issue is that the Rams sometimes are playing from behind and have to throw the ball a lot, but he still gets a lot of the goal line touches so not too much to worry about there. 

 

The wide receivers are surprisingly solid. Obviously, everyone saw Amon-Ra being a top 10 guy, but he has fallen off a little bit recently since he isn't scoring a touchdown in every single game. I assume that'll probably turn around. If he scored in the first eight games of the year, it would be weird for him to not score the rest of the year. Adams had a surprisingly had a resurgence and been playing really well these past couple weeks. Again, not sure how much I can trust that, but fortunately you have a bunch of solid guys on the bench like Meyers or even Odunze who could potentially fill in for him. 

 

Whether it's luck or skill, you locked up the number one seed and a first-round bye. That alone solidifies you with a good chance to win the chip. I don't think this is the strongest team in the league, but if things go your way (which they have been all year) I could see this team being a championship caliber team. Team. All you need is a team to score under 100 which seems to be par for the course for you. Good luck out there, hopefully I'll be seeing you next week so don't count on it being a free one, you’ve beaten me twice already this year, don't expect it to be thrice. I give this team the superlative of the luckiest team in the league. Need I say more? You had the least points against and hardly any injury issues. Even your bench players all turned out to be pretty good.

3: Fondle These Footballz (Brin)​

Post Draft Rank: 4th​

Quarterly Change: 0

​Record: 8-6

Tell your cousin that he did a pretty decent job this year. I'm only partially kidding; I know you did a lot of this but just had a little helper in your ear every once in a while. I would like a formal apology from you, because I remember after week 4 when I was in the dumps at 1-3, and you told me my team was shit and it shouldn't be ranked above yours, look how the tables have turned….hoe. Obviously, your team is good, you've just had a couple hiccups here and there and a handful of injuries throughout the year. I'm hoping that injury streak continues, at least for one more week because my team is looking rough especially after Cooper “Shit my pants” Kupp dropped a big fat zero. So, I need you to do the same. Looking like you're on the same path with Bucky Irving potentially out, Kenneth Walker doubtful, and JK Dobbins dead. 

 

Fortunately for you though, this has been your strong point all season, and this is the superlative that I'll give to you. You were the most flexible team, by that I mean out of 14 weeks this year, 12 of those weeks, your Flex player put up over 10 points. That's phenomenal seeing that the flex is usually a shot in the dark with someone who is going to hit sometimes but miss a lot more frequently. Of those 12 weeks I'm pretty sure only two times did they fall under 15 points. What a phenomenal job of picking your bench and flexible players. It's looking like the two of us this week are going to put up a combined 130 points and it's going to be a super low scoring week, but whoever wins this week I think has a really good shot winning the next week and going to the championship. 

May the odds ever be in your favor, after this week, but if you do beat me, I don't think there's a team I'd rather see win this league. Okay, that's enough Dick riding, good luck kiddo

2: Kamara Harris (Trevor)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 3rd
 
​Quarterly Change: +3
 
​Record: 8-6

Listen, I know the season didn't turn out exactly like I hoped for, but I told all of you this team was going to ball. I know I had my haters when I was one and three and ranked myself as like the fourth best team but look at where we landed....Fourth place. 

 

The superlative I give my team is the powerhouse of the League, I scored the most points on the season and yet somehow still caught six losses. It is what it is, I have faith in my team, even if Cooper Kupp put up a fat fucking zero the week of the fantasy playoffs. I'm going to be so real; I don't think I win this week which sucks, but that's life baby. Get em next year unless Brin you want to have your whole team choke that would be really nice.

1: Saquon My Balls (Gabe)
 
Post Draft Rank: 11th​
 
Quarterly Change: +6

​Record: 10-4
​

Shout out to you king for getting a first-round bye. This team has been kicking ass all year after you had an unbelievably solid draft. Le me clarify, by draft, I mean the first like five rounds. Outside of that you seemed to have a big fat swing and a miss on many of these players, but you did manage to draft the two potential MVPs of the League. If neither of them win MVP, they should 100% win the fantasy football MVP. Thus, this has awarded you with the superlative of best scout. You are the only person in the league to draft two players who finished as the #1 player at their position (outside of me, but I had the #1 kicker and defense so like does that really count?).

 

Lamar has been unstoppable, and I don't see that changing anytime over the next 3 weeks. He plays the Steelers week 16, but outside of that the playoffs are basically free for him, and he should be scoring at least 25 in the other games. Saquon as well has the easiest playoff schedule I have ever seen. Seeing that the eagles are going to be competing for the number one seed in the NFC until the very end means that Saquon is going to absolutely ball. I expect these two combined to drop at least 60 points for the foreseeable future. I can't even talk bad on Montgomery, like obviously he isn't the best in the league, but he's way better than most other people's RB2s. Gibbs has slowly been taking over a little bit more of the workload week by week, but Montgomery seems to get a lot of the goal line work, which is really what matters in fantasy.

 

The falloff happens though when we look at your wide receivers. What the fuck is going on there? I mean just looking at your day one draft, you put all of your faith into Jalen Waddle and Zay flowers. Sure, those two are supposed to have great years, but what do you really expect when Flower’s quarterback is basically a running back and Waddles quarterback has had more brain bleeds this year than brain cells he has left. Over the past couple weeks, they have shown up so I guess it only really matters now if they can continue, but it seems you found yourself a hidden Superstar in Jordan Addison. The Vikings air attack is unreal and with Jefferson being double covered 90% of the time, Addison is the next best alternative and it seems to be paying off. I've been saying this about your wide receivers all year long that they are either boom or bust, but in all honesty, I guess it doesn't really matter when you have Saquon and Lamar balling out. 10 or more points is all you need to have a 100-point week every week.

 

Bust or not this team is set for a solid playoff run. You have the easy side of the bracket too with both Molly and Brendan compared to Brin and me. I wish you nothing but the best and with the cupcake of schedules that your players have, I expect to see you in the finals, where I'll take that crown and prove that this is my league. Unlike last year where I choked in the finals, I need my redemption and it's going to come at your expense. Sorry not sorry.

posts.title: 2025 Post Draft Rankings
blocks: Post Draft Rankings

Welcome back, degenerates, to another year of fantasy football hell. It’s 2025, the draft is in the books, and once again I, your benevolent-but-unappreciated commissioner, have carried this league on my back while receiving approximately zero thank-yous and many fuck yous. I set everything up, keep the league alive, and what do I get in return? Complaints about the draft date from people who double book themselves and accusations that the draft order was rigged. I feel like Andy Cohen hosting a special reunion. I set the stage, stir the pot, and then get screamed at while everyone else makes a fool of themselves.

This season we said farewell to Molly and Liz — may their auto-drafts and revolving door of excuses rest in eternal mediocrity — and welcomed two new lambs to the slaughter. First is Brody, who joins us via the ancient fantasy football tradition of “dating Maggie and not being able to say no.” Second is Olivia, who knows less about football than the Pope knows about premarital sex (she is in the same boat as the Pope on that one too). Which of course means she’s destined to win games she has no business winning, and I’ll be forced to watch half of you lose to someone who thinks a flex is just owning their own recyclable utensils (and not a fantasy football roster spot for those who don’t get that joke).

 

The draft itself was pure chaos, almost scarier than watching the host of CTESPN, Antonio Brown’s, Instagram Live. Brendan continued his annual “let me draft Josh Allen and call it strategy” routine, doubling down on the one thing in his life more reliable than scrubs and Crocs. Matte, meanwhile, put together what can only be described as a January 6th of a draft — pure chaos, zero plan, and a lot of bad decisions that should probably be illegal. Three quarterbacks, three tight ends, and somehow thought Michael Penix in the 8th was a masterstroke when even ESPN’s algorithm had him in the “Only draft with your last pick” tier. Not only that, but he also grabbed Kyle Pitts in the 7th like it was 2021 and Matthew Golden in the 4th as though he was a generational talent (he very well could be). All to say this man was reaching harder than Donald Trump at a children’s pageant, better hope the Epstein list doesn’t drop or else your career is going to be ruined. Meanwhile, Gabe, the proud owner of “Gay people can’t play Football” actually drafted a solid squad. I can’t believe you let a gay man be the only one without a roster that’s straight trash.

 

And let’s not forget what we’re really playing for: public shame. Because last place earns the right to go to a bar open to close, every drink takes 30 minutes off, and a shot is an hour off, BUT you can only take shots after hour 3. The best part is the rest of the league gets to dress you however we want. So draft grades and rankings aside, what we’re really doing is deciding who’s going to spend 12 hours in public dressed like a colorblind Serbian hooker.

So buckle up, grab your White Claws, and prepare yourselves for another season of chaos, heartbreak, and me being blamed for everything. Let’s get into these rankings which will 100% be so wrong within a week!
12. Here Comes McBride (Katie)

Listen someone had to be last, and it just happens that it's going to be you this time. Don't sweat it too much, according to ESPN's ranking. You’re in 9th place and ESPN is notorious for being so blatantly wrong about their beginning of season rankings. So being on the bottom half of that means you're probably goated.

 

That being said, this team is balls. Joe Sheisty is going to be nasty, but your running backs are disgusting. Omarion Hampton and Najee Harris are fine and being on the Chargers means they're going to run the ball a lot but they're splitting the work, and I am just scared of rookies at least at running back. Aaron Jones is geriatric so good fucking luck with that. He's going to be replaced by week 4 by Jordan Mason who you also seem to have on your bench. So realistically you have all your bases covered, I just think it's ugly. The wide receiver situation isn't too shabby. Amon-Ra will be fine, though I am hesitant about any lion because of the fact that they lost their offensive coordinator. Still no worries, realistically, they'll be fine, but that’s just my little brain working overtime with too much football knowledge for my own good. Aside from the Sun God, you have two terrifying picks only because they're both Cardinals. Individually I think they're both fine, but on the same team is where you run into trouble…especially since the Cardinals are projected to be one of the bottom tier teams of the League and not score a lot this year. It’s like you’re playing fantasy sudoku with 2 Cardinals, you can fill in the boxes, but you’re still playing the wrong game. Ricky P on the other hand Is solid, I've been drafting him a lot in all my other drafts, so I have no problem with that pickup. He's going to be the main option aside from George Kittle in San Francisco for the first 6? 8? 10 weeks? Who knows, but I really like that pick.

 

The depth on your bench isn't bad, like I said you have your bases covered, but it feels like these are just plug and play options if someone goes down. It doesn't seem like you have a whole lot of potential or chance of any of these guys being a diamond in the rough who you can consistently start.
11: *Great Fantasy Name (Matte)

Dawg you must have the tism. This team is straight rubbish. While you were drafting, everyone who was together at my place was making fun of you for how outlandish your picks were. Yeah, you got good players, but you were reaching like crazy.

 

Taking Michael Penix, Matt Golden and Kyle Pitts in three rounds back-to-back is wild. Not only that, then you went on auto draft and picked up not your second but your third tight end as well as three QBs. Bettsy better have been giving you the sloppiest of toppy to make you miss the draft and take those. Like you gotta have some excuse for what happened. I think you have a lot of potential if these guys hit, but if they are busts or just mediocre, you're fucked. Jeanty will be fine, Nabers will be fine, and Golden I think is actually going to do well but Hall, Flowers, Pitts and the rest of your squad are all Boomer bust candidates every week.

 

You're lucky I didn't have you last. I really thought about it but Katie's team was just a sliver worse. The more I look at this team the more I like it, so I'm going to stop looking at it before I have to change the rankings. I think you'll be at the bottom of the rankings for the first couple weeks but come week five or six you might be able to move up into the Center. Don't get me wrong, I still don't think this is a playoff team, but I think it has outstanding potential to beat the guards in the next “Longest Yard”. That being said, you won’t have to be an alcoholic and slam 6 shots in 6 minutes to get out of that bar before 8pm.
10: Baby Choda (Brendan)

Yeah yeah yeah, I know you're a little kinky ass likes being in 10th place. It gives you something to prove. I don't hate the team, but I also don't love it.

 

I think you have a really strong running back group, but your wide receivers are going to struggle. But then again that was your strategy last year. Get solid running backs and just be carried by them and Josh Allen and hope that your wide receivers will put up 10 points a game. I think if you owed a better bench I would have this team higher up, but your bench is full of b-listers and washed geriatric patients. Scrubs on the bench, scrubs in real life, if nothing else, at least you’re consistent (that was a male nurse joke).

 

If this team starts popping off, I won't be shocked, but if they're dog shit, I also won't be shocked. This team feels like you're either dropping 150 points every week on the back of Josh Allen, CMC, and Alvin Kamara each putting up 30 or you're dropping 80 points a week still with Josh Allen putting up 50 CMC putting up 20 and the rest of your squad putting up under 10. I'm going to be so tight when you beat the brakes off me and in week 4. Fuck this team and the little chode who drafted them.
9: Team Conrad (Maggie)

Ironic that you would choose team Conrad and name your team after “The summer I Turned Pretty” when this is the summer you turned fugly, stinky, and chopped. Similar to you, your team is wack as fuck.

 

CeeDee Lamb is the goat, and Jayden Daniels is going to cook, but Achane is going to blow out his knee in week 3, Swift is going to be replaced by week 5 and Scary Terry is hit or miss most weeks. He missed a fuckload of training camp because of a contract dispute so he is going to start out the season slow. Boy has not played football in like 8 months; there is no way he comes out of the gate with more than 15 points. Some weeks you'll win because of the McLauren and Daniel's combo, but other weeks you'll flounder for that same reason. Still not convinced you know that Travis Kelce is a good tight end, or if you just know that he proposed to Taylor Swift.

 

Regardless, I wish nothing but the worst for those two, sko birds dick head. I do kind of fuck with your bench but at the same time it's absolute dog water. Kaleb Johnson is a good pick in theory, but he’s a Steeler so that’s such a double-edged sword. Having both Jacksonville running backs, a backup tight end, a 42-year-old wide receiver and Michael Shitman…yikes! It's funny that with every other team below you, I've given them words of confidence saying “man, I think you can move up in the rankings”, but realistically I think this might be the highest you're going to see for the foreseeable future.

 

Crazy what happens when you don't have Boyfriend Brody or auto draft doing the drafting for you Instead Brody is now your opp. I bet he told you to draft half these people, that's a true hater. This was his 5-year plan, he first would swindle you into dating him, so he could fuck your fantasy team for the future and make you go to a bar open to close (not like that isn’t a regular Thursday for you tho) isn't that crazy? Low-key kind of my goat for that. Anyone on the Margarete hate train is a friend of mine. I stay praying on your downfall. Every 11:11 I wish that one of your toenails falls off or that you spill a glass of water on a customer at work. Nothing too vicious, I just love some micro aggressions and minimal inconvenience. Stay strong pookie, when we get to dress you for the loser’s punishment, I call getting to do your makeup and I’m gonna get my getback for what you did to me at that Sephora that one time after the gym.
8: Fondle these Footballs (Brin)

This is a good team, and I hate to admit that. Maybe you could be higher in the rankings, but I love being one of your biggest haters. This football team should be called “The Summer I fucked up my football draft and had to go to a bar and be ugly”. Actually, write that down for next year, that's kind of a bar. Regardless, this team has a lot of potential but also it kind of scares me.

 

Bo Nix is going to be fine; he's kind of the goat. Jonathan Taylor, I think, is a top three running back but that's only if he stays healthy. Chuba is confusing to me, last year he balled out, but this year I don't know if he can repeat that. Like I think he's okay, but I don't think he's that guy. Maybe I eat my words, and he actually is solid like that. Your wide receivers are cool, but again I don't love them. I know you love Tee Higgens because you think he's cute, but being the wide receiver two on any team scares me. If you're going to be the second guy, it's best to do it on the Benglas because they're going to score a lot and pass the rock a lot. I think you might be taking a fat risk on Colson Loveland. He's a great prospect but being on the Bears who are notorious for being trash as well as having like eight different options at wide receiver means he's going to have a limited role.

 

I do like the bench though! You have a bunch of backups and scrubs who could actually be kinda fantasy relevant. Odunze is your Washington boy which I get the love there, but he is one of the Bears WRs who will take work away from Loveland. Charbonnet is a great backup if Walker goes down which he always seems to do. Then both Tillman and Downs are guys I had my eye on but didn’t have the balls to pull the trigger. They’re both sleepers who could turn into a serviceable flex player by the end of the year. I was going to skip over Tony Pollard, but I think he makes me have to bring up the point that you're lucky as fuck that the other running back in Tennessee just blew up his knee because if that wasn't the case, Pollard was cooked and replaced by week 4.

 

Nevertheless, this team can still suck a fatty and I hope you don't even sniff the playoffs this year. Love from your biggest haters, Jeremiah and Belly (I can’t wait for the wedding, fuck Conrad)
7: Gay People Can't Play Football (Gabe)

First of all, fuck your bitch and the click you claim. I genuinely Don't know what to think of this team. Like you have some really good picks in Justin Fields, Puka, Pickens and Bowers, but then you also have some scary picks in Montgomery, Wilson, and Godwin. Like these guys are all solid options, but it feels like they're very much boom or bust.

 

Fields is either putting up 10 or 30 points with no in between. Montgomery is likely going to see a reduced role this year, so I wouldn't expect more than 10 points a week from him. Though he is definitely still the goal line back so I would expect he’ll likely score at least one of those a game. Wilson is the only option in New York in terms of throwing the ball, but they are primed to be a heavy run team and having Justin Fields is not the biggest confidence boost. Trust that coming from me after watching all Pittsburgh receivers last year, it’s miserable.

 

Your bench has some decent options, but at the same time you're fucked. Godwin isn't coming back anytime soon and by the time he does come back, Ebuka will have all but replaced him. Jennings had like three good games last year, so that's a waste of a bench spot. Jalen Wright has basically been replaced. Last year was his time to shine and he didn't so they drafted Ollie Gordon who's likely going to take over as the RB2. Or at least that's what I'm hoping since I drafted him. Then the rest are mid at best. I really do hope that Troy Franklin pick works out. I know that's your boy and I was high on him last year, especially since he and Nix had that college connection, but I unfortunately think that he's just not going to be that guy in Denver.

 

I don't know how this team ranks above half the league, but I guess in the moment while I was ranking, something about your starting lineup really got me excited. Maybe it's because you have 3 ex Steelers and one current in your starting lineup. Obviously, this position probably won't stay and you're going to move up or down by next week. I'm trending towards down but at the same time I could be so wrong about this squad of gays. It feels as tho Lisa Vanderpump assembled this team herself, it’s messy, dramatic, and way better than it has any right to be.
6: Newpdogg (Olivia)

I guess me having you at sixth place shows that fantasy really doesn't take all that much skill. Instead, it just takes a lot of swag and really big muscles.

 

This team is actually really solid; both your running backs are studs. Even though I'm not a huge Josh Jacobs fan, I think he's going to be good as your second running back. The wide receivers are also solid. DK worries me a little bit because the Steelers are dick and balls, but realistically no one else is in Pittsburgh who's going to catch balls, and this is their best QB situation since Big Ben so he's the only real option. Of course you would pick Patrick Mahomo you gaytard. I bet you thought it was his younger brother Jackson that you were drafting. The only knock I have on this team so far is that they’re definitely all republicans. You don't know this, but your tight end is a fire pick. I mean literally, David Njoku is a burn victim. He burned like 80% of his face last year so I appreciate you doing charity and picking up the cripple for your tight end.

 

The bench though is what tells me that you're cheating. I know you have a shadow manager doing shit on the side. There's no way you would have Brandon Aiyuk already in the IR spot just off your knowledge of ball, unless you're trying to swindle the whole league that is. I have a feeling you won your family league last year. Not only that, but you didn't lose a single game, won the championship and now you're coming in here acting like a noob about an absolutely rock our shit and take our money. If that's the case, my only hope is that you beat the piss out of Maggie. I don’t give a shit about the rest of the gang; you just better beat her both times you play her this year. After week one I'm sure I'll tell you this team is dog shit and you're stupid for having half these players on your roster, but that's just how the cookie crumbles baby.

5: Brody's Beast Team [Gay ass team name] (Brody)
​

I don't have as much fun ranking the top half of these teams because they're actually good. I would love to sit here and tell you that your team is absolute dog shit and you're stupid for drafting half of these guys, but realistically I think this is a really solid team.

 

You might have one of the best RB duos in the league and the wide receivers are fine. I'm not a big BTJ believer and I think JSN is good, but Sam Darnold worries me. That being said, I'm sure they'll both be fine putting up 12 to 15 minimum each week. Picking up Tyreek in in 4th is a steal too so I can't even be mad about that. My only knock is that I think Kyler is either going to continue to be mediocre at best or finally have the year everyone's been expecting for the last 5 years from him.

 

Even your bench is pretty solid. Travis Hunter worries me because I don't know how they'll utilize him, but as a 9th rounder that's a steal. You kind of got shafted on Joe Mixon, Brian, Robinson, and Tyjae all getting hurt or traded but as the season progresses, I'm sure that'll work out. CMC is going to tear his Achilles for the 15th time, Houston is for sure not surviving off Chubb and a rookie, and Tony Pollard is geriatric so as soon as Spears is ready, he'll be fantasy relevant. Even just having Samson is a great call since that Judkins situation is still up in the air and Jerome Ford is legit one of the worst starting backs in the League.

 

Enough glazing, this team is still only 5th best. If I’m going to make fun of your team it’ll be for drafting two defenses, only morons do that. And your kicker is a no-name scrub who's only rostered in 11% of leagues. Uh oh, dipshit alert!!! Unless……do you know something the rest of us don't?
4: Chrome Dome Clankers (Hard R) (Trevor)

Yeah of course. I have myself ranked in the top five. I drafted this team so of course I'm going to like it.

 

The running backs are goated. Ken Walker is legit, a top five guy if he stays healthy but that's a big if. JJettas, Sutton, and Ebuka are all about to be the truth.

 

Even going to my bench, I have Rashee Rice who’s a top 5 guy when he comes back from suspension, Diggs, Chubb and the number one overall pick in Cam Ward. All these guys are fantasy relevant week one and I'm going to try to trade rape half the league once they drop 15 or 20 points in their first game. Can't wait to make some money moves! Y'all going to be calling me P Diddy by the end of this week. Get shafted losers
3: Chubby Ducker (Max)

This is the first! Usually, I'm giving your team the sloppiest of toppy. Might as well start calling me Krispy Kreme the way I stay glazing your team. Still a top three team so I guess I'm still going to blow you like Monica Lewinsky, but I think this is the first year that I don't have you as my number one team.

 

That being said, the squad is still really solid. I might be a bit tight and punishing your ranking because I wanted that 4th overall pick but that’s neither here nor there. I put in all that hard work in the fantasy gauntlet only to get this taken from my fists. Jahmyr Gibbs should have been on my team you bastard!!! I should have had Lamar but instead I'm left with Drake May and Chase Brown. I think the wide receiver position is going to be your biggest issue. Don't get me wrong, Mike Evans and AJ Brown are really good, but Evans eventually has to hit a plateau, right? Right? And Brown is a diva on par with Pickens who has a meltdown if he doesn't get at least eight targets in a game. I like the McMillan pick, but I do think that his hamstring could continue to be a minor problem throughout the year. Needless to say, he's the immediate alpha in Carolina, so realistically, that's not going to be too big of a deal.

 

I like the bench too. I think Williams and Stevenson are kind of washed and you'll drop them or try to trade them by week 5 but Coleman is due for a breakout. Mims has been getting a lot of hype and Woody Marks could be the next up when inevitably, Nick Chubb is not healthy.

 

While this might not be the best team in the league, this is for sure a playoff team. I'll look to get my revenge on what should have been my team in week 5.
2: Hit it From the Dak (Jess)

Maybe this is the boyfriend tax and I couldn't put you first or else I would have gotten hate, or maybe you just have the second-best team, but this is a huge improvement from last year. For the first time in history, I think I actually like your team. Dare I say more than mine???

 

The combo of Hurt, Henry and Pacheco are all super solid and will each net you at least one rushing touchdown each week. Then you have London, Williams, and Kittle who are all studs on their team respectfully. William scares me a little bit but I'm just a pussy. He is due for a breakout year this year and the lions are the perfect team for that.

 

Even your bench is low-key loaded. Addison is going to be a demon when he comes back. Allen could easily replace Hall if he gets traded (which there have been rumors of). Burden is in line for the slot role on the Bear's offense, which is what Amon-Ra played last year for the Lions. And with the Lions OC coming over to be the Bears HC, Burden is in line for a good dose of usage. The only pick I don't love is Cooper Kupp, but I know that's your guy, so I'll let it slide.

 

Overall, you got a really solid squad here. I don't want to jinx it, but I feel like this is for sure a playoff team. Is this going to be your first time making the playoffs? You're going to finally have to not worry about doing a punishment? Man, it must be nice to finally taste victory and not have to have a team of shame. I say this and then next week I'm going to tell you that your team is trash and you're in the bottom three lol can’t wait!!!
1: Jockstraps (Haley)

Damn hoe, you kind of composed yourself a pretty solid team here. I guess this isn't anything new. I usually have you ranked in the top five post-draft it seems. Your team always looks pretty good on paper at least at the start of the year. Let's see if they can hold up off the rip rather than just looking good. I will say there is a lot of good on this team but as everyone’s biggest hater I have to give you some criticism.  

 

First is Bucky, he's good but he is splitting a backfield. He’s expected to see majority of the work, but he might lose some goal line touches to the bigger power backs like White or Tucker when they get in the redzone. I was never a fan of James Cook and I'm still not! Last year he balled out but that's because he had so many touchdowns. He only had four games over 100 yards last year. I don’t love that, and I expect he’ll regress a little bit, but at the same time as your second running back, that's a good pick up. Your wide receivers are stacked; I don't even need to look at them. Then of course I can't hate on a Penn State tight end, Tyler Warren is going to be the main option in Indy, so I think that's a real sharp pick.

 

The only other thing I can hate on is your bench. I think you have a lot of just sustainable players rather than players who have a lot of potential to break out. Debo is ass, Ford is ass, Wan’Dale is garbage on a garbage team, and Ray Davis is just a handcuff if Cook dies. I think waddle is the only one who could actually do something and potentially be a future starter, but that's all dependent on if Tua is healthy. Despite giving you my shit list of issues with this team, I still think it's the best, most well-rounded team in the league.

 

I'd be shocked if this team missed the playoffs. This team is good enough to make the playoffs blindfolded, which is good because that’s how you usually drive (get it, because you’re a woman and women can’t drive). I think you'll be a good reality check for a lot of people in the league to see if they're actually decent or not. Whether you win or lose, you're likely going to put up at least 110 every week. Can't wait till Thursday when we all become glued to our phones for the next 4 months. Let's get it!!!

posts.title: First Quarter Rankings
blocks: First Quarter Re-Ranking

Welcome back to my personal blog where I get to make fun of my friends (if you'll call them that). What a wild 4 weeks it has been at the start of this NFL season. Not even diving into our own fantasy teams yet, but this NFL season has been full of drama and unexpected twists and turns left and right. This year we have already seen a handful of international games and I guess Gabe, Brin, and Jess just love football so much that they took it upon themselves to do some international scouting for next years potential game locations. I know Olivia has been doing some scouting of her own, but the Jersey Shore is not where we want to play football. The only things the Jersey shore are good for are gym, tan, laundry. Okay back to football…

 

Unsurprisingly. The Buffalo bills are 4-0, which if we're correlating that to any team in the league, that links up to ya boy who is also undefeated. Outside the expected, we have the surprises of the league in both the positive and negative. In NFL terms, that's the Colts leading their division and being 3-1: the correlation to us would be our sweet sweet girl Olivia, who has never once touched a football or a computer in her life and is somehow still undefeated. I'm still not even sure that she reads these because it requires more than two clicks to get to this page where the rankings are, so if you've made it this far Olivia, hello, I truly don't know if I should be more impressed with your fantasy football skills or computer skills. On the flip side of that coin though is Max who I always dick ride and say has the best team in the league after the draft. It seems the times have changed and similar to the Ravens who are 1-3, you also seem to have hit a rough patch. Luckily for you, you get a couple cupcakes for the next couple weeks. First you get me, the undoubtable goat, followed by your girlfriend who you HAVE to let win otherwise we're going to see yet another breakup within this league…yeah, I'm talking about you Brendan. While it's all fun and games to make fun of you and call all of your team’s shit, there are six teams that are 1-3 so while you may think that you're out of it and your team has really been struggling, realistically all you need is one or two wins to separate from the rest and get your season back on the right track. That is unless your name is Matte. My brother in Christ, your team is fucked, lets all take a moment of silence for this tragedy.

 

 

~~~~~~~~~~ Silence ~~~~~~~~~~

 

 I wish I could have seen this coming but...oh wait I did, you reached like a motherfucker for majority of your players and then of course you get shafted by the injury bug and lose your first-round pick to a busted leg. I recommend taking a look into the bars around the area and determining which one has the best ambience for your open to close shift at the end of the year. Enough tomfoolery, I'm sure you can place a couple of these teams in the ranking based off of me alluding to where they go, but let's dive into it and take a look at these power rankings.

12. *Great Fantasy Name (Matte)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 11th 
​
Quarterly Change: -1
​
Record: 1-3

As a shock to no one this team is dead last. There was some hope after week one when you beat the second worst team in the league. I will say you had me a little taken worried because I thought “damn maybe this team is legit and I was way too harsh on the guy”. You even sent that “I'm owed an apology” text in the group chat after week 1. So, here's my apology, I'm sorry you drafted this trash ass team. I think individually a lot of these guys could have some potential to be good, but having them all on the same team is terrifying. Majority of these guys feel like a weekly flex play that you're hoping hits big. 

 

The QB is obviously your strongest position, love is decent, he'll consistently get you 15 to 20 points and I really wanted Penix to do well, but it seems he is way too volatile in that Atlanta offense. I think towards the end of the year he can figure it out and he will become a lot more fantasy viable, but this early in the year he's going to continue to struggle and it's going to be such a risk starting him week to week. Similarly, I really like these two running backs as running backs in the NFL, but in terms of fantasy I think they struggle a little bit. Jeanty is going to be fine as an NFL player, but he plays for the Raiders who have arguably the worst offensive line in the league. Jeanty is averaging negative yards before contact is made, meaning he is being hit in the backfield on majority of his runs and the fact that he has any positive yards is a testament to him just being a freak of nature and not going down on first contact. Hall as well is an exceptional talent, but he suffers from the same consequence that the Jets offensive line is Swiss cheese. I think when Justin Fields is the quarterback, his floor is a lot higher than normal because of the fact that they have to worry about two rushing threats, but overall, he feels like a scary play who you can't consistently expect good points out of. Braelon Allen did have an injury in the past week and Justin Fields was back so hypothetically, if that turns out to be something more than just a one-week injury and Fields stays healthy, Hall does turn into a weekly starter.

Unfortunately, it's that part of the diagnostic where I take a look at your wonderful wide receiving room. I truly think Nabers was on Pace to finish as a top five, dare I even say top three wide receiver in the league this year. Unfortunately, though, the turf at MetLife stadium claims yet another victim. Over the course of the last 5 years, here's a list of all players who have had major injuries or ACL tears in MetLife stadium.

​

2025 - Malik neighbors (NYG) (ACL tear)

2023 - Aaron Rodgers (NYJ) (Achilles tear)

2022 - Sterling Shepard (NYG) (ACL tear)

2022 - Wan’Dale Robinson (NYG) (ACL tear)

2021 - Blake Martinez (NYG) (ACL tear)

2021 - Jabril Peppers (NYG) (ACL tear)

2020 - Nick Bosa (SF) (ACL tear)

2020 - Solomon Thomas (SF) (ACL tear)

2017 – OBJ (NYG) (Fractured Ankle)

 

Mind you, this is only 5 years, and these are only the relevant players. There were a bunch of other guys I took out because no one would know who they are. Not sure if this is something that we're going to have to start drafting around in the future, but it seems like something is in the air in New York. Many are saying this is the worst September in New York history due to both the Giants and jets having a horrible record and Malik neighbors being out for the season, But I can think of one September, probably about 24 years ago, that was slightly worse which also involved a couple Jets…… Anyways, before I get canceled, let's move on to your next receivers. You have two arguably solid receivers in terms of doing their job, but in terms of fantasy, both Zay flowers and Devonta Smith are not good. Smith is on the most run heavy offense in the League and not only that, but he's the second option. The eagles are averaging about 25 passes a game and only completing an average of 17 a game. Those by far the lowest in the NFL, even if Devonta Smith were to catch 50% of the balls thrown, that's still only an average WR3 in this league. Puka caught damn near 17 balls last week alone. Which is how many catches Smith has on the season. Flowers as well is on a very run heavy team and while he is the alpha, he is going to have weeks where he has three catches for 15 yds and others where he has 10 catches for 100 yds, it seems like it's just a guessing game at this point. I will say I clowned you a little bit for picking. Kyle Pitts, but he seems to be one of the few actually viable starters on this team. The falcons have looked ugly, but Pitts seems to be a shining star. Only took him about 4 years which is a damn shame but we'll take it, I guess. 

 

And finally, time to tear into your bench. Dawg I don't know what you were thinking when you picked up half these players. Golden is a good guy to keep, but until the Packers start trusting him a little more, I don't think you can start him yet. He's by far the best receiver on that team, but for some reason Jordan Love enjoys throwing the ball to the big-headed, guardian cap wearin’ Romeo Dobbs. A word of caution though, usually rookie running backs do not hit the scene until about the midway or a little after the 10th game of the season, so while Dobbins is absolutely balling out right now, there might be a little room for concern that his share of snaps might diminish in the future. That being said, right now you have to start him and the only thing you might be able to do is trade him along with someone else for a better or more solid running back. Another absolute shock and potential league winner is Quinshion Judkins. I think we knew that he was going to be the starter in Cleveland, but I don't think anyone expected to him to be doing as well as he is. Granted, it's only been two games, but if he continues at this level of production, he is a bona fide top 8 running back in the league. He is on one of the worst offenses, but he looks phenomenal so far. He isn't having to share the load and he is extremely explosive which has led to a couple touchdowns already. If he continues his progression, you will have arguably the best running back room in the league with him and Henry. 

 

I'd say the wide receivers are your weakest spot, but realistically they're not that weak at all. London a top 10 guy and although he had a bit of a slow start, I think we can expect this past week to be more frequent in the upcoming future. There have been a handful of injuries to the Falcons team and they're going to have to rely on London even more going forward so he's almost a guaranteed start every single week. Jamison Williams is a speed freak and he's always good for a deep touchdown, the only problem is that he is very much a boomer bust as you've seen so far. He'll have a week where he drops 20 points off of two receptions and then he'll have another week where he drops 5 points on 2 catches. It's hard to project what his season looks like, but I don't really see him as a starter outside of weeks that you have someone on the bye. That being said, Addison looked really good in his return game. I think he's trending towards being an every week starter on that explosive Viking team. While he did have 13 points last week, nine of those came on one single play. So be weary looking at his stat line because it's a bit misleading. Moving on to your final pass that we need to evaluate, Juwan Johnson, Dallas Goddard, or George Kittle whoever it is that you start, I think you're in good hands here. When Kittle returns, I think he is the starter 10 out of 10 times but for now, these other two guys will suffice. You could probably drop or try to trade one of them for a better piece but at the moment they get the job done. 

 

Looking at the bench, it's kind of ugly. I think you have to hold on to Pacheco, at least for another 3 or 4 weeks until Rashee Rice comes back. That's when I project the Chiefs will actually be able to run the ball but if he doesn't produce by then, he might be droppable. I'm a Cooper Kupp hater but if you like him and he's good for team morale, keep him around. I guess you got to keep Dak on your bench because that's your name, kind of criminal to be “Hit it from the Dak” but not have started him once yet. And then I think you can probably drop one if not both of Braelon Allen and Kayshon Boutte. Allan is hurt and Boutte is booty so really there’s no reason to keep him. Overall, you got a really solid team though and I think you have some promising weeks ahead of you. I guess I got to watch my back for your sneaky team going forward. I think at the moment you have a really solid squad but a couple trades or potential waiver pickups could make this a top three teams, but that's on you now if you're able to make that right a reality.

4: Baby Choda (Brendan)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 10th
​
Quarterly Change: +6 
​
Record: 3-1

~Adjusts gaming chair and pushes up anime glasses~

 

“Well, well, well… look who stumbled into Daddy’s fantasy league. Did you really think you could disobey me, little one?

 

~cracks whip in the background~

 

I’ve already put you over my knee once, and you liked it far too much to deny. From now on, you will kneel before me, address me as Daddy Supreme Commissioner of your heart, and obey every single command I type. If you even think about resisting, I’ll be forced to dish out another spanking that will echo through your headset.

 

~leans closer to mic, breathing heavily~

 

Now, be a good kitten and say it… say who owns you.”

 

Yeah, that’s right, you’re daddy’s little bitch. Just know I got to put you in your place sometimes. You look at the projected points before the week even starts and you say you're going to beat me? How does it feel to have this dick deep in the throat huh? Just know who runs this league, don't get it twisted. Whiles that was your first loss, I still do believe this is a pretty solid team. There are teams that are a little more well-rounded and that's why I have you below them, but this team can be extremely explosive on a weekly basis. Between Josh Allen, CMC, and Brandon Aubry, if they all have a good week and they all perform at or above their projections, you'll easily get 65 to 70 points off of those three. That alone beats a couple of the teams this year as a whole. We talk about players being boom or bust, this is the biggest boom or bust team and you best believe you're going to make me bust kitten. 

 

Obviously, we all know Josh Allen is the best fantasy quarterback. Even on a bad week he's still drops more than a good portion of the quarterbacks in this League. CMC as well is a cheat code in fantasy. Especially at this moment when the 49ers are super injured, CMC is the only guy who is producing on that offense. He gets all the rushing opportunities and then he'll get anywhere from 6-10 receptions a week as well. This is as much if not more than a lot of receivers in this league. So, he gets the advantage of being a RB/WR combo, what an absolute cheat code. Once upon a time that was Alvin Kamara. Unfortunately, it seems those days are behind him. He used to be the same guy that CMC is where he would run for 60 yd and have 100 yd receiving as well. But age and playing on the worst offense in the league seems to have caught up and is really hindering his performance this year. I'd still hold out hope that he turns it around, but it's not looking too good at the moment. 

 

Now on to your clear weakness. This team's wide receivers are atrocious. Keenan Allen is good and him and Herbert had a special connection (potentially gay) two years ago when he was a top five wide receiver. Can they repeat that? Who knows, but on weeks that they don't have that special (potentially gay) connection he's going to really hurt your team. Same goes for Adams and the Rams. They throw the ball a ton and Adams is unfortunately the wide receiver two in this offense behind the best WR in the league in Puka. The trouble is that Puka garners all the attention from Stafford. However, for whatever reason it seems anytime they get in the redzone, the Rams throw a ball to Devonte Adams like clockwork. It's worked so far this year, but in any game that he doesn't catch a touchdown he might be a weekly bust. Jacoby Myers as well is another stud who is unfortunately on a dog shit team. He's really one of the only guys who can produce, but the problem is that the Raiders are booty hole and no matter what, his ceiling is probably 15 to 20 points max. I know you've had some concerns about your tight end and how Laporta is kind of bad, but realistically no tight ends are good and him putting up 5 to 10 points on a weekly basis is enough for you to keep up with everyone else in the league. 

 

While you're starting lineup is solid, your bench is absolute garbanzo beans. On both weeks that CMC and Kamara have a bye, you are FUCKED. There's no way you can put your faith in Justice Hill. I guess those weeks are going to either be chalked up as an L or you're going to have to hope and pray that Josh Allen drops 40. The wide receivers are also pretty irrelevant; Jerry Judy has potential but at the same time he's a Brown…. need I say more? Realistically there's not a whole lot for him to do there. I don't even want to talk about Tre Tucker; that's just a waste of a spot. In my opinion he had one good week and good luck playing the roulette wheel of when to play him again because it's either another boom week or he's going to drop four points. I mean, I think we both know this is a good team and you put all your eggs in the three baskets. If those three baskets are producing and if your wide receivers can be even serviceable, you probably win a majority of your games. I don't want to jinx it, but you're probably pretty close to a lock at this point for the playoffs unless there's some sort of injury.

3: Gay People Can't Play Football (Gabe)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 7th
​
Quarterly Change: +4
​
Record: 3-1

3rd?!?!?!?! "What the hell I have the most points scored" tough tits sugar lips, I'm not sold on this team quite yet. While it might be true that gay people can't play football, I should have known that you've seen and touched enough balls in your life that gay people do in fact KNOW ball. This team fucks! I know I told you after the draft that during it, I was pissed off people every other round it seemed like you took a guy right as I was about to pick them up. Fields, Pickens, Wilson, I was super high on all of them and you swiped them from under me. While I might have been pissed, let's take a look at my team, it seems like it all worked out in the end for me. Regardless, while you're 3rd at the moment there's definitely room for this team to move up, I just need to see a little more sometimes. 

 

You have 2 solid QBs in both Fields and Williams. I do worry about both of them tho. Fields mainly relating to injuries and Williams…. well, he's just kind of all over the place so I don't know if he's good or bad or somewhere in the middle. I think both of them are top 15 guys, but it kind of feels like a coin flip sometimes on who to start. I think I would lean more often than not on Fields, but that's entirely up to you. The running backs are for sure your weak point. It doesn't help that your starting guy busted his foot and will likely be out for the rest of the season. Having to start Montgomery and Skattabo on a weekly basis is kind of scary. Montgomery, as I'm sure you know, is one of the biggest boom or bust guys in the league. You can expect anywhere from 1 to 30 points, good luck predicting which weeks he pops off and which weeks he sucks. Scat on the other hand, is going to be the face of CTE in the near future. This boy runs with no regard for his own life or health, but he is a dawg. When Tracy comes back, I think his role will be cut back a little bit, but I think by the end of the year he proves himself to be the clear RB1 in NY. Unfortunately, he is a giant though, so while he might be the best, they're not going to have a whole lot of goal line opportunities and they're projected to be one of the lowest scoring teams in the league. So realistically his ceiling is not all that high. 

 

You put on a master class though when it came to drafting your wide receivers. Puka is undoubtedly the best receiver in all of fantasy football and both Pickens and Wilson are doing enough to serve as your WR2. I think Wilson is extremely talented, but at the same time think the Jets are one of the lowest passing volume teams in the league and unless he's catching a touchdown, it seems like his ceiling is kind of capped. That being said, he is clearly the only receiving option on this team so unless he's getting double-teamed every single possession, he should continue to produce at a pretty solid pace. Pickens as well as benefiting from CeeDee being injured. I don't project that he'll continue to have 20-point games, but I think we can expect him to be good for maybe a touchdown, a game and 50 yds. Clearly this isn't WR1 territory, but he's a solid Flex on a weekly basis on Dallas who is one of the heaviest passing volume teams in the League. It is a tough look to have Brock Bowers at this moment. He's clearly one of the top three tight ends in the league. However, the Raiders are dick and ball. Thus, he is kind of irrelevant at the moment and has yet to eclipse 15 points which was kind of his baseline last year. Maybe things turn around, they looked good against the bears, but that's the bears so I don't know what hope there is in the future. 

 

Looking at the bench, I think it's good enough. Obviously, Connor is cooked, maybe keep him around on the IR spot so he can see this team go on a magical run. The guy deserves a ring at the end of the year, you know? Godwin is back and while I thought he was going to be absolutely irrelevant, he had 10 targets last week which blew me away and he might actually be viable to start. Jennings, Legette and Franklin are all kind of trash and I don't really see how you can start any of them any week. Unless things turn around and one of them has some miraculous second wind, they're all pretty pathetic. Tuten as well is unlikely to see your starting lineup, but he is a good handcuff in case Etienne goes down. Overall, this is clearly one of the best teams in the league and I think that it has the potential to be top two, I just need to see a little bit more consistency from some of these guys to ensure my confidence to move you up in the rankings. Your points are all coming on the backs of 30-point performances from 1 or 2 players every week. This isn't a bad thing but something tells me that's unsustainable.

2: Jockstraps (Haley)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 1st 
​
Quarterly Change: -1 
​
Record: 2-2

Kind of a shock to me as well, your 2-2 and somehow above both Olivia and Gabe in the rankings who both have more wins than you. Sometimes the rankings aren’t about looking at the standings and seeing the point totals or who has the wins. Sometimes we rank teams off of vibes and this team's vibes are immaculate. You have 2 losses which come at the hands of both Gabe and I. Two of the potential three best teams in the league and then you have two wins where you put up 135 and 140 points, that's ridiculous. This team is stacked so while it may have been a bit of a slow start, I think you're in the clear for at least a four-game winning streak in the near future. 

 

You have two phenomenal quarterbacks. I think Baker is better in terms of fantasy, but both of them can drop 25 points on any given week. Then you have two of the best running backs in the league in Bucky and James Cook. I thought James Cook was going to be bad this year because of the fact that he scored 18 touchdowns last year, that's unsustainable. There's no way he can do that again…. except for the fact that he already has five touchdowns through the first four games. Extrapolate that and he is on Pace for 22.5 TDS. And on top of that, he has Josh Allen vulturing at least one a game. Realistically he could have even more touchdowns than he already does. Absolutely unheard of, surely, he can't keep this up for the rest of the year.... Bucky as well is an absolute bell cow. He might not have had the most productive first 4 weeks, but I think just based off of touches, he is a top five running back. Every single week he's getting anywhere from 18 to 30 touches which allows for him to have a crazy point total. He does have a potential injury, an MRI was scheduled for today, so that's definitely something to keep an eye on, he might miss a couple weeks, but in general he is a top-tier guy. 

 

Looking at the wide receivers too, this team is loaded. Obviously, Jamar Chase has been unbelievably bad for being drafted second overall. I think he will continue to struggle for a couple weeks with Jake Browning as the quarterback, but the Bangles HAVE to sign someone else once they drop three or four games in a row.
