Medium ugly, egotistical, and minimal upside. Alright I’m sorry, I had to get a jab in there. You’re in last place yet I ranked you this high, I gotta humble you a little. Your final pass catcher, Tyler Warren, is arguably the best TE in the league. While he is playing on what is statistically the best football team in NFL history, he’s not the main driver, so his value is capped.

 

The bench is very average. Most of these players are a coin flip as I’ve mentioned before. Ray Davis is the only one I didn’t talk about and that’s because all he is, is a decent backup in case James Cook goes down. Aside from that, there isn’t much to write home about. This isn’t a bad team — just unlucky so far. I know technically you have the least points scored in the league, but given this roster, I’m shocked that’s the case. The fact that Matte and Maggie are within five points of you is a testament to how dogshit their teams have been as well.

5: Brody's Beastiality Team

​Post Draft Ranking: 5th
​
Quarterly Change: +5
​
Record: 4-4

Alright Brody, so you had a rough start to the year, but this is low-key shaping up to be a championship-caliber team. You have a couple holes here and there, but the rest of your roster makes up for any weaknesses across the board.

 

Herbert is playing like a top-tier quarterback, and with their running backs going down, I expect this to turn into an extremely pass-heavy offense — which bodes well for you. Your running backs are also elite. Bijan is arguably one of the best in the league despite a couple rough weeks, and despite no performances to blow you away, Kyren has been really solid as well. It’s just a damn shame that every single time they get close to the goal line, they decide to throw to Davante Adams instead of using the run game. Or if they do run, they give it to Blake Corum. Still, I think Kyren is a top-tier asset, and there are certainly better days ahead for him.

 

The wide receivers are also looking pretty scary. JSN is a league winner at this rate, and I don’t see that changing anytime soon. You have talent with BTJ and DJ Moore, but they just haven’t produced yet this year. Maybe BTJ was overrated coming into this season, or he’s just not the same as last year in that revamped Jaguars offense. DJ Moore is unfortunately getting lost in the Bears offense behind Rome Odunze. He looked good the other week, but aside from a 50-yard play that should have been a touchdown, he’s been inconsistent and not fantasy-reliable. Hockenson at tight end seems irrelevant — not really helping, but also not hurting compared to the rest of the league and their TE situations.

 

The bench is honestly decent for this point in the league. Kyler has been disappointing, but as a backup QB, you could do much worse. Travis Hunter finally had a good game, but I wouldn’t expect that to happen consistently — he’s been taking more snaps on defense than offense and the obviously doesn’t do you any favors as a fantasy manager. Realistically, his ceiling is uncertain. I do like Tyjae Spears, though; since coming back from IR, he looks leagues better than Tony Pollard. Not sure how the backfield will shake out, but he’s definitely worth holding and using as a fill-in during bye weeks.

 

I like this team. It’s coming together nicely, and sitting at 4–4, you’re in prime position for the playoffs. There are a couple more talented rosters out there, but you probably have one of the best teams in a great position at this point. You do have a rather tough matchup this week, but hopefully things turn around afterward. Looking at the rest of your schedule, you only have one team I’d consider truly top tier, so if you close the year with only one or two losses more losses, I wouldn’t be shocked.

4: Team Conrad
​
Post Draft Ranking: 9th
​
Quarterly Change: +7 
​
Record: 3-5

Good old Marjorie Taylor Greene, the world’s least favorite Republican. It seems your team is being punished for your childish decision to move across the fucking country. If you had stayed in Seattle through the NFL season, this team would be destined for greatness. But because you chose to be a fake-ass hoe, this team is destined for a lonely 8-hour bar session in San Francisco, wallowing in your sorrows with no one to visit aside from Bordy and maybe Anne. I wish I could be there to make fun of you one last time but alas, I’ll have to make fun of you from a distance. That said, despite being ranked 11th in the standings, this team is low-key goated. Sure, you have the second-lowest points scored, but there’s a ton of talent across the board, and I’m shocked you haven’t won more games.

 

If I were you, I’d remove Aaron Rodgers from the starting lineup and slot in the electric second-year player Jayden Daniels, finally back from injury. Daniels being injured has for sure thwarted a couple games for you, but with Daniels healthy, we might see a completely different team. Your running backs have been solid. Obviously, I’ve been trying to trade for Achane, but you were smart to tell me to suck a fat one because he’s been killing it. Somehow, by some miracle, DeAndre Swift is also a borderline top-10 RB and I don’t know why. Despite me believing he is absolute ass, it’s working. Hopefully, the trifecta of Daniles, Achane, and Swift helps you secure another dub this weekend. Even on the bench, Travis Etienne is a solid flex option — not as good as he was early in the season, but still viable when you really need him.

 

Your wide receivers tho are phenomenal. CeeDee Lamb coming back has been a godsend, and Michael Pittman is sneaking into the top-10 WR conversation. I’ve called him Michael Shittman, Autistic, and many other nasty names I’m not proud of, but he’s proving me wrong. He has a touchdown almost every week which is contributing to him being a top 10 guy, but hey I guess it’s working and I gotta respect it. Terry McLaurin has had some injury concerns, but if he returns to form, your WR corps is set up for a strong final run. Travis Kelce, too, seems to have shaken off the Taylor Swift era (get it, that’s her gay ass song name) and remembered how to catch touchdowns in the end zone.

 

Even your bench is stacked. Most of these guys aren’t starters, but they’re solid depth. Calvin Ridley in Tennessee is the WR  1, Malik Washington in Miami since Tyreek went down has looked good, and Darius Slayton in New York is always sneakily good. I am probably not starting these guys, but they’re all worth watching. Somehow, you also snagged Tez Johnson, an underrated sleeper that only Brody and I seemed to know about. Bam Knight might not be fantasy relevant, but having him shows some real foresight.

 

All this to say: I like this team a lot. Despite your losing record, and minimal points scored, there’s serious potential here. Best-case scenario, you’re fighting for that last playoff spot. And as your greatest hater, I would wish nothing more than for you NOT to get it. Am I being a dick? Maybe. Am I scared of you? Probably, this team is sick nasty, and I do not want to face it come playoff time.

3: Hit it from the Dak (Jess)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 2nd
​
Quarterly Change: +2
​
Record: 4-4

Back to dick riding the girlfriend. I know I’ve said this a million times, but this is actually a really solid team. You have a couple holes here and there, but overall, this squad is well-constructed and set up for weekly success. Maybe there’s a weakness at wide receiver or Flex, but compared to the rest of this league, you’re in a strong spot. Honestly, facing this team feels like walking into a haunted house with hidden traps — you never know when it’s going to bite you (I wish you’d bite me).

 

Starting at the top, you have two of the best quarterbacks in the league for fantasy. The Tush Push merchant Jalen Hurts is guaranteed at least 15 points every week, and even when he’s off, Dak Prescott is throwing bullets in a pass-heavy offense. I’ve said this before, but if you weren’t my girlfriend, I would have aggressively tried to trade for Derrick Henry a few weeks back when he was struggling. You’ve got a hidden gem there — and while he had a rough start, there’s nothing stopping him from torching defenses over the next 6–7 weeks aside from Pittsburgh and Cleveland. Your RB2 is a little shaky, but realistically it’s not disastrous. Dobbins is serviceable, but if I were you, I’d consider packaging him with someone else for an upgraded receiver or RB. Quinshawn Judkins is another sneaky League winner — he had a rough week last week, but outside of Pittsburgh and Buffalo in Weeks 16 and 17, he’s set up for success in a bottomless pit of a Browns offense.

 

Wide receivers are solid, though a little spooky at times. London is a freak of nature, capable of exploding for monster games, but he’s also had some ghosts haunting him where he’s dropped a couple donuts. The Falcons’ inconsistency hasn’t helped — expect a couple more monstrous weeks mixed with some flop games. Addison is talented, but as the WR2 on his team, he’s capped — realistic output is 10–12 points weekly. I could be wrong, though; he’s outperformed Justin Jefferson recently, but mainly because he’s been stealing all the touchdowns. Kittle is a monster — if I wasn’t your boyfriend, I would’ve aggressively tried to trade for him when he was hurt. He’s basically the only receiving threat in San Francisco, and he’s locked into your lineup despite having Dallas Goddard as well. Maybe a two-TE look would actually be better than throwing in a scrub at Flex.

 

The bench is surprisingly solid for this point in the season. Your Flex spot has multiple options — Pacheco whose having a little resurgence, Jaymo, Goddard — all capable of booming weekly performances….or busts. Regardless, you have enough firepower to keep you competitive in an up-and-down matchup.

 

Overall, I like this team a lot. I know you’re nervous about the playoffs, but I think this squad is built to survive the haunted maze of the fantasy season. Despite being like me and having the second least points scored against you all year, this is a strong, scary team — the kind that could sneak through the fog and appear in the playoffs like Freddy Krueger waiting to strike.

2: Newpdogg (Olivia)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 6th 
​
Quarterly Change: +4
​
Record: 6-2

There’s something about you Erie girls that gives me trouble. My only loss of the year came to Maggie, and you gave me a real run for my money last week. Granted, I’m not sure how much of this is on Olivia versus Uncle Tom, but this team is looking genuinely spooky. You might not have many outright stars, but almost every player seems to reliably put up at least 15 points a week.

 

I’ll contradict myself here: despite saying you have no stars, you actually have the best quarterback in fantasy — Patrick Mahomes. He’s been unstoppable the past couple of weeks, even without all his usual weapons on the field until recently. Looking at the Chiefs’ schedule, there are a few tough games ahead, so he’ll likely continue to ball out. I hate to admit it, but you’ve got yourself a true monster under the mask.

 

Your running backs are also frighteningly strong. Both Josh Jacobs and Saquon Barkley are on pace to finish top 10, potentially both in the top five. During bye weeks, Jaylen Warren and Kareem Hunt are serviceable, and both have performed well over the season — solid substitutes who won’t ruin your lineup.

 

Wide receivers are a bit less terrifying. DK Metcalf hasn’t been stellar for the Steelers in terms of actual play, but for fantasy he’s been a consistent lock for your lineup, finding the end zone almost weekly. Ladd McConkey has returned from his early season slump and has looked solid. Justin Herbert clearly favors him in the Chargers’ pass-heavy attack. I should have tried to trade for him when he was shitting the bd but I am no fantasy mega-mind like you. Olave is decent, though he’s limited by the Saints’ struggling offense. Overall, your WR corps has flashes of monster potential.

 

Your tight end situation is fine — it’s not great, but considering how weak TEs are across the league, it’s basically a non-issue.

 

Now, the bench. I genuinely can’t stand how stacked it is. Three solid RBs and two solid WRs? That’s a starting lineup for some teams in this league. Over the past couple weeks, your bench has outscored entire rosters, including Matte’s team and last week alone, your bench nearly outperformed Brandon’s whole squad. You’re absurdly loaded, and it makes me regret ever inviting you to play this stilly little game we call fantasy football.

 

I’d love for this team to crumble into a haunted graveyard of missed opportunities, but I know better — this squad is playoff-bound. Chances are, the next time I see you, it’ll be in a championship game, and I will absolutely hate it. Paying Uncle Tom $200 and getting nothing in return is a nightmare scenario. Fuck you, Olivia, and your elite ball knowledge — may the ghosts of the season haunt your opponents as you march toward the playoffs.

1: Chrome Dome Clankers (Trevor)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 4th
​
Quarterly Change: 0 
​
Record: 7-1

​The King stays on top. Honestly, I'm not sure how I'm doing it, I have three really good wide receivers but the rest of my team is kind of mid. I don't know how it's happening but I need running backs bad or at least Zac Cahrbonnet to tear his ACL, then I'm set. Set, until now, though, I'm still sitting atop The League until I drop my next couple games against Brody, Gabe, and Jess since I talked to so much shit in this ranking. All of y'all can eat my dick, see y'all again in a couple weeks

posts.title: End of Regular Season Rankings
blocks:
Well well well, it seems that the end of the regular season is upon us and wow oh wow, what an end to the season it was. I mean let’s get the boring stuff out of the way first. The top team was ya boi, little T, whether it was a stat correction or not, the difference between 1st and 3rd is 2 points and I am him. They call me the god of fantasy, the pigskin prophet, the gay GOAT, whatever your favorite nickname or slur, it is undeniable that I smoked all of y’all...in the regular season. But now all starts fresh, and I get to get bounced in the second round of the playoffs when Max or Gabe has Gibbs or Puka break a football record and drop 55 points on me in one week.  

 

Enough about me though, there was definitely more drama in the playoff push. The girlies from Erie were FIGHTING and Maggie Dick slapped Olivia, but not only that, Olivia’s team shit the bed on that Monday night game, and she missed out on the playoffs by a measly 4 points. Had McConkey or DK caught just 1 or 2 more balls each, you would have been locked in. Maybe they should take a lesson or two from Gabe, he’s the king of catching balls and clearly so is the rest of his team. I have never seen someone have 2 of the top 3 receivers in the league on the same team. Yet you fall so short with the rest of that squad. I guess it’s all about catching and receiving, and you don’t care too much for tush pushing or pounding it down the hole.  

 

Anyways, I digress. There is still one thing I must layout before the commencement of the playoffs, the rules and what’s at stake. So, for those in the playoffs, Me, Brin, Max, Gabe, Brendan, Jessica, you are playing for.... you guessed it, the championship. Winner gets a whopping $225 grand prize while 2nd gets a respectable $50 and then third gets their money back. And of course, those in the loser's bracket (or the consolation bracket if you’re a libed up snowflake) are playing for not just your pride, but for a chance at redemption. The winner of the loser's bracket gets to choose where they want to draft next year. “Oh, that’s a stupid prize” yeah well, don’t suck next time and you get to compete for real money. Plus, take a look at Max who was the winner of the losers bracket last year. He is in the playoffs and has potentially one of the most dangerous teams. So, eat your pride and lock in so you can get a jump on next year's draft.  

 

Congrats on a phenomenal regular season to each and every one of you! Well, I guess not to everyone, there is one person who had an abysmal season. Who could that be??? Oh, that’s right, our good old friend Matte. *James Droz voice* (if you don’t know who that is please look it up or click the hyperlink) WHAT HAPPENEDUUHHH?!?!?! Your team was so booty cheeks this year, the whole league was aware you were going to be in last place since about week 7 when you were 2-5. Shout out to you for ending the year on a good note and getting a W over Brody, but damn this team was CHEEKS!!! I hope you have learned a thing or two from this year and maybe next year you don’t draft a rookie WR in round 4 and a QB who only played 3 games the year prior in the 6th round. There are many points to make on this team and why it failed, but we can chat about that over a beer....or two....or three....or eight...or nine while you sit at a bar from open until close dressed to the nines by your favorite league mates. I am super excited and can’t wait for this day to come!  

 

Okay that should finally be the end of this rant I call an introduction, so let’s hop right into the rankings....

12. *Great Fantasy Name (Matte)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 11th 
​
Quarterly Change: 0
​
Record: 4-10

Matte  

I mean what can I say, I saw it coming from the second the draft finished. My brother in Christ this team was ass. I don’t think I need to harp on that much more than I already have since I have legit been saying that this whole season. I mean I think you have good players and like they will all have decent careers but in terms of fantasy you could not have built a worse squad 

 

Like sure Stafford is good, but Hall and Jeanty, while promising young athletes, are on 2 of the worst teams in the league. They had a combined 7 rushing touchdowns all year, the consequence of your team never seeing the redzone. Jonathan Taylor, who unfortunately was taken 1 pick ahead of your first pick, had 7 rushing TDs over the course of weeks 5-7.  

 

Similarly, these wide receivers were about as useful as your sand wedge. They didn’t do shit all year. Both Smitty and Zay Flowers are on two of the heaviest rushing teams in the league, yet for some reason you decided they’d be great starters. I can’t give you too much shit though because you did catch the worse injury of the season being Malik Nabers tearing his ACL. I truly think he would have finished top 5 if he had played the whole season, but that is unfortunately fantasy football. The funniest part to me though is how this team has turned into a revolving door of players and for some reason you have transitioned to be the whole packers team. The starting QB, three WRs, and their backup RB is rather funny. They all suck from a fantasy perspective, so it made sense how they ended up on the worst team in the league.  

 

Alright, I’ve had my fun. I hope you like wasting your Saturdays, because you are destined to sit in a bar for a full day* and just drink yourself stupid while contemplating what went wrong. I’d recommend maybe building out a cheat sheet for next year's draft since there’s no way you could do worse than this past year. Honestly being hammered might even make your draft better. Good luck soldier

11. Here Comes McBride (Katie)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 12th
​
Quarterly Change: -1
​
Record: 5-9

I mean you had a good season for what it’s worth. You just happened to have the oldest and most fragile team in the league. Almost every one of your players from week 1 sat out at least 1-2 weeks due to an injury at some point in the year. Then on top of that, 4 of your players sat on IR for at least 4-5 weeks or were just ruled out for the whole season.  

 

That being said, you cut Joe Burrow which I think was a huge mistake especially now that Danny Dimes is fucked. Not that he is a guy you HAVE to hold on to, but you’re fucking over everyone in the playoffs because now Brin, the previous champion, has him and will likely go on a run here at the end of the year. So, if she wins and goes back-to-back, I will never hear the end of it and I will forever blame you for it since this is probably the closest, I’ll ever get to winning a championship.  

 

Really not a whole lot you could have done throughout the year. The only possible move you could have mad was to trade Amon-Ra for a haul of mediocre players that could have helped you get a couple more wins, but I think it was pretty clear after week 4 or 5 that your only goal was to avoid last place and you were not really fighting for playoffs or a championship, just fighting to save your dignity.

10: Jockstraps (Haley)​
​
Post Draft Ranking: 1st
​
Quarterly Change: -4 
​
Record: 5-9

Get fucked nerd, I had to beat your ass one last time just to let you know whose boss around here. It doesn’t matter the stats may be fucked up or whatever, I never had a doubt I’d kick your shit. Rounding out the season though, I have no idea what happened to this team, like still even now looking at it I don’t get how you had a losing record. I mean I know what happened actually, like Bucky got hurt and missed most of the seasons and Chase had an autist throwing him the ball for half the season as well, but the fact that you didn’t win more still has me floored.  

 

I guess it just wasn’t your year this year, and that happens sometimes. I mean not that I am an all knower of ball, but I had you as my best team going into the year and you fell flat on your face. I guess there are a few silver linings to look at here. 1: You’re not in last place and won't have to do a punishment (not that you care, getting blackout in a bar all day is your basic Saturday anyways)... 2: You have a really solid team, I’ve been saying all year and I think you have a legit shot to win the losers bracket. I think you can compete with the likes of Maggie, Brody, and Liv, but I was scared to rank you higher just because I haven’t seen enough from Bucky yet since returning from his injury.

9: Brody's Beastiality Team

​Post Draft Ranking: 5th
​
Quarterly Change: -4
​
Record: 5-9

Rough season, not much else to say. It feels like you did everything right and somehow still couldn’t manage to catch a break. Like you pretty much had a top 10 player for every position and yet still managed to get shafted week in and week out. Herbert 9th overall Qb, Bijan 5th, Kyren 9h, JSN 1st!!! Brownd D 3rd, like what more could you ask for? It's a solid lineup all around, and for some reason it just sucked, and they could never all be on the same page.  

 

It’s alright though, you get redemption here. You lost to pretty much every team here in the loser's bracket, yet somehow managed to beat almost all the playoff teams so take that how you will. I think among the teams in the loser's bracket, you have a pretty good shot. Maggie has a decent squad and so does Haley but aside from those two, the rest should be free. I really wish I could offer more insight into this team and the misfortunes that came to be, but I am so truly dumbfounded by how you had what I would consider an elite team yet only managed to pull out 5 wins.  

 

Get em next year, I guess?

8: Newpdogg (Olivia)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 6th 
​
Quarterly Change: -6
​
Record: 7-7

What a fucking choke job dude. After starting 7-1 you lost 6 of your last 7 and missed the playoffs. I know Uncle Ruckus is pissed that his niece fucked up his chance at permanent Seattle glory. I don’t want to be that guy, but I told you this was the case from the beginning. Despite you being 7-1 I knew this team was fraudulent. Saquon and Josh Jacobs are the only ones who did anything all year. Mahomo was alright but when it mattered most, he sold on you.  

 

Probably also stings that it was Maggie who ended your playoff hopes. I know you genuinely don’t care, and I wouldn’t be surprised if you didn’t know the playoffs existed, but I gotta give you some flowers for this being your first year and you actually doing so well. Yeah you lost at the end, but that’s fantasy football for you, 90% luck 10% skill, and 5% asking the commissioner to delete your uncle from the league so no one would know you’re getting outside help (despite legit the whole league knowing you because you showed up on draft day with nothing but a hard kombucha and thumb up your butt). Good shit though, I’m glad you decided to join us this year and hopefully you’ll make a return next year. I would inform you that the winner of the loser's bracket gets to pick their draft position for next year, but I don’t think you have a chance to win that. You’re not the biggest loser, so don’t sweat it!

7: Team Conrad
​
Post Draft Ranking: 9th
​
Quarterly Change: -3 
​
Record: 7-7

If anything, my girlfriend is forever indebted to you. Thanks to you beating down Olivia in the final week of the year, Jess was able to get into the playoffs for the first time in her sweet little fantasy football life. I know you don’t know that feeling yet, but maybe someday if you don’t take your bfs trash ass advice, you too can make the playoffs. Honestly despite not making the playoffs, this was kinda a big dick season for you. You beat Brody and Haley in your head to head matchups with them and finished above both of them in the standings then you went 1-1 against Olivia and cucked her of a playoff spot, and even despite losing out to me in the standings, you gave me my first loss of the season.  So realistically I’d call that a pretty successful season, when it mattered most, you went 4-1 and you can legit talk that shit to anyone of your homies.  

 

Good luck in the playoffs and I hope you win the loser's bracket. You’ve always been the biggest loser I know!

6: Gay People Can't Play Football (Gabe)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 7th
​
Quarterly Change: +5
​
Record: 8-6

Alright big dawg, it’s time to shut up and nut up or whatever they say. Welcome to the playoffs, but you unfortunately have what I would consider, the hardest path to the championship. First you have to go through Max and Jahmyr Gibbs who has been dropping 30 pieces like it's nothing and then if you survive that, you gotta go through the #1 seeded, undisputed best player in the league. And while you have a solid team idk that you’re built to put up the 130 points, I’d assume you’re going to need in back-to-back weeks to make it through.  

 

That being said, this is a really solid team. Caleb is up and down and has a pretty rough playoff schedule, but who knows, maybe he can ball out and save the season when it matters most. It’s the least he could do for the gay community. I think the RBs are dog water, but for some reason the bears have gone into a split role RB room as well, so Monangai has actually become viable over these past few weeks. He is 100% the goal line back and absolutely useless if he doesn’t score, but the bears have been in the redzone enough to the point where Monangai is earning his keep. Montgomery has faded into the back in that backfield, and there is nothing left to say about him. You have the best WR room in the league and usually I would say this doesn’t cover for the lack of production elsewhere, but you legit have 2 of the top 3 guys and some random role players on the bench that you seem to do a good job on guessing when they’ll pop off vs when they’ll drop a dud. Even on top of that you have the best defense and a top 5 TE, so the talent all around makes up for you having two second string RBs in your starting lineup.  

 

All this to say, it’s time for this team to lock in. I’m not happy to be on this side of the bracket and I’d much rather be on the bottom half with Jess and Brendan, but it is what it is and if either of us want to win a championship, we’re gonna have to beat these teams anyways. Good luck to you, I HOPE and PRAY I see you in a week because I do not want to face Max, but that could be a death wish too since any one of your players that isn’t a RB can drop 20-40 points on a good week. See you soon pookie ;p

5: Baby Choda (Brendan)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 10th
​
Quarterly Change: +2
​
Record: 9-5

How is this fuck ass team in the playoffs? I clowned you all year for being the Josh Allen merchant and not knowing how to draft a competent team and only relying on Josh Allen. Boy was I wrong; you know how to draft 3 fucking players and then the rest of it is all a game of luck for you. Sure, Josh Allen is the #1 QB, sure CMC is the #2 RB, whatever, I don't care, the MVP of this stupid fucking team is Brandon Aubrey. He has scored 145 fantasy points this year. The only people on your team to score more are your QB, RB1 and WR1. The rest of these fuckers were useless. My left testicle got more play than Keenan Allen or any other bum on this team.  

 

I like genuinely don’t understand how you kept winning. Even on your weeks where you had players on a bye, you somehow still found a way to win with scrubs who would drop 30 points. Fuck this shit, I hope Jess gets her get back from last week and curb stops this monstrosity of a team in the first round of the playoffs. If she doesn’t, I hope brin does, because god knows I would kill myself if I had to face you in the finals and Josh Allen drops 50, CMC drops 30, Aubrey drops 20, then the rest of your team combines for a whopping 20 points and I have to pay you $200 for that dogshit performance. FUCK YOU BITCH. Maybe this is your Icarus moment for this season. You have flown too close to the sun yet again relying on 3 guys and when one of them fails, you’ll plumet back to earth.

4. Fondle these Footballs (Brin)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 8th
​
Quarterly Change: +4
​
Record: 9-5

What the fuck bro? This team is some bullshit, and I don’t know how you keep getting away with it. This team is just a bunch of backups and wannabes that somehow have come together to make a passable team. I think this team is only doing good because no one in this league has a good roster. Like usually you look at at at least one team in the league and know they are the best. They have a good QB, a good RB, 2 good WRs, and a good TE. Not one team in our league has that, and I think because of that, there is so much diversity of mediocrity that you can get away with this lineup and keep winning. 

 

Obviously, JT is a dawg, but he’s been in a bit of a slump since the colts have been going through their struggles. Idk how much that changes with Danny Dimes out for the season, but he does have a pretty favorable schedule after next week. Rico or Chubba are inconsistent af, Michael Wilson is the most random player to be good with MHJ out. Collins is doing a lot better than he started out so that’s nice to see for a 2nd round pick, Fannin has finally panned out to be a bonified top 10 guy, and Katie stupidly dropped Joe Burrow. The rest of these guys are super booty cheeks, and it pisses me off they’re doing well. Like Tee Higgens is hurt but somehow still drops 20+ points, Charbonnet is the bane of my existence, Bo Nix can suck me off, and Rome finally hit a wall. I just don’t get how you had 9 wins and then got a 1st round bye. I’m not saying I have a much better team, but I am not sure how you came out of the pile of slop from 2nd to 12th. Good luck, I guess? I mean I wouldn’t mind seeing this team in the championship compared to the others in your half the bracket, but at the same time I am actually very scared of this team.

3: Hit it from the Dak (Jess)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 2nd
​
Quarterly Change: 0
​
Record: 7-7

Whoop whoop!!! First playoff run here we come!!! Sure, you barely snuck in, and it took a lot of help from Maggie on a night where Jalen Hurts had possibly the worst game of his career. But alas, playoff berth is a playoff berth. At least you didn’t have to stress about coming in last place this year like you have the previous 2 years. Idk, maybe I need to stop helping you. You were last, and now, you’re slowly climbing your way up the ranking year after year. Next year you’re gonna be the best team in the league and win the chip, so I think I’m done helping you.  

 

Okay on a real note tho, this team is dangerous. I feel like you have had a good team all year, but they have never all come together to put together the performance I know they’re all capable of. Like looking at this lineup, my base points for everyone is Hurts-15, Henry-12, Judkins-10, London-15, Williams-10, Kittle-10, Boutee/Addison (flex)-8, Broncos-8, McMantus-8 (I’d personally pick up the Patriots kicker again over this guy), but the baseline of this would be 96 points and that’s not accounting for anyone having a good game. We all know Hurts can easily drop +25, same for London. So, like if they all come together and have good games, this team should be beating down on Brendas fraudulent ass team. This is your week to get your revenge. Fuck him and that stupid ass team. No way Josh Allen drops another 40 points on the New England defense. No way Aubrey does another 24 on Minnesota, and there definitely IS a way CMC drops 30 on Tennessee, but 2 of his 3 big players having bad games is a win in my book. I truly hope you give this boy a beatdown and get to see Brin in the second round!!!

2: Chubby Ducker (Max)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 3rd
​
Quarterly Change: +7
​
Record: 8-6

It’s inevitable, I guess. I held off on the glaze of this team all year long. At the beginning of the year, I said you were mid, at the midpoint when you had like 3 wins, I said “it looks scary, but they’re all frauds”, but now at the end of the year when it matters most, I am back to my old ways of giving you the sloppiest toppy there ever was. This team is NASTY. It’s funny because I don’t think this is your best team that you’ve drafted, but somehow it has made it the farthest.  

 

Lamar seems to FINALLY be hitting his stride, but he does have a bit of a rough road for the playoffs. This week should be free against the Bengals (though he did only put up 6 last time they played) but after that he has a couple of tough games vs. NE and GB. Not easy, but if anyone can do it, especially while trying to catch the Steelers for the division, I bet he is going to put on a show these last few weeks. Then on top of that you have the best RB duo in the league with Williams and Gibbs. I don’t think there is a sole on earth who feels safe playing against Gibbs in the playoffs. Thankfully I have a first round bye, but even just being on the same side of the playoff bracket as this team, makes me fear for my championship hopes. Williams has been super solid too and I’m kicking myself every day for taking a trade with Katie for Hampton over Williams and AJ Brown that you offered. That legit would have been the biggest fleece of my life but I decided to be the league retard and pass on two top 15 guys. Instead, I wanted to keep Jefferson not knowing he was playing with a fantasy terrorist called “Nine”, fuck that guy! Tet has been looking phenomenal too and even though the Pats are still splitting carries, they have a pretty easy schedule down the stretch and should be able to both be sustainable in your lineup. The only “hole” I see is the flex, but all things considered, I think you’re fine. I am praying on your downfall this week because I do not want to have to face this team when Gibbs is playing the Steelers. You know how down bad I am going to be when he runs for 250 yards and 4 TDs, and not only is my fantasy season cooked, but so are the Steelers. Fuck this shit, I hate fantasy football

1: Chrome Dome Clankers (Trevor)
​
Post Draft Ranking: 4th
​
Quarterly Change: 0 
​
Record: 10-4

Okay one last time, sure Max might have a better team, but I don’t give a damn. I have sat at the top all year and I’ll be damned if I remove myself from the top now. In “theory” I have a great team, but in practice, I am scared. The QB situation is fine, the RB situation is fine, but my WRs are tanking HARD. Jefferson is playing with “Nine” and has not caught a TD since week 9 and hasn’t broken 100 yards since week 5, FUCK! Sutton is just super inconsistent, Rice is goated, but the Chiefs play the Chargers and Broncos, two of the best defenses in the league to finish out the season, and then Egbuka hasn’t had a TD or 100 yards since week 10, I might be cooked. Whatever, it’s been a good run and even if I lose, I can say I had the best record to cope with in some capacity. I hate fantasy, I’ll see y’all at

posts.title: 2024 Post Draft Rankings
blocks: Post Draft Rankings

Welcome back to fantasy football 2024! For those returning, glad to have you back, I can't wait to make you all my bitches again. And for the newcomers, that previous sentence was something we call a joke, I love all the people in this league and cherish each and every one of them. I am exited to begin this year on the right foot and actually have a league full of people I like!

 

However, it seems this year it will not be a 12-person league, in fact some of you have taken a page out of Drake's book (no I'm not talking about leaking a video on you playing with your gargantuan dong) and you have gotten some ghost writers, or should I say ghost managers. Let’s clear the air here and now so that we have a place to direct our anger and we don’t lash out on someone who is simply a vehicle for their ghost writers poor decisions. Below is the manager in our league as well as their exposed ghost writer. I had Drake's buddy Kendrick Lamar do the digging, so you can be certain that this info is accurate

 

Maggie - Codename: Margarine Butter                Ghost Manager: Bf Brody – Codename: Brodizzle         

Brin – Codename: Brian Vandepump                   Ghose Manager: Her cousin – Codename: Cuzzo X

Liz – Codename: Lizzo                                          Ghost Manager: Her revolving door of men - Codename: Mike, Matt, Tim, etc.

Jess- Codename: Jessie                                       Ghost Manager: Her chill af bf – Codename: Douchebag

Molly – Codename: Molly                                      Ghost Manager: Sleeper.com - Codename: Ur dead to me 

Matte- Codename: Motts Apple Sauce                  Ghost Manager: This mf has inside info I swear - Codename: Skete Carroll

Trevor – Codename: TT                                         Ghost Manager: His Sister, can’t blame me if I lose - Codename: The lesser twin

 

With that out of the way, lets take a look at who drafted who and give my expert, totally unbiased opinions on where I think these teams rank going into the season.
12. Baby Choda (Brendan)

I hate to do it, but someone had to have the worst team here. If it makes you feel any better, it was a toss up between you and the team in front, I just think they have slightly more depth and the QB wide receiver stack they have going in the only thing that saved them from being in this spot and not you. Regardless, you would have ended up down the bottom two no matter what. If it makes you feel any better, ESPN has you ranked at 11, so that’s gotta be a win, right? I guess the silver lining is it makes for a good underdog story, and you can laugh in my face when you go 3-3 on your fantasy football championships. Anyways, lets take a look at why I have you all the way down here at the bottom of my power rankings.

​

Starting from the top, you must be confused because you have arguably the best fantasy QB. I agree! However, the team starts to fall apart once I continue to check out who else is on the team. Your RB1 is Derrick Henry, King Henry. I think this is a great pick and he’s going to ball out on a stacked Baltimore team. I do worry a little because he is turning 30 this year and generally that’s a dangerous ago for RBs. However, he is a freak of nature and I think if anyone can combat father time, it’s him. He may lose some touches and goal line work to Lamar, but overall, solid pick. Mostert on the other hand is one that I am not very high on. He is 32 years old and he is unlikely to beat father time. Last year he did so well because the Dolphins were unbelievable explosive and he scored 21 TDs. What a phenomenal year, the only issue is I don’t think he will have a repeat of his best season at the age of 32, plus they now have Achane who is in his second year and much more reliable, quick, and overall better. The only shot Mostert has is that they share a lot of the work and hopefully they’ll be winning a lot of games, so he’ll get a lot of garbage time touches.

 

On to WRs, I think they are both mid as hell. Deebo is a good receiver, but as long as Aiyuk, McCaffery, and Kittle are there, there are too many mouths to feed for him to consistently pop off. I think Kittle is a great addition to your team too but the two of them will seldom score more than 20 points combined. Ridley is also a guy I have little to no faith in. He did okay in Atlanta a few years back, got suspended, went to Tennessee, sucked dick, and now I’m supposed to believe he’s going to have a great year since he is Jacksonville with T-Law? I just don’t buy it. He has to compete for targets with a handful of younger guys and I just don’t see him having a great season all around. Expect maybe 10 points max from him every week. Sutton on the other hand is a guy I like a lot. He had a phenomenal year last year with and aging Russel Wilson and I think Bo Nix is a huge upgrade. I could see him breaking the top 15 WRs since there aren’t that many other options on that team.

 

Final part of this is your bench. MR. PRESIDENT, A SECOND KICKER HAS HIT THE TOWERS!!! I’m not here to judge, but actually, I am, wtf are you doing with 2 kickers on your team??? Unless Nick Folk is the second coming of Mark Moseley (the kicker who won the NFL MVP in 1982), there is no reason to have him on your team and not someone else. Outside of Jerry Jeudy and MAYBE Adam Thielen, I don’t see any of these guys staying on your bench long term. None of them are going to have a large roll on their team and I feel like after a week or 2 there will be much better options emerging on the wavier wire than bum ass Alexander Mattison or Chubba Hubbard.

 

Overall, this team is likely going to go through a major makeover in the next couple weeks and I look forward to seeing how you spend you free agent money, that’s going to make or break this team. Goodluck, I look forward to seeing this team rise the ranks and make me eat my words.
11: Saquon My Balls (Gabe)

A familiar place for you on my power rankings, last year I had you near the bottom and you proved me wrong by winning a fuckload in a row. Let’s see if you can run it back and do the same thing this year. If there is 1 win, I can congratulate you on, it’s that you have a team name that isn’t team team team.

 

I think this team has a lot of potential, but it also has a lot of players who I think can flop. Obviously, the raining MVP is a great snag by you, but that’s about the only sure thing on this team. Saquon is on a new team, and while it is the eagles, you never know how they’ll utilize him. I think losing Jason Kelce, that O-line regresses a little, but honestly not that much. Also, Jalen hurts and the tush push was a hit last season, but without Kelce that might not become so much of an option. Why risk your QB getting injured when you can give it to Quadzilla in the backfield and let him either plow it up the middle or break some ankles. He’ll probably ball out, but I just worry a little because of the mobile QB and other studs on this offense who may take away from his workload. Montgomery as well is another guy I have my hesitations about. He played well last year but that was because the lions had a rookie that they were still exposing to the NFL. Montgomery was the lead back last year, but I don’t believe that is the case this year. He’ll still get some good touches and have solid goal line work behind arguably the best O-line in the NFL, but that’s his limit. He isn’t the pass catcher on this team, he isn’t the explosive guy, he’s the 3rd down role player who is gonna give Gibbs a chance to catch his breath on the sideline and then switch right back out.

 

Looking at the WRs on this team, this is my biggest hesitation. I do like that you have the Lamar/Flowers stack, but I just don’t know if Flowers is that guy. I think Derrick Henry going to the Ravens helps because teams are going to have to crowd the box and leave the WR’s a little more open, but I haven’t seen enough from Flowers to convince me that he is the main guy in this offense. Every team is going to put their best CB on Flowers and I think the best pass catcher on this offense is Mark Andrews. Not to say he’s not good, but I thought that was a little early to take him in the 5th round. Waddle is a little better, but he faces the issue that he isn’t the main guy on his team. Sure, Tyreek is going to take some focus from the defense, but Waddle is unlikely to become an alpha and dominate targets. His only balls are going to come when Tyreek is completely covered (which isn’t often). He can still produce, but I don’t think he’s going to be consistent at all. Your final WR is Tank Dell. I like him but similar to Waddle, he isn’t the go-to guy on his team. They have 2 other WRs who are known for dominating targets. Fortunately, Dell is known for the deep ball so if he is getting the ball, it is likely going to net you at least 3 to 4 points every single catch. I just don’t see consistency there, but then again who knows, that Texans offense is going to be lethal. Obviously, CJ Stroud can produce tw0 1,000-yard receivers, but idk if he can do three. I do like the TE option, with Diggs out and a rookie WR in as well as a few new guys that came from other teams, Kincade is the only piece Josh Allen has that he is familiar with. This will for sure play in his favor and I expect Kincade to be a top 3 TE.  

 

The bench is the last thing I’ll critique here. I think it’s alright. Ford is a great addition, but the rest are likely to be on the waivers in the coming weeks. Addison is good and had a great year last year, but he is dealing with a possible suspension as well as losing a good QB, he’ll now have Bradford who as we know, isn’t good. The only other player on this bench that I think is valuable, outside Cousins, is maybe Chig Okonkwo. He has sneaky potential and with a second year QB in will Levis, I think he becomes a favorite check down target and could produce.
10: Jockstraps (Haley)

I had a tough time placing these teams in the middle/back of the field. There was a clear top 4 or 5 but after that, 6-10 were all a blur and they are all so close to each other. You could be 10th this week and 6th the next, who knows. Though, I do think this is the worst of the mid-tier teams, but just barely.

​

You have Joe Shiesty, so if this team was built off sex appeal, you’d be first, however it is built off talent. He has that, but he also has injury history, and he isn’t mobile like the other guys in the NFL, so he loses some points there. PLUS, he may be missing his number 1 receiver to contract disputes so who knows how he does at the start of the season. Your RB room is what scares me the most on this team. I know you’re super high on Josh Jacob Jingle Heimer Schmit, but I am not. He’s getting old and he’s going to be splitting work in a GB offense that is very pass heavy. He should be alright this year, but I doubt he’ll be a top 10 guy at the end of the season. Zamir White too is a guy I have no faith in. He is on a shitty team that is likely going to lose a lot of games and not run the ball a whole lot due to that. Fortunately, he has Garner Minshew, the moustache god, as a QB so defenses will have to respect the run a little more than they usually do, but it still isn’t something I would count on.

​

Your WR core is probably the strongest aspect of this team. Hill should be a top 3 WR if not the best in the league. He was on pace to break the single season receiving yard record last year, but the dolphins were pumping the breaks and sitting him in the 4th quarter of games because they were often blowing teams out and there was no need to risk injury. This year I think he balls and breaks that record and not by like 50 yards. I wouldn’t be surprised if he had close to 2,500 yards this season. Diggs as well is a dawg, but I do worry about him on this new team. He is still the same alpha WR he has always been, however, there are now 3 other monsters on that offense that will challenge him for targets. He should be good, but I wouldn’t be too shocked to see him have 1 or 2 games of 15 points followed by 1 or 2 games of 5 points. I just worry that there are too many mouths to feed, and his points will be more volatile than the stock market under sleepy Joe. Aiyuk has a very similar problem to Diggs, he isn’t the number one guy on his team, plus he might not even be a 49er for long. If he does get traded, his value likely goes down. The teams he is in talks with are the Patriots, Browns, and Steelers. While they may be decent, none of them have the offense that the 49ers do, and his production will likely tank. If I were you, I’d wait for him to have 1 or 2 good games in a row and then trade him away to some sorry sucker for a fat price tag. I also really like the pickup of Kyle Pitts. He has been the laughingstock of TEs for the past 3 years, but now that he has a competent QB and offensive coordinator, I think he is gonna have a great year. He was a freak of nature coming out of college and Kirk Cousins is known for throwing a lot to TEs, so I think this is the perfect situation for him.

​

My last point of contention with this team is the bench. It’s honestly not terrible, I think it’s just not great either. I like Zeke, Allgeier, Palmer, and Kmet. They can all have a roll on their team, but I just don’t know how big it’ll be going into the future. Kmet is a good TE but with 3-star WRs I don’t see him having the breakout season among them. Palmer is on one of the best passing offenses, but I am unsure who the #1 WR is going to be in that locker room. Palmer is the most experienced and has the most chemistry with Herbert, but he was relying on Keenan Allen to distract the defenses last year and he was capitalizing off that. With Allen there no more, I am unsure who takes over. Allgeier and Zeke are in similar situations where they are both kinda backups or goal line backs? I really don’t know what their usage will be on their respective teams, but they are worth keeping around for a few weeks to find out.
9: San Diego 69ers (Liz)

For someone who had the first overall pick, you kinda fumbled the bag here. The team isn’t trash, thus, you’re not at the very bottom of the list, but for getting the best player in the draft, I just thought this would be a super team. You have 3.5 players I like in the starting lineup, but the bench is abysmal.

 

First thing I notice is the QB, CJ Stroud. He’s solid and I think with the new weapons he has on offense; he is going to ball out. I think this is a solid pick BUT I think you wasted a QB pick way too early. He is going to throw the ball a lot, but he doesn’t have the mobile upside as much as other QBs going in this range. For example, there is Lamar, Richardson, Hurts, who I’m sure were all taken, but it feels like you saw QBs going and just ripped the next best thing. I will stop harping on this pick because he is going to be good, but me personally, I would have waited a little longer and grabbed a better role player. RBs obviously will be carried by CMC, he’s going to ball out as always, but I think Joe Mixon is a little worrisome. The Texans are not a team known for running and even though Mixon had a great year last year, I don’t see that repeating. Especially on the Texans team where they have 3 dominant WRs and a super solid TE, he is less of a priority than he was in Cincy, and I think he’s going to struggle a little. He’ll probably be top 20 but not anything to write home about. Not that it matters tho because CMC literally puts up enough points for 2 RBs so in all honesty, it probably evens out fine.

 

Your WR room is a little scary in my opinion. I think the best pick here was Cooper Kupp, people are quick to forget that he was the best WR in the league prior to getting hurt. Sure, he has a little more competition with a young Puka Nacua on the team, but Matt Stafford is still the same gunslinger he has always been and both of them can eat on this team. Olave worries me because he plays for the Saints. They are likely going to be playing a lot of close games which usually means decent passing opportunities; however, he has Derek Carr throwing to him. Carr is getting old and is the QB that does the most checkdowns to his RBs. This doesn’t bode well for Olave who is a monster over the top. I’m sure he will still get some good usage, but I just don’t see him being that start you are looking for when you draft someone in the 2nd round. Keenan Allen also is a guy with some concerns. Age being number 1, he is 32 years old which is basically a boomer in the NFL. He is also going from one of the most pass heavy offenses in the league to one that ranks in the middle. Sure, they have a new rookie QB who looks REALLY good, but he also has a lot more competition. In LA his only competition was Mike Williams who is the king of injuries and Quinten Johnson who literally has bricks for hands, the guy couldn’t catch a cold in a blizzard. He goes from that to Chicago where DJ Moore is coming off the best season, they just added a rookie WR that they drafted in the top 10 picks in the NFL draft, and they also have a solid TE in Cole Kmet. I’m sure Allen will be alright, but there’s just too many mouths to feed for me to be confident that he is going to have a similar season to last year. I fuck with the TE pick though. I truly think he is going to have a breakout year in this Dallas offense. They did nothing to address their WR concerns and outside of CeeDee Lamb, there aren’t many other options for places to throw the ball. Ferguson is one of Daks favorite targets in the redzone, so I expect he is going to rack up a lot of TDs this year.

 

Now my favorite part of this review, your bench! I know you don’t know half of these guys and you were likely just picking them because you needed some backups, but I know every single one and am going to love to tell you why each and every one of them is ass as if you should have known this before drafting them. Singletary literally was balls in Texas last year, there were games where he would have 5 or 6 rush attempts and still be at 0 total yards. I know I give you shit for being slow, but I think even you could get 1 yard in an NFL game. You might snap in half the second one of those guys would hit you, but I believe that the half of your body holding that football would fall forwards to get 1 yard. He is in an ideal situation though; he just joined the Giants who no longer have Saquon. The RB room is wide open, but I have very little faith in him to produce. Pat Freiermuth is the other pick who I kinda agree with on this bench. He is one of the few players on the Steelers to eclipse 50 targets last year so while he doesn’t do great, he is a consistent option on that offense. They do have a new offensive coordinator who hates using TEs, but he might be worth keeping around. Okay now for the speed round! Moone, never was all that good in Chicago, in Atlanta he is the 2nd or 3rd option, I don’t think he’ll be great but lowkey if anyone makes me eat my words its him. Douglas plays for the Patriots who suck…. enough said (I did hear decent things coming out of training camp about him tho so keep an eye on him).
