Three top 12 WRs should undoubtably lead you to a winning record and playoff birth. I haven’t even mentioned that you have Mark Andrews who is the #1 target on the Ravens and is likely going to have yet another big year as long as he stays healthy. This team is looking dangerous

 

Time to talk some trash on your weak ass little bench. That’s what I’d say if I didn’t like your bench, however, every one of these guys is good and has some room for making that starting lineup. Williams and Chubb are both starting RBs. Granted they both had some pretty bad knee tears and are still in recovery, but when healthy, these two are dangerous. If Chubb comes back this year, he will be the biggest steal of the draft in the 11th round. The WR depth is also solid with Doubs and Williams both as emerging stars behind the main WR on their teams. I think they both play a similar role where they pickup the free targets when the main guy draws a double team. Last thing I’ll mention is Brock Bowers. The Raiders drafted him with a top 15 pick so obviously they are going to use him. I was going to pick him up, but I didn’t know we were drafting not one but two TEs per team. Don’t be shocked to see some trade requests for him a few weeks into the season.

 

I’m sure it was hard to understand me with your dick in my mouth, but I like this team a lot. I think the starters are all scary good and even your backups will all serve a purpose. Maybe it was a jinx when I said it last year, but I’m going to say it again this year, this Championship is yours to lose, don’t fuck it up.

posts.title: First Quarter Recap (Weeks 1-4)
blocks: First Quarter Recap

Alright, welcome back to this shit website where I get to make fun of all of you for your poor life decisions and also poke fun at your fantasy teams too. I know I pumped the brakes on this and have moved back to once a quarter of the season but take what you get you greedy fucks. I work so hard during the day, and I totally have no time in my schedule to write this, I swear I am busy 8 hours a day every day. Okay that part was for my boss if he was reading since I am writing this on my company computer.

 

What a start to the season am I right? So much has happened in 4 weeks. We have the Seahawks, Vikings, Commanders, and Steelers all leading their divisions. Never in a million years would I have predicted all of these teams would be doing what they are doing right now. Then on the other side of the coin, you have the Dolphins, Bengals, and 49ers at the bottom of their division, yikes you hate to see it. Idk if it’s just me, but I feel a little down this year, perhaps it’s because they aren’t showing Taylor Swift at every game. I really do miss watching football and then having her show up every single commercial break or timeout. Maybe we start a petition to bring her back. Clearly Mahomes isn’t happy about it either. He took to the field to show his distaste for the NFL my tackling his own player, thus resulting in a season ending injury. I know Kelce is pretty pissed too, he has frequently been seen in the box with her and not on the field. At least that’s what one might think with the way he has been playing so far.

 

I know I have gotten some mixed reviews about the waiver budget system this year. I personally am a fan because it doesn’t reward the shit teams with the best players, but then again those are the teams that have been bitching about the budget. Lmk what the rest of you think because going forward it could be something we could switch up (I would prefer not to tho; I think this is the fairest way to play). With that, I guess I can go into ranking these teams from worst to last. I am lowkey shocked with this year. Usually there is one maybe 2 teams that stand out to me as the clear alphas, however, this year it seems there are 4 or 5 teams that all look really good and then only a few that are a complete mess. Not naming names, but if the shoes fits…...jk you can probably figure it out based on the rankings. Give me all your gripes and moans when you read over this, it fuels me to know you’re pissed that I think you suck (at fantasy).

 

FYI, I don’t reread any of this, so this is all a one take crapshoot. If there is a spelling error, suck me off, if there is a grammatical error, eat my ass. You try writing 14 pages of gold and make no errors.

12: Jockstraps (Haley)
​
Post Draft Rank:10th
​
Weekly Change: -2
​
Record: 1-3

Well, someone had to be last and unfortunately, it is pretty clearly you and your team. Fortunately for you, it is still early in the year, and you can turn things around but your team has just seen some shit through 4 weeks.

Joe Burrow has turned out to be the biggest fraud the NFL has ever seen. The only time he ever shows up is when he is playing Patrick Mahomes, aside from that he is only good on the eyes. But with his new slim shady look and silent fake aura, he is not GOOD. I would highly consider going to the waivers and picking up anyone else until about week 7 or 8 when he remembers that he is actually good at football and turns on the jets. The RB room is just as I predicted at the beginning of the season…ass. Josh Jacobs is a good player but, on the Packers, he has struggled. He is getting the touches but has yet to see the endzone. Statistically, that has to change, I don’t think there has ever been a starting RB who hasn’t scored a TD all year, but who knows, maybe this is the year of firsts. I don’t even want to give Zamir White any time of day, I am better off not even writing about him since he has made 0 contribution to this pitiful offense. Perhaps this is contributing to why you are in last, but you are the only player in this league who does not have a single RB on your roster who has scored a TD (aside from Zeke, but he’s ass so I’m not counting it, plus it makes for a better one liner, it packs more of a punch). I don’t care who it is, but please for the love of God go pick someone up or trade for someone who has scored a TD and put them in your starting lineup.

​

The WRs where who I expected to be this teams saving grace; however, some unforeseen circumstances seem to be hindering that. Tyreek who I predicted would be a top 3 guy, has been the complete opposite and honestly, I would contemplate even starting him at this point. It was a cool experiment to see the two most fragile things in the NFL collide. But between Tua’s head and Damar Hamlin’s heart, it seems Tua is the more fragile and thus, Tyreek has had to suffer with some pitiful QB play. I’d bench him until the Dolphins trade for a better QB or Tua puts his life at risk again by standing in that pocket. Diggs has been a dawg and even though that Houston WR room is crowded, he still commands a good portion of the catches and fortunately the TDs. Aiyuk has been underwhelming especially since Deebo went down. Everyone expected him to take over, but he has just been mediocre at best. I would continue to start him since you don’t have much of a choice, but I wouldn’t be 100% satisfied or certain in doing that week to week. Kyle Pitts is trash too and I again don’t want to spend any more time on that since I am sure that’s already a big pain point for you. I have him in 2 of my other leagues and I am on the verge of suicide over it. Fuck Kyle Pitts

​

Last thing to critique, and my personal favorite because I get to be the meanest here, is the bench. What the fuck is going on here Haley? You got vaccine deniers, players without hamstrings (who is out for the year), and BUMS galore on this bench. I actually don’t hate it, and I feel like you have some good pieces, but at the same time they are all so inconsistent. Lazard and Kirk could honestly fill the hole you have at WR but then again that’s as much of a gamble for either of them as it is for Hill, I’d slightly swing towards Kirk more but who knows. Zeke is fat and that’s all I really have to say about him, he’s not touching the pigskin nearly as much as he should be and I think that’s because he might actually confuse it for a real pig skin and try to eat it, fat motherfucker. Allgeier is good to have on the bench pending an injury but that’s probably not happening anytime soon so hold him but don’t start him unless you have to. Then both Wilson and Mitchell are spawn of that one character from SpongeBob who has glass for bones. Neither of them can stay healthy and I would drop both since they’re just wasting space on your bench.

​

Final notes and recommendations: Find better RBs, idk if you gotta trade or just hope to find gold on the waivers, but you need something. Remodel the bench. Keep a few, drop a few, honestly doesn’t matter too much, you can’t get too much worse. That’s the one positive note I can leave this at, from here you can only go up!

11: Hit It From The Dak (Jess)
​
Post Draft Rank: 7th
​
Weekly Change: -4
​
Record: 1-3

Okay, I’m gonna keep this short and sweet since I know you hear it from me every week. I get that call every Tuesday saying, “I need help with fantasy, who should I add or drop”. I get it, I’m the fantasy god and I’m all knowing but you can’t blame me for what has gone wrong on your team. Ultimately, this is your team and all decisions you make are final.

 

Getting into it, you already have your love hate relationship with Dak in midseason form. Every week he’s either the goat and why you drafted him or he’s the worst and you need to go to the waivers to find a new QB. I think you should just roll with him, but you have your heart set on someone else week by week. Geno seems to be the newest fascination, and I am excited to see him ball out next week when he’s on your bench, only to shit the bed the following week when you started him. Ultimately resulting in you going back to Dak and dropping Geno or whoever else it is by week 7.

 

Almost exactly as I predicted (check the last power rankings), you have a STUD in JT and a BUM in White. I needn’t say more since you already have heard it a million times. Rhamondre is solid but playing for the patriots really hinders him. He does seem to get 99% of the offensive snaps tho so that is going in your favor.  

For the WRs, you have some pretty solid talent, but it is shaky none the less. Wilson is a prospect that everyone was super high on, but him and Rodgers have yet to sync up, thus making him look like shit. Stick with him, I promise it will be worth it. Reed is a great surprise! In that Packers WR room, no one knew who was gonna come out and be the alpha, but Reed has really stepped up. Love being out hurt his production for a week or 2 but with him back, Reed is a must start at this point. However, shifting to that flex spot, this is where there is a huge hole in your team. There is no one I’d consistently put in that spot. Michael Shitman is pathetic at best; Jennings is only a viable option with Deebo out (he comes back this week) and the rest are still unproven. I know I’ve been in your ear saying trade Goedert, but he is actually one of the shinning spots on the Eagles, especially with Pink Shoes and the Slim reaper hurt. He should produce for another week or 2 before regressing back to 2 points a game.

 

Not too much to say on the bench. Smith-Njigba and Jennings are the only ones I like, Johnston is still a coin flip and Gus the Bus hasn’t done shit. THOUGH my one word of advice is hold Gus because we are quickly approaching week 5 which is where JK Dobbins always gets hurt so he’s worth stashing for at least one or two more weeks.

10: *Great Fantasy Name (Matte)
​
Post Draft Rank: 8th
​
Weekly Change:-2
​
Record: 1-3

The name is gay. I know I told you to change it, but I almost wish you didn’t. Though it is fitting with Caleb as your QB, so I guess I get it, you’re trying to be as sus as your team.

 

Speaking of sus, let’s take a peek at those RBs. Holy shit they blow! Robinson is the only bright spot. I wanted him coming into the draft, but you swiped him so kudos to you, but the rest were all a swing and a miss. The fact that you have a backup RB as your starter should say something. And that something is “I am bad at drafting”. Swift finally showed up this week, but I have a feeling that’s going to be a one time thing. Ain’t no way he drops another 20-point performance. This man was on two of the best offenses in the leagues over the past 3 years in the birds and lions and still didn’t produce, now he is on the bears, and we are seeing his true potential. That is 1.8 yards per carry, what a MONSTER! I think you when you were high as shit on those drugs for your shoulder could get more yardage than that.

 

Fortunately, where you lack in RBs, you make up for in WRs. I will be the first to say I was wrong about Nico Collins. I thought Diggs was gonna outshine him and in that crowded WR room, he wasn’t going to get catches but boy was I wrong. He is off to a heater of a start to the season. You possibly have the best 1 & 2 in the league with him and Lamb. Lamb has been a little slow compared to what’s expected, but he is still going to be the number one in Dallas. Shaheed is clearly hit or miss but so far, he has hit more than he has missed, and I think you are blessed and going to be carried by these guys going forward. You win by the WR and will by the WR it seems but so far, so good. Kelce has been a flop of a player this year, but things seem like they may be turning around. Taylor Swift was complaining that her man wasn’t getting the attention he deserved, so Kermit took a dive into Rashee Rice’s knee in an effort to get the ball to Travis more. I think he begins to be more relevant in this offense and finally put up some points unlike any other TE in this league.

 

The bench is coming along, but at the same time it looks the same as most benches in this league. You have about 1 or 2 guys who are valuable, 1 who’s good for a week, and one who shouldn’t even be on a team. I’ll let you connect the dots there on who is who, but majority of these guys will only every see a starting role in your lineup during a bye week or when someone is hurt and you’re in desperate need.

 

Overall, this isn’t a terrible team. I like to find your weakest spot and harp on that, but this team is decent. I think if the WRs can stand out a little more and Kelce can come to life, you have a lot of room to move up the power rankings. I just have yet to see enough from Williams, Robinson, Kelce, and Shaheed to be 100% certain that this team is good.

9: Saquon My Balls (Gabe)
 
Post Draft Rank: 11th
​
Weekly Change: +2
​
Record: 2-2

Moving on up in the world! From 11th to 9th, flip those two and we’re talking about how your team is gonna do this week without either of your starting RBs (ur gonna bomb, get it like 9/11).

 

This team is in quite a predicament at the moment. You have a two-time MVP carrying this team with his legs. Unfortunately for you tho, he isn’t using his arm since you have his ~#1~ Target as well. I think this week will probably be your worst and you can likely chalk up an L. The silver lining is that you’ll have the best RB and a solid second for the rest of the season.  Which is going to go a long way for you since you have absolutely no backups. I mean technically you have Ford and Bigsby, but Ford loses his job in about 2 weeks when Chubb comes back and Bigsby is only good if Etienne pulls a CMC.

 

Aside from the weak ass depth at RB, the weakest point of this team is those WRs…. yikes. Flowers was supposed to be nice and I’m lowkey still holding out hope for him (if you want to trade him to me, I’m all in). Lamar and the Ravens seem to be hitting their stride and per usual, they are a ground and pound team. If anything is in your favor, it seems that Mark Andrews has finally peaked and is on the downhill so they are going to be forced to favor Flowers more if they do decide to pass, which is unlikely with the freight train, Derrick Henry, in the back and a QB who has more rushing yards than everyone in the league except 8 players. Tank Dell has unfortunately fallen off the face of this earth. We could have seen it coming with Diggs joining the Texans, but no one knew for sure. You still have a handful of guys who COULD produce but are very much a gamble. Both Addison and Waddle were projected to be flex players but have fallen on hard times in Tua’s injury and Addison also being hurt. I think if either of them will continue to ball out, it’ll be Addison since the Vikings look unstoppable (plus JJettas requires the defenses to double him leaving Addison open).

The bench isn’t bad, it has a handful of guys who are questionable or irrelevant. Like I doubt you’ll ever play Cooks, Davis, Bigsby, or Chig unless one of their teammates actually dies. And not to say it’s a wasted spot, but Kirko Chains hasn’t done shit. If his poor level of play continues, and the Falcons continue to lose, I wouldn’t be too shocked to see their 8th overall pick make an appearance. Sure, it would be stupid since the Falcons spent like 200 mil on him, but you never know. I just feel there are better options on the waivers who are actually gonna help you more than Kirk and the rest of those benchwarmers.

Overall, this team is mid, I actually had a pretty had time deciding the order from here to about 5th place. Sure, you’ll probably the an L this week, but going forward you are going to have some of the most solid and consistent play from you 1 throwing RB and other 2 starting RBs. You better hope they can make up for the flops that you drafted in WRs or at least hope if Lamar eats, so does Flowers. I know it’s early, but I could definitely see this team sneaking into the playoffs and creating an upset on the backs of Lamar and Saquon combining for 75 points.

8: San Diego 69ers (Liz)
​
Post Draft Rank: 9th
​
Weekly Change: +1
​
Record: 3-1

I hate to say I told you so….nah just kidding I love saying that shit! I FUCKING TOLD YOU CMC WAS A BROKE ASS BUM!!! Sure it was the logical thing to do, obviously draft the consensus overall number one guy, BUT the universe was against him from day 1. First of all no RB has been the #1 RB in back to back years since like 2008. Secondly, he was on the madden cover, it’s like you have never played madden or heard of the Madden curse. EVERYONE knows that the player on the cover of Madden gets hurt or has the worst year of their life, that’s just common knowledge.

Despite my little rant there, you actually have made a solid recovery. You got a steal in Jordan Mason since it was a Monday night game and you essentially had to add him or else you’d have had 0 points. Had they not played Monday, you would have had to compete with everyone else on the waivers and probably had to drop a fat bag to pick him up. And since then, Mason has been on a tear, he  has looked just as good as CMC did in previous years. It makes you question if CMC is even good or if he’s just a system player in the offense of one the most creative play callers in the modern era. Hmmm I wonder, maybe you should trade him away or drop him since he’s a fraud and likely wont be back for at least another month. HOWEVER, if you do make the playoffs and CMC comes back, I do not want to play you. He is single handedly the reason Haley won the championship last year and I’ll be damned if I lose to CMC twice in back to back years! Your complementary RB in Mixon is solid. Sure he’s been injured, and sure he is on one of the most pass heavy offenses in the league, but that should stop him from putting up 5-10 points every week lmao. It seems like quite the conundrum you are in with Mixon and Stroud on your team. Unfortunately, it seems they can not both succeed at the same time. It is as the old prophet, P.Diddy, once said give me the baby oil because you’re getting fucked one way or another. Either Stroud balls out and Mixon flops or Mixon balls out and Stroud flops.

 

As if I haven’t already torn you up, it is time to make fun of your sorry ass WRs. They aren’t bad, but they certaintly aren’t good. Olave has had a resurgence in the past 2 weeks but who knows if that is sustainable in this Saints offense. At first it was Shaheed who was getting all the targets, then it was Kamara, now its Olave, who knows who it’ll be the next week. 10 targets does bode well for him and I think that’ll hopefully continue but I would have him on a very short leash if I were you. Same with Mooney, he had 2 games where he looked pretty good, but then 2 games where he has been rather irrelevant. I think (mainly hope) that he has a shot of being decent once the falcons get it together, but that could be a longshot. Kirk Cousins has not looked good, and he has not found a favorite WR among his team. Between Pitts, London, and Mooney, who knows who will get the ball in that offense. You do have Keenan Allen who I would expect to fill the hole of any of these guys, but he has not looked good over the past month. He missed a few games and when he has plated, he has not been a viable fantasy option. Sure, they are still working out the kinks in that Bears offense, but Allen’s potential seems to be slipping away and dwindling week by week.

 

You know I always love this part. It is the most irrelevant part of the team, but the part where you have the most question marks, the bench. First thing that sticks out is you have 2 kickers. You should never have 2 kickers unless you have the number 1 guy who is on a bye week. Drop one of them for the love of god. I get Akers was on here in replacement of Mixon, but he’s back now so you definitely don’t need him, especially since he never eclipsed 10 points in the 3 games he started. Chandler as well is a big fat question mark. When will he ever play for you? He is only good if Aaron Jones goes down and even then he probably isn’t even that good. Neither DeMario douglas nor Jonathan Mingo have looked good over these first few weeks. Obviously they’re backup, but you could have at least picked a backup for a team who is going to score TDs. You got guys on two of the worst offenses in the league. If the main starters aren’t scoring TDs, there’s no way the backups are going to be scoring TDs, yikes. Ending on a good note, Freiermuth is a solid guy to have. Ferguson is better and for sure should be starting, but Muth is also a dawg and quickly becoming one of Justin fields favorite targets. If he keeps it up, in a week or 2, you may be able to cash in and trade him to the league idiot for a better WR to fill some holes.

I think this team is okay, I know you’re down bad without CMC, but once he comes back, you’re gonna be okay (assuming he comes back, reports aren’t looking too hot rn). One final thing I want to say is that I think you may have made one of the biggest mistakes this season by dropping Cooper Kupp. I know he is injured, and you already have CMC in your IR spot, but Kupp is an elite receiver who is going to be a huge role player in the later weeks. It just so happens that I conveniently noticed you dropped him and decided to add him. Sure, I won’t have him for 4 weeks, but when he comes back, my team is going to take off. So, when I win the title this year, I’ll throw you $5 and tell you to treat James to some Winco Salmon. I appreciate you. In all honesty tho, this team should finish in the top 6 and you should make the playoffs. You may barely squeak in, but you could for sure make some noise in the later weeks of the season.

7: Butker?I HARDLY KNOW HER (Maggie)
​
Post Draft Rank: 6th 
​
Weekly Change: -1 
​
Record: 1-3

Maggie will be Maggie am I right? I can always count on you to leave an injured player in your lineup at least once a year. Not that it mattered, your team was booty cheeks last week, but I just love the consistency. I know I had 0 part in helping create this team, but something about you doing decent actually makes me feel good. Maybe it’s an underdog thing, like everyone likes to root for the kid in a wheelchair when they give him the football and everyone fake chases him down the field while he scores a TD or how Spiderman and Batman show up to the make-a-wish kids hospital bed. It just warms my heart to see the league idiot popping off. I genuinely do like this team and if you weren’t 1-3 I would have you a lot higher on this list.

It seems you have moved on from one scrub at QB to another. Jordan Love to Brock Purdy, they are both decent QBs, just not for fantasy. They seem to be hit or miss but 15 points a week is serviceable and if the rest of your team decides to show up, it should be enough to get the job done. I am a big fan of the RBs, however they seem to be struggling a little. I had high hopes that both of them would be 10 top for sure and potentially both top 5 RBs. Unfortunately, neither of them are in the top 10. I think that can be attributed to the Jets just being the Jets and the Dolphins having a guy who’s head is more fragile than your feelings at QB. I expect both these guys to turn it around and eventually end up top ten as long as you have some patience.

The WR situation is also surprisingly solid. I knew Mike Evans was going to be a dawg, he always is, but Smitty was kinda a surprise to me. Sure Evans has flopped 2 games, but that’s his thing once game he’ll have 5 the next 25, it’ll all even out. Smith thos I think has been benefitting from the Eagles being injury city. AJ Brown was down and out so Smith took over, but eventually he too got clobbered and will sit out a week or 2. You do have luck on your side tho because they have a bye week so it shouldn’t affect you too much. I think you also got a blessing in disguise in Xavier Worthy. He has been very inconsistent and only amassed 4 targets in each game, which genraly is not good. BUT Rice just got hurt and is probably out for the season so it is likely that Worthy begins to take over. He has the highest snap percent among all rookies at 79% and he is now the #1 option assuming Kelce continues to be a bum. I wouldn’t be surprised to see him begin to flourish in the explosive offense and easily become a top 15 guy.

 

I don’t say this often, you can check everyone else’s rankings, but I actually like your bench. Very seldom do I go to a bench and see a handful of viable options. You have LaPorta who has been booty cheeks so far, but was the TE1 last year, defitnely worth keeping. You have Pickens who has the most targets among WRs who don’t have a TD yet. It will come with time, he has been rather unlucky with penalties and should continue to produce and get better as the season progresses. Even Jordan Love on the Bench is solid, I don’t think he’s good but he’s good enough when you need a quick fill in. I know Brooks is on your IR, but when he comes back, I have high expectations for him and assume he may be in that starting lineup on a every other week basis. I know Lockett hasn’t been great but he has been okay so worth kinda keeping unless you can find better on the waivers. Only one I don’t like is Austin Eckler. He is the fantasy equivalent of a crippled old man in hospice care who has every single STD known to man. Syphilis, gonorrhea, the big A (autism), this man should not be on a team.

 

In short, this is lowkey a good ass team. Get more than 1 win and you are for sure gonna move up the rankings. I like this team and wish you the best, unless it’s against me, in that case, kick rocks loser!

6: Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
​
Post Draft Rank: 4th
​
Weekly Change: -2
​
Record: 3-1

I like what you got going on here kiddo. This is a very cohesive team despite battling some injuries. I think there are for sure some holes, but they are rather small and can easily be patched up. $45 on wicks on the waiver is a little step, BUT I actually really like the move. At the beginning of the season, he was my #1 that I thought was going to pop off. Sure he had a few slow weeks and originally Molly had him. You earned him and I can only hope he does good things for your team.

 

In terms of QB play, Sam Darnold has been on a monumental run and honestly he looks really good. It also really helps that you have the JJettas stack so every time Darnold throws a TD to Jefferson, you get double the points (which seems to be happening a lot). DJ Moore has had a slow start to the season  with their new rookie QB but I expect as the season goes, that relationship will smooth out and they will start to link up for some pretty consistent and solid games. I was in your ear trying to finess him from you because I do have a lot of hope for him, but at this point, it is just that, hope. I know he’s a good player but who knows how the Bears will do, they are one of the most volatile and hyped up teams in the league with little to show for.

 

RBs are actually pretty solid as well. I think Kenneth Walker is legit one of the best in the league and I was hoping I could finess him in a later round. Unfortunately, we are in Seattle and I feel that may have skewed his value which made him go a little earlier than I would have expected. He is a top 10 potentially even a top 5 guy when healthy. That has been a bit of a concern though, he has already missed 2 games but when he does play he balls. I know you had Pacheco and I think he is also arguably one of the best in the league. He very sadly went down and will be out for a handful of week. I think the report was 6-8 weeks SOOOOO hypothetically if you want to trade him away, I could probably offer you a piece that would fill a hole in your team now rather than waiting. Moss is a viable fill in for now, but he is splitting the backfield work with Chase Brown almost 50/50. The unfair part though is that Chase Brown is getting all the goal line work. I believe in the past 2 weeks Brown has seen 4 snaps on the goal line and Moss only 1. You better not be betting on him scoring any touchdowns because those may be scarce in the upcoming weeks.

 

The bench here is actually really good. Both RBs will put up around 10 points a week. Dobbins does worry me because he is always an injury risk, but as of now he is balling. And Bucky has been taking over that backfield with shit ass Rashadd White losing work. I wouldn’t be surprised if long term Irving is the starter. Shakir is a really good guy to have, I have him in a handful of leagues and I am hesitant to start him, but he is Josh Allens favorite target so far. I think they are still working out the kinks but come week 7 or 8 I think we could see some real production from him. Higgins has been on a slow start and I don’t love him, in theory he should be having a much better year but in actuality, he has been underwhelming to say the least.

 

I do like this team a lot, you have a pretty solid core of players and just a few question marks or players who SHOULD get better throughout the year. It’s still a bit of a gamble with some of them, but overall, I think this team is in a good place. So far so good, 3-1 looks good on you. Also keep your mouth shut if you know what's best for you…iykyk.

5: Kamara Harris (Trevor)
​
Post Draft Rank: 3rd
​
Weekly Change: -2 
​
Record: 1-3

“Oh my god, Trevor is so bias, why is his 1-3 team above my team”, shut up you fuckin dweeb. Lets take a look at the real metrics and see what matters. I the 2nd most points scored in the league and only by ½ a point so I’m basically the leader in points scored. I have just been extremely unlucky. I have not lost a game by more than 5 points, every single game has come down to the wire and I have been on the losing side of this unfair world we call sports. I do so much for this league and this is how I am repayed??? I get shafted week after week after week, what more can I do? First it was JK Dobbins dropping 21 on me, then it was Hurts and Adams Dropping 23 and 21 WHEN I HAD KAMARA who had 40!!! Then to top it all off, I get Derrick Henry who drops 3 TDs and 34 points on me. Again I must ask, what have I done to deserve this? I have been fair, I haven’t made any eggrigious trades, I have tried to consult others and give good advice, I even helped tell people who to draft when I myself wanted those players. This is some BS and I am sick of it. If I don’t start winning, I am going to throw a fit.

​

I have 2 solid mobile QBs, I have the #1 RB, I have the #2 and #8 WRs, the #2 kicker, the #1 Defense. What deal was made with the devil to prevent me from winning.

It matters not what I do, I shall prevail. I have found a diamond in the rough due to Liz being a dipshit. I have found Cooper Kupp among the waivers. He shall miss time but when he returns, my team shall be UNSTOPPABLE. The championship is all but mine.

​

I would have ranked myself higher if I didn’t care about you tools, but I figured it’s best to be humble and let my team do the talking.

4: Baby Choda (Brendan)
​
Post Draft Rank: 12th
​
Weekly Change: +8
​
Record: 3-1

Jumping from dead last in my power rankings to 4th is a phenomenal accomplishment. Do I think this team is good? Ehhh that’s still up for debate, I only put you above myself because I am a humble and self aware king. This team reminds me of the great Greek story of Icarus. You have your little wings on, you have learned to fly. You are atop the fantasy standings with the most points socred, congrats! Ohhhhh but don’t get too comfortable young lad, I Dedalus have crafted those wings with WAX and your rise to the top shall soon fall as I see this team doing so! Poor Icarus, he was cocky, he thought he was all that because he drafted a QB first like a MORON. You’re too close to the sun young man, those wings are melting, your team shall soon fall apart.

​

Derrick Henry and Josh Allen are the bones of those wings, they are the backbone, they are always constant, but watch out here comes the wax, it’s Chubba Hubbard. He has projected you high in the sky, but he is not for long. Soon Jonathan Brooks will be returning and Hubbards workload shall be smited into oblivion. Then who will step into that role of your RB2??? Moestert? Mattison? Uh oh, he is falling, uh oh, that’s 4 losses in a row. Be careful young Icarus, you are flying awfully close to the sun. Stop now and make some trades before it is too late and you come crashing down to earth.

​

Ok I’m done speaking in tongues, all that was to say your RB situation worries me but your WR situation is even scarier. Deebo is a dawg, however, this dog resides at the house of Mike Vick. He has been injured and even though he is coming back, it’ll probably take a week or 2 to get back to normal. Aside from him, who do you have? None of these guys are consistent. They all either put up 2 points or 20 points and there is no in-between. Ridley, Sutton, Jeudy, Tolbert, busted up Thielen, I would not trust any one of them on a weekly basis. It is a shot in the dark every week but I hope it works out whoever you do decide to play.

 

Overall I think this is a decent team but I am baffled by how you are atop the league right now. You have 3.5 solid players in Allen, henry, Deebo, and Kittle. Aside from them idk who is gonna produce. But it seems it doesn’t matter too much when Allen and Henry produce 30 each on a weekly basis. Jk upon revision, I see you have Brandon Aubrey, that connects all the dots, that’s how you have been winning so much, it all makes sense now. I will beat the shit out of this team next time we play tho, don’t get it twisted.

3: Hurts So Good (Katie)
​
Post Draft Rank: 2nd
​
Weekly Change: -1
​
Record: 3-1

I stand by my post draft stance that this team is still goated. Sure you may have dropped a little but that is not at your own fault. If Kermit the Frog didn’t take out Rashee Rice who is likely to miss the rest of the season, this team might have eclipsed the first spot. Never the less, this is still a solid team that has just been knocked down to reality with the rest of us who have a solid core but are just missing a flex piece.

​

Hurts is proving to be a very good QB as always. Of course he had his best week when you were playing me, resulting in a win by 4 points (bullshit). He has been a little underwhelming though. For a 3rd or 4th round pick, I would expect him to be top 5 not just top 10. Sure I’m getting picky here and his whole wide receiver core has been hurt, but I was just expecting more. He will for sure get better as the season goes on but he is off to a shaky start. As expected, Kyren Williams is putting up points like his family depends on it. Somehow he has yet to surpass 100 yards, yet he is the RB4 on the season, that is a true miracle. Aaron Jones is making me eat my words a bit here, I said he was gonna be doo doo poopy stinky, but he has somehow put together a great start to the season and is the overall RB9. I am not sure if that is sustainable or if the Vikings are just on a hot streak, but until he goes bad, he is a must start.

 

The WR room is hindered with the loss of Rice, but Adams sould step right in and fill that role. He has not been playing to the standards everyone expects, but what can you really hope for? He is getting old and he is on one of the worst offenses in the league. There is a light at the end of the tunnel though for him (and part of the reason I just tried to trade for him). He has requested to be traded. Now this is a loaded gun, he could go somewhere that has a better offense and he emerge as the superstar we all know him to be (Buffalo or Baltimore). Option number 2 is he goes to another shit team like the Raiders and continues to flounder (Steelers). Or the final option, he stays in Vegas and continues to underwhelm. I am willing to take the chance that he goes somewhere good, thus my trade offer, but it is all a gamble at this moment. It seems no matter what happens, you are well suited to fill his spot seeing that you have Jakobi Meyers as a handcuff. So even if Adams leaves, you have the Raiders new #1 guy. A situation to keep an eye on for sure.

 

Your bench is a very interesting one to say the least. I like some of it, I am impartial to some, but this is one of the few benches where I don’t dislike anyone. McBride is a beast who has been suppressed so far this season, Warren is good, but injury has limited him. Corum is a phenomenal handcuff. Even though he hasn’t gotten a whole lot of work, he is great to have. Meyers as I explained previously is great. Benson is in the same boat as Corum. Of all the handcuffs for RBs in this league, I think those two and Braloen Allen for the Jets are the 3 best options and you having 2 of them is a good look. Then finally Michell has been not great, but he is a rookie on a wonky offense. If there are better guys out there maybe swap him, but I would wait on him, you never know when he is going to pop off.

2: Gridiron Gupta (Molly)
​
Post Draft Rank: 5th
​
Weekly Change: +3 
​
Record: 3-1

I said it once and I will say it again, I love this team. It has a very similar build to a lot of teams I drafted in other leagues. The two QB system is working great, especially with Kyler and Daniels. Those are 2 of the best mobile QBs and Daniels is playing out of his mind right now. Never would I have expected a rookie to be outperforming literally every other QB in the league. The last time that happened was back in 2015. This is where your bf lives in terms of fantasy. He has mentioned to me 3 or 4 times now “Back in 2015 I won the championship” and it was on the back of another rookie QB named Cam Newton. I don’t want to draw too many comparisons here or jump the gun, but Daniels could be that guy who balls out and takes you to a fantasy Championship. Lets not get ahead of ourselves, because you obviously still have to go through the goat (me) to win, but we can cross that bridge when we get there.

 

You have 2 unbelievable RBs starting. Bijan has been a little slow but that Falcons offense as a whole has been abysmal. Give him some time and he will for sure evolve into the fantasy monter we all thought he’d be. Cooks too is absolutely cooking (see what I did there). He dropped a dud this last game, but every other game he is exactly what you are looking for. At least 10-15 points with the chance of more always looming. I do worry that you don’t have a lot of depth. Charbonnet is good when Walker is out but Pollard is balls and Lloyd is out for the season so you should probably just drop him. Rico showed a little potential last week but I’d be hard pressed to trust him until we see a little bit more.

 

The WRs are nasty tho. Aside from week 1, Maserati Marv has been playing out his mind as well as Chris Godwin. I know I expected him to have a good year since he is back in the slot, but holy shit I did not expect him to be the overall WR6. Drake London seems to be your only miss but even with how bad Atlanta has been, he has been decent. Certainly better than a lot of other WRs that other people are starting. I see you got Wandale on your bench. I would take a look at him if you’re looking to fill a spot, he has been sneaky good and has been getting a lot of targets on that Giants team that is going to be losing a lot and forced to throw a lot.

​

Like I said, not a whole lot of notes on this team. The starters are solid, the bench is solid, the team as a whole is beyond solid. I hate to say it, but this team gives me a little worry since I think it is one of the few that could consistently give me a run for my money.

1: Picksburgh (Max)
​
Post Draft Rank: 1st
​
Weekly Change: 0 
​
Record: 2-2

I told you not to fuck it up with my post draft rankings and it seems you have done that. This team has all the right pieces and really only has some holes in terms of depth. I will say the best player on your team right now is Kermit the Frog. Sure he has yet to score more than 17 points in a game, but he took out Rashee Rice for the season. That is going to hinder Katies team who was in pretty close competition for this top spot. So while he may not be the greatest in terms of fantasy points, he is the greatest in terms of fucking up your opponents.

 

The RBs here are top tier. Conner and Gibbs are both hard runners who are almost guaranteed +10 points every week. The only time you are gonna get caught slipping is when one of them has a bye week (conveniently the week you play me). Javonte Williams as a backup is not a good look. I get that Chubb will be back eventually, but that is a risk of its own since he damn near lost his leg last year. He is no doubt a dawg, but idk how he will bounce back. Until then you have two studs and a hole when they are on bye. I think this week might hurt the most since when Gibbs is the better of the two. He can usually put up enough to cover for a shit rb but idk that Conner can do the same. Of course me saying this, now puts it into the universe that Conner is gonna have a 30 point game.

​

The WR room is disgusting. DK is a freak of nature and that Seattle offense is going crazy with him and Walker. I can only expect him to continue to add to his great start to the season as they play the Giants this week. Scary Terry has had an emergence as a solid WR with the help of his superstar QB. I knew he was good, but over the past 3 years he has had some of the worst QBs throwing him the ball. Now that he has a good QB, we are seeing what he can truly do. As if those two weren’t good enough, you got injured AJ Brown just sitting there on the bench. When he comes back, you are going to have potentially one of the best 3 headed monsters in this league.

​

There isn’t much more to say here, this team is stacked. The bench could possibly use some improvement, but in reality it’s not like you’re gonna need these guys with the way your team is playing. Williams is the only one who is likely to see play time and he has looked really good so far. Idk if you want to start him or flip him for someone better, but this team is already among the best if not the best. You’ve had some tough luck in terms of actual production but on paper and partially in real life, this team is a dream team.

posts.title: Second Quarter Recap (Weeks 5-8)
blocks: Second Quarter Recap

We are halfway through the fantasy football season and all no one has completely sold out and given up, What an accomplishment! I know there have been times where I’ve had to talk Matte off a ledge and Jess has called me in tears over her poor bench management, but if you’re not passionate about your team, are you really even playing fantasy football???

​

It seems as though most everyone’s teams are taking shape and everyone has hit their stride. Sure, there are people who stride may be the length of a midget’s stride with only 2 wins and then there are others who have the stride of Shaq with 6 wins, but that is neither here nor there. There is still plenty of time left in this season to turn things around. Oh, you went 3-5 the first half? Now go 6-2 in the second half and that’s what I call a playoff spot.

​

Going through the ranking order, I came to the conclusion that there are 3 teams at the moment that are fighting for their lives. If something doesn’t change soon, one of those 3 will be in last place and doing whatever punishment we deem fit (I have a running note in my phone of potential punishments). After those three teams, there’s a clear gap. Then I have 5 teams that are all similar in build and standings. In my opinion, these are all fringe playoff teams. From the looks of it, only 2 of them will be making the playoffs, but I wouldn’t be surprised to see any of them there. Obviously, some of these teams have a lot more work to do seeing that they only have a handful of wins compared to the other teams in this range, but if things go their way, I could see teams ranked 5th-9th all in a close race for the playoffs come week 14. Then finally, there is yet another FAT gap between these teams and the top 4 in my humble opinion. These top teams have a solid build and decent depth all around. Coincidentally, these teams are 4 of the top 6 in terms of scoring and all of them are in the bottom half in terms of being scored against. Is it luck? Is it skill? Probably a little bit of both, but nevertheless, we are at the halfway point of the season so let’s dive into my dogshit takes on your horseshit teams.

12: Jockstraps (Haley)
​
Post Draft Rank:10th
​
Quarterly Change: 0
​
Record: 2-6

You're already in last place in the standings, so I won't kick you while you're down, but this team is looking rough. Obviously, you have had some struggles, but a lot of it is out of your control. Sure, you never really had good running backs, but now your wide receivers that you had at the beginning of the year are all hurt. Originally your lineup consisted of Brandon Aiyuk, Tyreek Hill, and Stefon Diggs. These three were supposed to be your saving grace and pull you through the rough patch of having a weak RB room. However, both Diggs and Aiyuk are now injured and will be lucky to return if at all. I guess the one good thing is Tyreek is finally back. Maybe he hasn't had that phenomenal game (yet), but he is beginning to look like his old self where he damn near broke the single season record for most yards. There isn't much you can do in terms of replacing your whole team who's been injured, but I think you've done a solid job so far. Adding Legette as a wide receiver is a great move because Dionte Johnson was just traded so now, I assume Legette should be their number one guy. While that's all good and dandy, he's still a panther, so in reality you can expect 10 points max from him every week. I truly would like to help you at this point since it seems you're fighting to just avoid the punishment, so looking at the wide receivers on the waiver wire, I'll give you a couple people to keep an eye on. First, Sterling Shepherd for Tampa Bay could be solid, especially for the next couple weeks while Mike Evans is out. Two, Bub means for the Saints is also a decent fill-in since Shaheed is out for the season and Carr is allergic to throwing to Olave. Outside of Olave and Kamara, they don't have too many other options on that offense. The final guy, who is my personal favorite because I'm a Steelers fan, is Calvin Austin III. He is their Speedy wide receiver so he's likely going to get the deep balls which they have been throwing a lot more of. Plus, he is the kick returner so if he happens to score a touchdown (which he did last week), he gets points for that as well. It’s an extra benefit that sometimes works in your favor, but don’t anticipate it on a weekly basis. 

 

I would tear into the running backs, but I think you already know where I stand with them. Josh Jacobs is a dog. He's just been unlucky, but he did finally get one touchdown on the year, only took him 5 weeks. Chase Brown isn’t a bad option, but the Bengals seem to be struggling as a whole and their indecisive with who is their starting running back sure doesn’t help. Even if they do decide Brown if the better back, I can’t guarantee he’ll produce a whole lot of points going forward. He has one of the tougher schedules in terms of matchups. He plays the Ravens, Chargers, Steelers twice, and Denver who are all top-rated run defenses. I'm also hesitant about Bigsby. While he has been good these past couple weeks, Etienne is coming back so his workload should decrease back towards zero. Allgeier is a decent fill-in perhaps, but he seems very hit or miss as well. But you never know because Atlanta is retarded and doesn't know how to use running backs. They have arguably one of the best in the league, yet they let Allgeier get all the goal line work and every once in a while they’ll give him majority of the work.

 

For what you have, you're doing well, it just seems this team has been plagued by injuries. Perhaps it's because you won last year, the fantasy gods decided to smite you and injure your whole squad. Or maybe it's the fact that you still have Tom Brady as your profile picture without him on the team. I think if you picked him up (and he is available on waivers) things might turn around for you. I don't know what type of voodoo magic you need, but at this point anything is worth a try.

11: San Diego 69ers (Liz)​

Post Draft Rank: 9th

​Quarterly Change: -3​

Record: 3-5

A four-game losing streak does not look good on you…..yikes. I wish I could say I think things will turn around, but unfortunately, you play me this week so I doubt it. Looks like that four game losing streak is about to be five. I hate to be a hater, but you low-key deserve this. Anyone who blatantly and emphatically stands behind a racist deserves to be low in my power rankings. The fact that you have the 49ers defense after Bosa did his dirty little dance on national television baffles me. Here I thought you were a woman for women, but then again I should have known that you’re an Arsenault through and through, just like your brother. I know in that closet of yours, you have a pair of big ass overalls and a MAGA hat. I should blackball you from this league for this disgusting showing. You're lucky I don't take Nick Bosa’s picture, do a little photoshop with your face next to him showing your love and compassion for a god damn confederate. Sure, he does sexy Skims commercials, don't think I forgot about that, and that truly has been weighing on my mind when deciding if he's good or bad, but I think he just slightly edges out the good with the bad. Anyways, that's enough of my rant on Bosa. Let's take a look at this stinker of a team. 

 

With the running backs I can't really blame you for since your first overall pick has been out all year. You've tried to use Jordan Mason as a filler, however, after those first couple games he's really falling off. I don't know if it's the 49ers as a whole or just not able to run the ball, but he has seen a fraction of the work he was seeing those first few games, and the touchdowns have all but disappeared. Mixon on the other hand has been solid and should continue to be solid for the rest of the season. I think you're going to really struggle this week and perhaps the future in terms of replacing any running back on bye or god forbid, injured. Singletary has all but lost his job to Tracy, Chandler was always a backup, Johnston and Wilson are two guys that have played maybe 15 snaps total, so I doubt either of them will be of any use. If we played in a league where all the starters got hurt, you'd be killing it, but unfortunately it seems that the only starting RB who's going to get hurt is your first round pick in CMC lmao, you hate to see it. 

 

The wide receiving room doesn't get too much better. Olave is solid, but only when Derek Carr doesn't play. When Carr plays, Olave is irrelevant. Unfortunately, for you Carr should be back this weekend, so Olave should be back the three points a game that he has been used to. Mooney as well is very much hit or miss. Sometimes he'll have a big game, but other times he's going to drop single digits. It all depends on good ol’ Kirko Chanis, but that Atlanta offense has been so bipolar it’s hard to predict what’ll happen with them. There's no one I would like to see perform more in the Keenan Allen, but it just seems that he is super injury prone and can't stay on the field for more than two games at a time. I know he popped off last year, but he is kind of old in terms of wide receivers, so I guess it makes sense that he's having such a fall off. 

 

This team seems to have hit it’s ceiling after week 3 or so, but I don't see it getting much better from here. I'm sure you'll win a couple more games, but you're going to be struggling big time to avoid finishing in last. Dawg, you need to get it together, I can't imagine losing this league twice in a row. I feel like that's almost grounds for relegation. To be fair though, this team has just been a big old flop compared to what they could have been, it wasn't bad on draft day, but it seems like all these guys were drafted with a very high ceiling and a very low floor and they seem to be sticking mainly to that floor. You got six more weeks to hopefully get at least two or three wins to avoid last, but I'm not sure if that's going to happen seeing that you have almost the lowest points scored in this league. I guess there's nothing you can do except pray and start reading draft guides for next year.

10: Hit It From The Dak (Jess)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 7th​
 
Quarterly Change: +1​
 
Record: 3-5

For all the tears and stress that comes to me every single week, this team is actually shaping up to be pretty solid. I know you've had a lot of injuries and a lot of players who have been up and down, but they seem to finally be sustaining their roles. While their roles may be minor, your players have been doing enough to keep you out of dead last. I think you're running backs should finally be good to go. Assuming no more injuries, those two are studs and should remain starting for as long as they're playing. I've said it once, I've said it twice, I've probably said it 30 times, but I don't like Rashad White personally. I think he is not very good and there are currently two other bucks running bags who are doing just as good if not better than him on his same team. I feel like he's been at his ceiling these past two games. I know you're set in your ways, and it's been working so let it rock I guess, but me personally, I would not be playing him. Sure, I’m usually wrong and my advice may have hurt you more than it has helped so far, but that’s just my 2 cents. Aside from that, on the bench you have Zack Moss who is questionable as a running back since the Bengals themselves don't seem to know who their starter is. Definitely worth keeping, but I would be hesitant to play him anytime soon. 

 

The wide receiver core seems to be shaping up well, only took them half the season. Garrett Wilson, to my surprise, has not had a slowdown even though the Jets traded for Aaron Rodgers boyfriend. In fact, Wilson has seemed to be the one who's commanding the most targets on that team. I think the only struggle there is that the Jets are absolutely pitiful. If he was on my team, Jadyen Reed would make me want to pull my hair out every single week. It's either he's on top of the world, or he puts up five points and there seems to be no in between. I have always had trouble trusting Packers wide receivers since there seems to be about five of them who are all equally good. Unfortunately, it seems Jordan Love doesn’t play favorites so it does get you in a bit of a predicament. Regardless, when he's good he's good, so do with that as you will. Even on the bench though, you have solid replacements in Josh Downs and Ricky Pearsall. I think Downs should really pop off in these next few weeks with Flacco as the starting quarterback. Pearsall is a good guy to keep an eye on since the Niners have lost Aiyuk and Deebo in the past couple weeks. Sure, he's still a rookie and he hasn't gotten the full workload, but he's definitely someone you should stash and keep an eye on in case they do finally decided to utilize him. 

 

Overall, I think this is a respectable team coming together. I think realistically you probably finish between 6th and 8th, but for how this season started, I think that's a huge improvement from where you were expecting. You've had a lot of struggles with QBs (fuck Dak) but you seem to have gotten that figured out. You had running back injuries and woes left and right the first 7 weeks, but they seem to be coming into their own the right time. Your wide receivers have been all over the place, but I think you finally found a core three guys who you can consistently play. The rest just seems to be a crap shoot, but then again, that's what everyone else is doing when it comes to tight end, kicker, and defense so you’re not at any disadvantage there.

 

Side note: Now that you’ve gotten rid of that plague to your team in Dak Prescot, you gonna keep the name or is that up for remodeling? A couple potential ideas that I can think of are.

Steeler Nation, Let’s Steal (In honor of Russ joining your team)

Taylor Park Trash or Taylors Era Tour(For Jonathan Taylor)

Use these as a basis or use one of them idk, just trying to throw out some ideas.

9: *Great Fantasy Name (Matte)​

Post Draft Rank: 8th​

Quarterly Change:+1​

Record: 2-6

My brother in Christ, I would like to sincerely apologize. Not because I've ranked you low, or because I've talked shit, but because the fantasy Gods have absolutely taken a big old fat Cleveland Steamer right on your chest week after week. Looking at this team week one, you had one of the most competent and complete lineups with Lamb Nacua, Kelce, and Collins, I truly thought this team was bound for greatness. I was dreading seeing this team in the playoffs. Unfortunately, though, you've been hit with more than just a handful of injuries. Shaheed, Collins, Hollywood Brown, and Nacua have all either been inured for multiple weeks at a time or are already done for the season. Not to mention you have been getting absolutely bodied every single week. When it comes to points, you seem to play the high score almost every single week. Only twice has a team put up under 110 points on you in a game. That is ungodly how unlucky you've been. On the bright side, you've been able to win those two games, but still, that's just dog shit luck. 

 

I think you still have a adequate team and honestly if you win the next four or five in a row, I think you have a really good shot at making the playoffs. Brian Robinson and DeAndre Swift have both been going dummy on that dick, they've been doing tricks on that thing, scoring left and right. Hunt hasn't been as phenomenal, but he's been doing enough to get by week by week. Sure, he's going to have a fall off when Pacheco inevitably comes back, but for now he's getting the job done. Your wide receivers are finally almost all healthy and back to normal. Lamb and Nacua with Kelce at tight end seem to be consistently putting up 10 plus points each which should be enough for you to beat most teams that don't score over 110 points.

 

 The bench is good enough. I see Coleman has really been popping off with Cooper in town and Hopkins should hopefully get it together once he learns the playbook. How can you not do well with Mahomo as your quarterback? I really like the Bo Nix pickup, in fact, I'm pretty jealous because I need a quarterback bad and I was really hoping to get Nix, but it seems you are one step ahead. Honestly, I might even consider playing him over Williams at this point since Bo has been running a lot more and he has finished as a top 10 quarterback three of the last four weeks. I don't know why you still have Braelon Allen on this bench. Sure, he's a good backup, but you should avoid playing him at all costs. He's only good for like two points, a game and I know that had you not played him a game or two, you probably would have one or two more wins on the year. 

 

Overall, I really like this team, I just feel that it might be a little too late to turn things around. Obviously, that's not of your doing, but this is a really solid team and hypothetically if you drafted this exact same team next year, I feel like you're in the top five and no doubt out of the bottom five. Keep your chin up, I don't want to have to talk you off anymore ledges. While I think it’s a longshot for you to make the playoffs, I could very easily see this team winning the losers bracket which gives you the first pick for next year's draft or whatever pick you want in general (since the first might not always be the best place to draft, just ask Liz).

8: Baby Choda (Brendan)​

Post Draft Rank: 12th​

Quarterly Change: -4

​Record: 4-4

Awww poor Icarus, just as I had predicted, flew a little too close to the Sun and has lost three of the last four games. Those wax wings of yours aren't working any more, you couldn’t fake anyone out into believing that you were a god meant to fly as us mere peasants walked. Enough of the ancient Greek references, but it does seem that this team has been on a slow descent from the top. However, I feel that you may have hit your lowest point. While things have looked a little uglier over the past couple weeks, there's definitely room for this team to turn it around and get back on your winning ways. Perhaps maybe make some wings of hollowed out bones and feathers rather than wax. I am no master craftsman though so don't listen to me. 

 

I think you have the best quarterbacks in the league between both Baker and Josh Allen, they are two of the top five QBs, in terms of points right now. I know I've gone through my quarterback struggles as well as a handful of others in this league, so you should consider yourself blessed to have both of them. This guy has performed well above what I would have expected from him. I knew he was going to be the number one wide receiver in Atlanta, but I didn't realize that would come with a solid 15 points every game. It's crazy too because the falcons have struggled through these first eight games and yet he's still been undeniably consistent. I do stress a little bit because Darnell Mooney has been looking pretty solid, but London is still Kirk cousins number one read every single time. Until he proves me wrong, similarly to Cooks, you got to start him. Unfortunately those were your only options at WR….that is, until this past week when we made a nice little trade. I think the addition of Amari Cooper really helps this team out. Obviously, your players are going to have a bye week in the very near future, and I think trusting in Amari Cooper on the Buffalo Bills is a lot safer than W’andell Robinson for a shitty, inconsistent Giants team. Sure, Robinson has had his weeks of stardom, but they are few and far between. Don't get discouraged by Cooper's poor performance these first two weeks in Buffalo, he's still learning the playbook and I think within the next two weeks, once he figures it out, he will quickly become Josh Allen's favorite Target and put up some solid fantasy numbers. The only thing about Cooper that worries me is that he has some of the most drops in the league. But who can blame the guy, you'd probably be dropping balls too if they're coming from Deshaun Watson. Those things had to be oiled up by Mr. Massage hands and it's probably stupid hard to catch a ball that's been touched by him. Talking about the Browns though, you have one of the most elite tight ends in football right now. I don't usually mention tight ends because they seem to be an irrelevant position this year, but Njoku has been great these past couple weeks since Amari’s been out of town. It also helps that Jamis Winston is throwing him the ball rather than massage man. I wouldn't be surprised if he consistently puts up 10 to 20 points every single week and finishes as a top three guy by the end of the year. He's one of the few shining stars of that team and I think he will continue this path for the next couple weeks. 

 

There's not much left to say about this team. I've already given you your kudos and I've already taken the L in a head-to-head with you. I might still be a little bit skeptical because I personally was never on the hype train for half these guys. Apparently though I’m in the wrong and you are leading the standings in terms of points and wins. So maybe I should just stick a sock in it and watch greatness from a distance. Next time, do you want to write these power rankings since clearly, you're all knowing and can draft better and know more about football than anyone else in the league. Good luck the rest of the season, unfortunately I won't be getting my revenge game during the regular season. You better watch your back though because if it comes to playoffs I'm going to DM all of my players and ensure them that they pop off the week I play you because I can't have 2 losses to you. That would be purely embarrassing for me as a person and the commissioner of this league.

posts.title: Regular Season Recap (Weeks 9-14)
blocks: Regular Season Recap

What a season! It's been! 14 weeks of pure chaos where no one knew what the fuck was going on. We had games that finished within a point, and we had games that finished about 99 points apart. There were good teams, there were bad teams, there were happy teams, there were sad teams, but at the end of the day we only have one loser, LIZ!!! Hope you enjoy the waffle House or wherever you decide to go, I'm sure all of us will look forward to watching that either live or getting hourly updates. As expected, it came down to the VERY last week to determine the playoffs. Katie had the first-round bye locked up and Brin had a SPOT guaranteed, but outside of that, the other 4 spots were all up for grabs. Obviously, Molly and I were sitting on the outside and it seemed that only one of us would be making it. Though there was the fat outlier of Haley who was “statistically” still in contention. Nevertheless, ball don’t lie and there was some witchcraft and wizardry that went on leaving Max out and Molly and I in.

 

Sorry this is so late, homeboy was chillaxing at home this whole past week, so this is going to be a ragtag group of comment put together with the hope of finding some coherent sentences along the way. Just because the regular season is over and the playoffs are set, don’t expect my rankings to follow that of ESPN. That would defeat the whole point of this “blog”, why would I just copy and paste the BS that they spout and take that for gospel. Last time this site made its prediction was at the end of the draft and let’s look at how that played out. ESPN predicted that Liz would be the #1 overall team……what a fucking whiff. Maggie as the #3, Molly as the #4, and Matte at #7. In fact, they could not have been more wrong seeing that the 4 most bottom teams are all in the playoffs. Liz, you should have known your season was over when ESPN said you had the best draft. That’s why I was stoked to see myself at the bottom, I know ESPN doesn’t know ball and me being ranked dead last meant I was a LOCK for the playoffs.  With that. Let's peek at my honest to God, totally accurate, power rankings for the rest of the season. Peep the superlative I give your team, everyone was known for something whether it was good or bad, that's to be determined.

12: San Diego 69ers (Liz)
 
​Post Draft Rank: 9th
 
​Quarterly Change: -1
 
​Record: 4-10

You hate to see it Liz, you really do. If nothing, you're at least consistent. Last place 2 years in a row, you're my goat. You’ll go down in history as the freest of money every year. You sure you want to play again next year? I understand now why you only wanted the buy-in to be $15, you knew from day one there was 0% chance you would be fighting for a chance to win it all. All jokes aside, I think you just had some bad luck. That bad luck being named Christian McCaffrey. It's a tough lesson to learn, but it's a lesson you'll learn eventually. Never draft someone from your favorite team because it only leads to extreme disappointment. I stray far away from all Steelers because I know that I'm going to be pissed if not only do the Steelers lose, but my fantasy team loses too because one of their bums didn't do any good, it's called hedging your bet. You did have some surprise ballers on this team. Those being Darnell Mooney and Nick Westbrook over these past couple weeks. The rest of your team was rather forgettable outside of Joe Mixon who was your only stud. 

 

The superlative I'll throw this team is the biggest bust. I mean I could have told you this being that the ESPN predictions are almost always wrong. After the draft you were projected the number one team, they thought you were going to have the best season. They thought you had the most stacked team in the league. Whereas me, Brendan, Brin, and Gabe were all the bottom four ranked teams. All four of us made the playoffs, you see any correlation there? I don’t know that I expected you to do good, but honestly you did the best you could with what you were working with, but damn you hate to see it. Hopefully next year, you don't draft Christian McCaffrey or someone who's going to have a bust of a year. Unfortunately, there is someone every single year who drafts a guy in the first round that doesn't play, and it just happened to be you this year, there's always next year, I guess. I would mention that you could run it back and win the losers bracket, but I do not see this team being remotely close to doing that. I know you pulled some wizardry last year, but this is a much different team, and I would be shocked to see you win two of the last three playoffs weeks.

11: Hit It From The Dak (Jess)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 7th​ 
 
Quarterly Change: -1 
 
Record: 4-10
 
​

You know what I should have expected nothing other than this from you. A season full of tears, highs, lows, rage fits, hype wins, that's fantasy football for you though. And like many other teams, you were fighting until the bitter end. Oddly for you, you weren't fighting for a playoff spot, but you were fighting to be out of that last place spot. I liked the team you drafted. I thought it was super solid, you just had some flops, and I think there's definitely a learning curve for next year. We learned not to draft five players from the same team, I think Packers wide receivers are definitely something we should avoid next year. Fuck Jonathan Taylor and Jaden Reed, those two caused you and me so many headaches debating if you should play them, should you bench them, should you trade them, or should you drop them. It was a bit of a wonky year, but you made out and I think this is still a solid team. I don't know that you have the greatest shot in winning the losers bracket, but there is potential. 

 

The superlative I will give this team is you were the waiver wire warrior. There were teams in this league who hardly touched the waiver wires. Brendan was the lowest changing team only making three moves throughout the year, the average in the league was 16 moves per team. That means through 14 weeks everyone pretty much added or dropped one player every single week. You, on the other hand made 36 moves this year. You lived and died by that waiver wire. Every single week you made one, two, or three moves, adding or dropping the most random people, calling me and giving me grief for telling you to do certain things. Who am I to give you shit for it though, you're not in last place and that's all that matters. I know players are up and down but maybe next year pick some guys you really have faith in and rock with them all year. That's what Brendan did, and it looks like he's the number three team so who knows. You're my favorite waiver wire warrior though and there's no one else I would rather spend an hour on the phone with every week talking about who's good and who's not. It was super fun playing a game of roulette every single week with you to find out who was going to put up five points or who was going to put up 12. Can't wait to do it again next year!

10: Butker?I HARDLY KNOW HER (Maggie)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 6th
 
​Quarterly Change: -4 ​
 
Record: 4-10

I don't even know what to think of this team. I know last time we checked in with the power rankings I was giving you the sloppiest of toppy. I thought this team was playoff bound and I thought this team was sick nasty. Sure, you had some injuries, but this is a solid squad all together. I think you had some bad luck despite having a decent draft. Breece Hall was the biggest flop ever, Achane was injured and didn't really pan out. Evans and Pickens have both missed a handful of weeks with injury, the only decent one was Devonta Smith, he was your king of consistency. I still do stand by this being a good team, I think you just had some poor luck. 

 

Though that leads me to your superlative, this was the least attended team. By that I mean you did not give this team the attention they needed to grow. Everyone knows flowers need water and sunlight to grow. Similarly, fantasy teams need constant waiver additions and lineup switches. There were 3 weeks where you played people who were not playing, and I know there was at least one week where someone had to remind you to set your lineup. I don't think any of that would have made this a playoff team anyways, but it is something to note. I also think it's just funny to give you this superlative seeing that I know you try your best, but you're not locked in like the rest of us who are addicted to this. I don't know that you can win the losers bracket, but hell you can at least give it a try. Strategy number one, I would recommend switching out George Pickens who is again, not going to play. I know you though and it would taint your legacy as the least attentive team to change him out now. Good luck kiddo. This might all be a divine punishment for drafting Harrison Butker, which I don't completely disagree with, but the rest of the league seem to have beef with it. Here's a little joke and totally a joke ~wink wink~, but do you know why I didn't buy Jess a watch for Christmas? Because there's a clock on the stove and that's where the women belong. Big praise to my man Harrison

9: Jockstraps (Haley)
 
​Post Draft Rank:10th
 
​Quarterly Change: +2​
 
Record: 6-8

Tough year for you, I thought you drafted well, but I should have known with Kyle Pitts and Aaron Rodgers this team was doomed. Losing six of your first eight games hurts like a bitch, but you did a great job to turn it around. This team doesn't have a whole lot of depth, but you did pick up a couple people and drop some throughout the year which really seem to help. Your biggest gain was me dropping Chase Brown at the beginning of the season. This allowed you to pick him up and from there, the rest is history, he was one of your better players and helped cement you in a really good turnaround of this season. I know it was a long shot, but the fact that you even had playoff viability last week is outstanding. 

 

The superlative I'll give this team is the biggest comeback to no one's surprise. 2-6 is a tough look and I think I had you in dead last in the rankings due to the fact that I thought you were so far behind. I thought you'd be lucky to catch a couple Ws to get out of last place. Little did I know you'd be fighting for a playoff spot and have a pretty solid team going into the playoffs. There are a handful of other really good teams, but I think you do have a shot at winning the losers bracket if Tyreek and Chase Brown continue their dominance. Good luck out there, I'm curious and excited to see where things go from here. If nothing else, you can say at least you didn't get last place despite having arguably one of the worst starts in league history.

8:*Great Fantasy Name (Matte)​
 
Post Draft Rank: 8th​
 
Quarterly Change:+1​
 
Record: 4-10

What a season you had. I know I had to talk you off a ledge numerous times, but for how this team turned out, you had a really strong finish. Bo Nix is one of the better quarterbacks in the league, CeeDee, Puka, and Collins are for sure the strongest three wide receiver combination in the League. Kelce too is someone that had a rough start but panned out towards the end of the year. I wouldn't even say your running backs are weak, but on this loaded team they're your softest spot. Can't be mad about that though, seeing that they both finished in the top 30. 

 

The superlative I give this team, and I think we all saw this coming, is the unluckiest team of the Year. You had so many injuries to so many key guys which stunted your chance at winning. Not only that, but through the first 7 or 8 weeks you were getting absolutely shafted by matchups. You played the high score almost every other week and at one point you had over 100 points scored against you to the team in second place. Things slowly evened out towards the end of the year, but you still finished as the most shafted team. I do really like this team's chance in the loser’s bracket, and I think if not the favorite, you are one of the two teams I expect to be in that loser's bracket final. Don't prove me wrong, see you next year, hopefully in the playoffs.

7: Chubby Ducker (Max)​

Post Draft Rank: 1st​

Quarterly Change: -6

Record: 8-6

Call this team the 2016 falcons the way you just choked. I thought this team was a lock from day one to make the playoffs. Sure, you had some ups and downs and injuries, but I thought this team was phenomenal. You had great players all around and despite some unlucky play, you were in a top spot pretty much all year. Two fat L's at the end of the season led you to miss the playoffs by 13 points, but damn that shit hurts. I know I had you ranked stupid high all year long and I was the last person to see this coming. Even just watching the standings the last week, I thought it was Molly and I fighting for the last spot. I didn't even think twice about you missing the playoffs but here we are. 

 

I could give this team the biggest choke as the superlative, but I'll be nice, and I think this is the most well-rounded team. Sure, Mahomes has sucked this year, but for how bad he's been, the 11th overall quarterback is not terrible. He was undoubtably your weakest link. Outside of that you had Gibbs and Connor, two top 15 running backs. AJ Brown and Scary Terry, who despite not finishing in the top 20 are two super solid wide receivers. Even as a flex you had DK who I personally think might have been the biggest flop of this year. I mainly say this because I drafted him in most leagues and he did not produce like I thought he would, but still not a bad Flex option. Then on top of that you had the best tight end, I know he finished as TE2 technically, but Brock Bowers has been an absolute stud.
