posts.title: Week 8
blocks: Week 8 Rankings

Unfortunately, I did not have to get up to watch a whole lot of the NFL this week, but from what I do know it was quite the wonky week. There was a little bit of everything. The good, the bad and the ugly. We saw the good in the Eagles vs. Commanders’ game where it came down to the wire. We saw the bad in the Chiefs vs. Broncos’ game where everything just looked horrible. And we saw the ugly in the Jets vs. Giants game where there were more punts in the whole game (24) then there were points (23). 

 

If for sure was spooky season because There were a couple upsets this week, mainly the Chiefs, the Niners and the Texans who are all considered playoff favorites and potentially Super bowl favorites. It seems the same could be said for our league. There were four out of six games that were "upsets" due to the team with a lower record winning. However, pretty much every single game seemed to come down to the wire. Becka and I were separated by 10 points, Gabe and Brin were separated by 9, Liz and Jess were separated by 10, Matte and Haley were separated by 3, and Ryan and Maggie were only separated by 1. Probably one of the most eventful weeks which will definitely shake up the standings a little bit.

 

If we gander on over at the standings, we see that the difference between the 4th place and 11th place team is a singular game. So, at this point it seems that the playoffs are wide open. All it takes is a little bit of luck. Any one of these bottom teams would be lucky to lose to Adrian, Gabe or myself in the first round of the playoffs. This week was especially hard to rank all of these teams. I will say there are definitely tiers to the rankings. The bottom four on any given week can find them all shuffled around in the 9-12 range but I think that’s their max for now. The next four or five depending on how you want to look at it, can also be shuffled around depending on week-to-week matchups and injuries. Then the final three seem pretty set in stone with a very little wiggle room among them. So, with that, let's dive right in.

Record: 4-4

Woah you're in 10th place???? You got a win and you still dropped in the rankings??? Yes, absolutely. And before you start thinking too hard, get it out of your head that I'm bitter because I'm not. It took three of your players having their absolute best game of the season (one dropping a 40-piece McNuggets) and one of them having their second-best game of the season to catch a W. Meanwhile, three of my players had their worst game of the year and two of them had their second to worst game of the year. I guess a blind squirrel does find a nut every once in a while. Regardless, a win is a win and you are still doing decent….in theory in the ESPN standings. It's just that this team terrifies me. Mahomo is not the quarterback that he has been the past 4 years, statistically he is doing worse than Russell Wilson. I know you wanna dickride the old QB of your childhood, but he has been ass in Denver and for him to be better than Mahomes is an embarrassment to not only him but the Chiefs as a whole. Both your starting running backs and even the RBs on the bench all seem to really struggle. Among five running backs, they have collectively only broken 10 points 7 times in 8 weeks. The inconsistency is unreal and I feel bad for you having to pick one of them every single week and the roulette table of who's going to have a decent game this week and who's going to put up a stinker. The same can be said for your wide receivers. Similar to the running backs, these guys have no consistency. However, when they do score points, they do it big time. Adams had a week of 35, Lamb a week of 35, Davis had a week of 19, and kittle had a week of 26. While it may not happen often, these guys sometimes pop off and pairing that with Mahome's remembering how to play football, you can sometimes squeak out of W. While I do have a lot of negatives to say about this team, The one positive is that I know these players can be good. Unfortunately for you they all seem to have something really limiting them. Mahomes has no wide receivers, Adam has Helen Keller for a quarterback, CeeDee Lamb has an incompetent coach, kittle has 10 other teammates who are all better, and Gabe Davis plays majority of his games and frigid weather where no one wants to throw a football. I would love to see this team turned around, but I just don't think it's any of these guys years, despite what I thought at the beginning of the year.

9. Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -7
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 2-6

Yeah, I know you're surprised, I kind of am too, but comparing your team to all these others I see a lot more potential and seeing that you're only one game out of the mix, that should be kind of scary for some of them. The problem is that you're playing me next week. I have learned my lesson and anytime I talk shit, I lose. So, I am going to be very nice to you and whisper sweet nothings about this team in hopes that they do poorly and I can continue in my winning ways. Then maybe week 10, you can start to mount your comeback. I think your strongest point is literally Breece Hall. Without him this team falls apart. I think the wide receiver duo of Waddle and Addison is really solid, however, I do have my concerns about Addison going forward due to the fact that Perk Cousins is done for the season. I am hopeful though since they did pick up Josh Dobbs who should suffice as a gunslinger which we saw in Arizona over the past couple weeks. Even your backup wide receivers are really solid in Tee Higgins and Adam Thielen, I think you can plug and play any one of those in any week and go toe to toe with most people in this league. The parts that worry me is your second running back and tight end and quarterback. Brian Robinson has looked like a shell of himself these past couple weeks and if I were you, I would be kicking myself for not taking those trade offers that I sent to you in like week 3. I think when James Connors comes back, you'll be better, but you need it ASAP. Sam Howell seems to be balling, but the inconsistency is terrifying, especially for someone who can't afford a 3-point game out of their quarterback. I genuinely think that if you can win next week, this team takes a huge hop in the rankings. I would say good luck, but I don't want to be disingenuous, so have a nice day and I hope James at least makes you smile even if fantasy doesn't. That's about the nicest thing you’re going to get so enjoy it while it lasts. This is not how I was planning on ending national bullying month, but I guess I'll go out on a good note.

8. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 4-4

I'm sure you're sick of me saying this, but it's boom or bust with this team every week. Unfortunately, when they boom it's a mediocre boom. Aside from DJ Moore, no one seems to put up a 40 burger or even have the potential to do so. But when they bust, they bust harder than OG Mudbone (look it up) and they put up single digit points like nobody else's business. As much as I would have loved to see it, you fell a little short against Gabe, but there are definitely some signs of life from this team. Joe Burrrrrr Is back and hopefully for good this time. Saquon is actually putting out the despite the Giants being arguably one of the worst teams in the league. I don't hate this team, I think they're very mediocre and all aspects, aside from looks, but I think you're definitely in the hunt for the playoffs and for sure could throw an upset here and there to fuck up the rankings. Compared to other teams, your starters may lack a little, but your bench is very solid which hopefully will help you in these next couple weeks while a few of your players go on bye. I would say it seems like you have some tough choices to make, but I think it's pretty intuitive who you should play this week and pretty much any week going forward. Really not a whole lot of complaints, this team just isn't that sexy (on paper, they're very sexy in person) which isn't going to make me want to bump them up in the rankings, but if they get the job done, they get the job done.

7. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -4
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 4-4

Girl you are in trouble! Spooky season has come and it got your ass. Let's pour one out for the realest motherfucker, Percocet cousins. He'll forever be missed and honestly this is going to take a huge toll on your fantasy team. This week specifically you're lowkey fucked. No good quarterback, two dog shit running backs, the only thing that's been keeping you afloat is the fact that AJ Brown has been averaging 125 yards a game, but against the Cowboys I doubt that'll continue. Olave has done decent but still nothing to the point where he's going to carry this team like your other receivers. Mark Andrews is also a hit or miss carry potential, but that Raven's offense is sooooo questionable. I didn't realize how much losing this past week really hurt you. Fortunately, CMC is only missing this week. On the bright side, you're playing arguably one of the worst teams in the league, so even if you're missing a QB and RB, Maggie will probably forget to put half her players in, so realistically it'll be fair. Obviously, your biggest hole is the quarterback, but looking on the waivers, it's a crapshoot. Take your chance on Levis and hope that he can repeat what he did last week, but Pittsburgh is kind of stingy so I don't know if that's a great idea for this week. Baker might not be terrible, but he's not great. He might be the most consistent, but only expect like 15 points out of him. The rest could do decent but they all terrify me. My sneaky one might be Gardner Minshew but who knows if he is going to have a game like he did two weeks ago or if he's going to have a game like you did 3 weeks ago where one is 27 and the other is 9. I would say maybe trade for someone, but realistically you don't have a whole lot to offer aside from your best players. You could try to get a package for one of your best players, but I don't know if that's going to work or if that's a great idea in general. Regardless, this injury might be your downfall. I know you want to be a skinny legend, but this team was thin before on the bench and it's even more thin now. Not a good luck! If you lose to the Magtard next week, then this team's really dropping in the rankings! Don't let me down!

6. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +6
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 3-5

Wow, yet again you barely squeak out a win. Granted going into that game I thought you had it in the bag, but then I forgot that Stevie Wonder was the quarterback of the Raiders. I would be very hesitant to play Jakobi Meyers going forward or at least until the Raiders pick up a better quarterback rather than old sexy man Jimmy G. The wide receivers are a little worrisome as well. Kupp is lowkey getting less targets than Puka and if Stafford is injured, I think he really loses a lot of value. Pickens also has struggled since Dionte Johnson came back. He is no longer the focal point of this offense and seeing that this offense was booty cheeks before, his value goes way down. Fortunately, you have a couple people who can fill in on your bench, but this team might be trending in the wrong direction. I think there's definitely still a lot of potential, but you're pending a lot of questionable players and situations like injuries and which quarterbacks going to play each week. In the cases of the Browns, the Rams, the Steelers, or the Raiders, literally all your receivers are in questionable situations. Looking at the schedule next week, I think you have a relatively easy game that you could get a victory in. However, I said that about myself last week when I played Becka, and she beat my ass. So, in reality I don't know what to tell you. I still think this is a really good team, but there are definitely a lot of concerns I have as well. If things work out this is the top five team, if things don't this is a bottom five team. Good luck brother! The playoffs can still be reached, you probably just got to win out.

5. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -4
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 3-5

When I look at this team, there's two words that come to mind, volatility and disappointment. It seems like every week this team is either ballin for fallin', there seems to be no in between. Lamar either gets 30 or 10, Pacheco either gets 5 or 15, Schultz either gets 1 or 13. Then on the disappointment side Bijan has not lived up to the expectations, Aaron Jones has been unbelievably trash, and Scary Terry hasn't been great, but it seems he's finding his stride now. I think having Dionte Johnson back is huge, especially seeing how much attention he's been getting in just these two weeks he's been back. Even though the offense makes me want to kill myself, he still is getting a lot of work and targets. I say this every week, but your bench sucks dick. I doubt most of these players will ever see a starting spot in your lineup unless someone is on a bye or pulls a Damar Hamlin. All this shit talking and disappointment, yet I still think this team is better put together than majority of the teams in this league. You have dropped a handful in a row, but I still think you're in a fine position to make the playoffs and possibly cause some trouble for others.

4. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +5
Weekly Change: +4
Record: 4-4

I have had you up down and all around these power rankings. One week. I'm high on your team, the next week, I'm so down bad on it. I think we've gotten to the point in the season though where I can give a relatively realistic take. Despite you needing your kicker to get 16 points to clutch up this week, I can say, this is a good team. You have arguably the best running black combination in the league, one of the best wide receivers, and then a pretty decent supporting cast elsewhere. The quarterback situation does worry me, Calvin Ridley kind of sucks dick, and your bench is mediocre at best. But I can't ignore the fact that you have 3 top five players in their positions in my opinion. Even without a solid starting QB, you probably match up with most teams in this league pretty well, especially since a handful of other teams have lost quarterbacks or just never had a good one from the start. I still be your ass, but I wouldn't bet that I could do it again. I don't really want to see this team in the playoffs due to the fact that I think it's actually pretty decent. You do have a pretty tough matchup this week, but if you can win that, I think you should be set for making the playoffs. There's still a lot of football left to be played, but this is a terrifying team that truly has been embracing the spooky season.

3. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor)

Post Draft Change: +4

Weekly Change: -1

Record: 5-3

What an absolute stinker of a week. I managed to pick all the wrong players to start and most of them put up season lows. While it does suck, I'm still leagues ahead of handful of these other teams. Tony Pollard is really pissing me off and I honestly don't know if I have good wide receivers anymore, but if there is one thing I know, it's my team is better than yours (unless one of your players puts up a fluke 40 points). A win last week would have been nice so that I could have been two games up on everyone else, but one game will do. I still think I'm going to make the playoffs and I still think I'm going to fuck someone up in the playoffs. The back half of my schedule looks pretty easy, so expect a wild few weeks and me to ruin some of your dreams of winning this league. Liz, if you don't want this week, you're going to be the first of a few. See you suckers week 15

2. Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: +1

Record: 6-2

I guess all it takes to win in this league is three good players. Etienne, Hill, and Hockinson are the only three that are relatively consistent on this team. Despite his piss poor start, Jacob's has actually turned it around and seems to be making a difference on your team. He has yet to break 100 yards, but he's the only thing that seems to work for that team since Jimmy G can't actually throw the ball. Trevor Lawrence seems to be getting better and better week by week which is really helping since a lot of teams seem to be struggling with a QB right now. I don't really want to help you since you're one of my biggest competitions at the moment, but perhaps trading Russell Wilson for a more competent WR2 would be of use to you. You may have to sacrifice a week and take an L when Trevor Lawrence is on by, but I think you're already locked in for the playoffs so it could be worth it. Actually, looking at it you're probably going to take an L this week seeing that you have Lawrence and Etienne and Russ all on bye. Not sure what you're going to do, but picking up another quarterback probably isn't a bad option since your bench could pretty much all be dropped. Maybe wait on the quarterback trade for a week, but trading LaPorta could probably really help since a lot of teams are struggle with the tight end. In the end, you do you, but it seems like anytime I've given anyone advice in this league, it's backfired, so maybe don't listen to me. I'm just ranting about how I would try to improve my team if I were you, but realistically getting someone to trade with you is the hardest part. Good luck figure in and out, but also, I wish you the worst.

1. Herbalicious (Gabe)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 7-1

Even when it seems that your whole team has a mediocre week, they all seem to do it at the same time which allows you to still somehow put up +100 points. There's a lot of teams in this league that would love to put up 100 on a weekly basis, even if it was by accident or on a down week. Obviously, you have one of the best quarterbacks, and your two wide receivers are both studs. I do worry about the running backs a little bit, but they both seem to put up an average of 10 points or so every week. That's pretty bad for an RB1, but they're both RB1s so honestly two 10-point performances aren't terrible especially if the rest of your team is carrying. As I say every week, there is not a whole lot of depth on this team, but it seems like it's working out and you don't really have too many players who overlap on bye weeks going forward. So, in reality that doesn't really matter too much. I think the tight end is probably your weakest position but fortunately, that's also probably the most insignificant one among all positions since it seems that everyone has a shitty tight end. I hate that you have an easy match up this week, when do you play Adrian or me? You got to get some competition up in here, I can't let you just stroll to the number one seat and a first-round bye in the playoffs. I may have taken an L last week but your time will come again and I'll creep back up, always remember to keep an eye out for Selena

What an electric week for the NFL. All of us on the East Coast here woke up to a game already being completed, that being the Chiefs vs. Dolphins which took place in Nazi, Germany. The Jews weren't the only ones looking gassed as the Chiefs ran all over the dolphins and put them in a coffin. Across the NFL there were a shitload of other explosive and entertaining games. One being CJ Stroud lighting up the Buccaneers while doing his best Oprah impersonation, giving out touchdowns to everyone. One of my favorite games of the year occurred between the Eagles and the Cowboys. I don't root for either of these teams, but I love seeing either of their fan bases crying no matter the result. On top of that, we got Sir Josh Dobbs, who just joined the Vikings this past week hop in the middle of the game due to an injury to the original starting quarterback. Sir Dobbs put on a clinic as well as he strapped the team on his back. He picked up the legacy of Kirk and did not disappoint in Minnesota. I was slightly hesitant for the wide receivers and their fantasy value going forward, but Dobbs has definitely calmed those nerves. On the flip side of those good games were some really bad ones, mainly the Ravens beating the piss out of the Seahawks which I know strikes a nerve for all you home towners. The Raiders beat down the Giants and their JV team of scrubs. Following the game, the Giants ownership actually released a statement that they would be resigned from the League and will forfeit the rest of their games.

 

In our league, there was really only one good matchup between Haley and Maggie which came down to the final game on Monday night where Maggie's tight end literally needed one catch. But guess what, she's a dumb bitch who doesn't know ball so unsurprisingly, her team lost. One of my other favorite things happened in Gabe losing. The king has finally lost his crown and what makes it even sweeter is that it was to Jessica whose team is slowly creeping back from the depths of hell. The rest of these games were not all that close and there were a couple blow outs where teams barely put up 50 and 60 points. Who knows what's in store for this week, but one thing I do know, I'm about to cook your team below.

Post Draft Change: -7
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 3-6

Well well well it's like moth to a flame, you always find your way back to 12th. I tried my best to help you and give you reminders about switching your lineup, but I've been reprimanded for that and as if this team wasn't already fucked, it seems like your season is done for now. Let’s be honest though, you are just such a little girl all on her own with no help, you stand no chance against the big strong men and other women of this league. I wouldn’t expect such a feat from our favorite disabled friend. I do have to throw you a little pity due to the fact that your players have all been hurt. If Justin Fields and Devon Achane we're healthy, this might be a different team. The one shining star is CJ Stroud who is apparently the best rookie since Tom Brady. I was so hopeful for you in last week's matchup, but you're a dumbass and you have the Chargers second string tight end who didn't get a single catch and you lost the game by a single point. I would say fix this and get a new one, but I know you don't read this nor do you play with your fantasy team, so I doubt there's any hope. I think you're screwed next week because your best player, aka your kicker, is on a bye week, so how in the world can we expect you to replace someone who is going to outscore everyone on the team and put up 15 points. You also have some of the lowest points scored all season and seeing that Liz is only one game behind you, I think you should just start worrying about what handcuffs you want. If you leave it up to me, I'm going to pick some frilly pink ones or maybe some with spikes on them. It might just be best for you to start looking on Amazon and throw me some suggestions so it can be fun for you. I wish I had more to drag on this team about, but I think that I got that all out in the first like 5 weeks of the season. Dare I say I'm starting to almost feel bad for you? Regardless, I think you're fucked and your season is over, but I guess there's always next year and maybe you can actually draft and have a decent team. Love you long time, thanks for the free $10!

Weekly Change: -1
Record: 4-5
You voiced over and over that you know my opinion on this team and you don't care, so I'm not going to waste my time writing a review that isn’t going to be read, appreciated, or utilized.

10. Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 2-7

I think it was just an unfortunate showing last week. Your team looks good; however, they just can't seem to all be on the same page at the same time. Do I think this team is better all-around than some of the other teams in this league? Absolutely! You have a competent quarterback, a good running back, and at least two pretty solid wide receivers. That's more than you can say for a lot of teams in this league. You even have a pretty solid bench which is apparently a rarity in this league. The only thing that I think is holding you back right now is your record. You are certainly not dead yet, but it for sure seems like you’re in a coma, on life support, with a tube down your throat. All your meals come in a cup and honestly the family is thinking about pulling the plug on you, BUT YOU”RE NOT DEAD YET, you still have a 2% chance to make the playoffs, but you need everything under the sun to go your way. If you lose a game from here on out, you're done. If ever there was a team that can pull it off, I think my B-Squad of a team can definitely do it. The only thing that I would recommend going forward, is remove Zach Moss. While it seemed like a good trade at the time, it looks pretty bad rn and I think we are both realizing Zach Moss probably shouldn't be in your starting lineup. He has been underperforming and realistically isn't someone I think you can trust on a weekly basis. Aside from that, just play the matchups, and pray to whatever God you believe in. Definitely not the easiest matchup next week, but I think it's definitely feasible to get a W and get this comeback train on the rails.

9.  Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 4-5

What a phenomenal game. I could not be happier for you, getting a much-needed W, as well as taking down the reining League champ. This may have been your Super bowl since I'm not sure you make the playoffs, but if you do make the playoffs, this game is the reason why. Your team is actually coming together at the right time of the year. You're running backs are getting their act together, your wide receivers are both still a little questionable, but they are continuously giving you enough to get by. This team is unbelievably scrappy and somehow it seems it's only getting better. Congratulations on putting up the most points this past week, that is no small feat seeing that we have some teams that consistently put up well over 100 weekly. Now on to another huge game which for sure has some playoff implications. If you lose your out, but if you win, I think you replace Brin in the playoff hunt and kick her out of contention. I love watching this team turn things around and I love having a part in this because this has been such a roller coaster of a team. I can't wait for next week when you're screaming at the TV about one of your players not getting touches. You might have some challenges going forward since a handful of your players are on bye the following week, but that's a problem for future Jess, just keep rolling! Bring out Brin and put her in her down like the old family dog.

8. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 4-5

Tough loss last week, for all those good wins where all your players popped off, this is the opposite and kind of what I expected. A lot of single digit points and barely breaking 80 points total. There were definitely some anomalies, a handful of your players had their worst game of the year and you had a couple people on bye, so I can't give you too much shit, but it definitely didn't look too hot. This loss puts you at 4-5, which is not a good look seeing that you've lost three in a row. Your playoff chances are definitely slipping and we're going to need to see DJ more and Raheem Mostert get back to some big weeks for you to have a chance to make a run. Speaking of running, looks like Najee Harris is finally alive, however, it seems a little too late in the season to make a difference. I really don't have too much to say about this team. It's not good nor bad, but it's good enough to keep you out of handcuffs with Liz, hahaha.

7. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +5
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 4-5

What a turnaround! This team has gone from pretty much dead last all the way back into relevancy. Last week was a little ugly, but for the first time this year you played the team that put up an absolute stinker of a game. You still have a very solid team; however, I do worry about some of the players and their roles going forward. In particular, James Cook has seen a dip in production and utilization which has been hurting his numbers. George Pickens has also been kicked to the corner since Dionte Johnson has returned. I think David Montgomery should be back now that they are done the bye and hopefully, he is recovered from his injury. However, Jamyer Gibbs going crazy these past couple weeks really makes me question how much he's going to be used going forward or if he's just going to pick up where he left off and dominate that backfield. Gus the bus has low key been (hypothetically since he’s been on your bench) carrying this team over these past couple weeks. I don't know why Baltimore is using him now compared to the before, but if he has the hot hand, I'd say keep playing him. The fact that you've climbed up from the bottom all the way to 5th in the ESPN ranking and 7th in mine is a bit worrisome for me and I'm sure others in the top of this league. Unfortunately for us, you have Liz this week who is dead last and probably isn't going to be too much of a challenge. I really need this team to lose because you're coming from my neck and we can't be having that happening.

6. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -3
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 5-4

You were almost the first team to break a thousand points, you are literally 0.14 points away, if only Kirk hadn't got hurt lol. While you got away by the skin of your teeth last game, it looks like you have another easy game this week. You're going to also have your best player back in CMC and Alexander Madison's role should also be increased following the Cam Akers injury. I've been talking so much shit on him these past couple weeks because I don't think he's a good player, however, he seems to prove me wrong and he has been very solid over the course of this whole season. It's also nice to see Jaylen Warren have a roll finally and we can only hope that he can continues to put up decent numbers in that pitiful offense. I think this week might be one of your hardest due to the fact that your 2nd best player, AJ Brown, is on a bye, but like I said, you play Bekah so maybe it’s not all that scary. I know you're struggling to find a quarterback and you keep bitching and moaning because you’re trash and you didn't store anyone all year, but now you want to blame everyone but yourself because the waiver suck and you don't get your first pick. Sure, it's not the most optimal system, but everyone else who had an injured quarterback seemed to have picked one up or had one on their bench... Sounds like someone's just incompetent. It's not like you haven't had plenty of room on your bench either, literally none of those guys are good. Over the course of 9 weeks, you have seven players on a bench. In those nine weeks, those players have only eclipsed 10 points eight times. Taking a step back that is a potential of 63 individual players and only 10 of them have had more than 10 points. That is literally 15% of the time, one player on your bench has had a considerably average game. You should have gotten rid of half of these players weeks upon weeks ago so quit your bitching, find a quarterback, and make the playoffs where you lose to a top ranked team like the rest of the league.

5. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -4
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 4-5

I like this team as I've said many times of before, however, it is very inconsistent. Lamar baffles me, sometimes he puts up 30 and then the past couple weeks he's been putting up 10 to 15. I want to say he's not that guy, but we all know he is that guy, he's just struggling, I guess? The Ravens have been beating the shit out of everyone they play recently, so maybe he really hasn't been having to play too hard? Maybe since they’ve been winning by so much, he can just hand it off and go on cruise control. I have no clue what it is, but regardless it's hurting your fantasy team. You're running back situation is what worries me the most, however Aaron Jones just had a very solid game and supposedly is no longer on a snap count. So, if that continues, I take back that statement. Though the inability of Kansas City and Atlanta to use their running backs is killing your team since they work on a committee and no coaches are willing to come out and say who's leading that team. The wide receivers are coming together really nice, and while they may be low-key, they're probably two of the most consistent so far this season. I don't imagine either of them are going to drop 30-point games, but both doing 20 is very viable. You also apparently have one of the best tight ends in the league. He is quickly becoming CJ Stroud's favorite target and I don't see that offense slowing down anytime soon. This is definitely a pretty dangerous team but it's inconsistency from your best players is what worries me. When they're good, I don't see many teams beating you, but you need all the stars to align for that to happen.

4. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +5
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 4-5

Very solid team, but it seems like it's kind of falling apart. Your quarterback situation is super questionable, Kamara is not a problem at all, but Walker seems to be losing touches more and more every week which is never a good sign, PLUS he does have one of the harder playoffs schedules so this is definitely someone to keep an eye on and maybe slightly panic. posts.title: Week 11
blocks: Week 11 Rankings

What a weekend football! It seems there were a lot of games that came down to the wire this week. Both the Steelers and Seahawks lost on last second field goals, however, it's definitely more embarrassing as a Seahawks fan because they missed it from like 30 yards whereas the Steelers just suck at defense. We finally had two really good prime time matchups between the Ravens vs Bengals and Chiefs vs Eagles. Unfortunately, in the Ravens-Bangles game, Joe Burrrrrr got hurt and does not seem like he'll be returning anytime soon. This allowed the Ravens to run away with it and could potentially end the Bengals season. The Eagle-Chiefs game was a Super bowl rematch and it gave us pretty much everything we expected. It came down to the wire, However, a MVS dropped a pass in the last minute, which cost the Chiefs the game as well as me losing my fantasy game. So, if you're asking, I'm down bad because I would have loved to win and see the Eagles lose all in one week. But I guess you can't get everything you wish for. One of my wishes was finally fulfilled this week in the Steelers firing their offensive coordinator, so hopefully that turns things around for both the Steelers and some of your fantasy teams who have Pittsburgh players.

 

In terms of our league, this was a really good week for everyone. There were four games that were separated by less than five points and then the other two were absolute blowouts. There were a bunch of injuries this week which I think will definitely alter some teams going forward. There seems to be a QB epidemic and no one can keep a guy healthy for more than a couple weeks at a time. If you still have a decent QB, consider yourself lucky. Somehow this week we had a bunch of the losing teams win and the mid teams lose. That means that STILL no one has been eliminated from playoff contention. On the flip side, due to this, Gabe and Adrian still have not secured a playoff spot. It is 99% guaranteed they get one, but we're still delaying the inevitable and leaving the possibility of one of them not making it. One of them could have the biggest choke since the Falcons in the Super bowl 6 years ago. This league has gotten extremely close and the difference between last place and third place is only two games, so it is honestly very feasible that any one of us could make the playoff somewhere this league. With that, let's take a peek at the rankings and see how things have shifted over this past week.

12. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -7
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 4-7

Last week was rather unfortunate for you. You lost by three points and looking at your bench. Had you played any one of those guys over someone else, you would have one. That being said, who can predict CJ Stroud having the worst game of his career and who could also predict Achane getting hurt yet again the second that he touched the field. You really needed that win to help you, but I think your fate might be sealed. As if your team wasn't already going through the ringer, the Rams decided to drop their starting running back for the past few weeks because the one guys coming back from injury. Usually, we see him work back in and your guy slowly begins to taper off with his touches, but in this case, he has been dropped and now is completely irrelevant. You hate to see it, but it's almost as if the fantasy football gods have set out to punish you for auto drafting. I feel like there's not much insight I can give you at this point, this team is decent, but it seems to fall apart every single week in some capacity. Keep your chin up, but still keep those handcuffs in your Amazon cart.

11.  Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -9
Weekly Change: -1
Record: 4-7

I don't want to jinx you, but don't look now, you're making your way out of last place. You're 4-7 and one game away from being in the middle of the pack where everyone else is. I think this team is actually coming together really nicely. You have one really good running back and two pretty solid RB2s. The wide receiving core isn't bad, they've just been very mediocre recently. Thielen has been playing well but he's had some tough matchups in the past few weeks, Addison has been doing all right but with Make-A- wish Josh Dobbs (because he’s bald as fuck and has no eyebrows) at QB, Addison hasn't been putting up the numbers that he had previously been doing with Kirk. I also expect he might struggle a little with Justin Jefferson potentially coming back either this upcoming week or the next. That said, you still have Jalen Waddle and Tyler Boyd / Tee Higgins who could all fill in. I think your weakest spot is for sure your wide receivers, but this is where I think you can flip that. You currently have both Dak Prescott and Sam Howell who are ranked 6th and 5th respectively in the league in terms of points from a quarterback. I suggest you take a peek at both of their schedules and determine who has the easiest one going forward or which one you would rather keep. I think you can flip the other one for another solid wide receiver and potentially a good bench guy or a missing piece. If you do this, this team becomes a whole lot scarier and I might not want to see you continue to win games and make your way through the depths of last place. I know your playoff percentage is still only 13%, but that's a whole lot better than the 2% it was last week. I think if any team can make a come back it might be this one. I really hope this pipe dream comes to fruition because there is nothing I would love more than to see you and Gabe in the championship game and you smack his shit around. But this is all wishful thinking and me putting this in writing definitely probably just jinxed you. With that being said, I look forward to next week when you have been eliminated from the playoffs and I can make fun of you for that.

10. Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: -6
Weekly Change: +2
Record: 5-6

Congratulations! I guess….I really wanted that win, but I guess you needed it more than I did. With it, you have now projected yourself up into 9th place in the ESPN rankings. You have the same record as a majority of the League and the only thing separating you from 5th place is your points scored. No, I don't think you're going to beat out many people in terms of points, but if you can keep winning, this is a playoff team. Don't ask me how it’s happening, your team is still full of stinkers, but somehow you managed to pull out a W every week. By some miracle the Make-A-Wish child, aka the Pass-tronaut (because he got a 4.0 in college as an aerospace engineer and wanted to work for NASA if the NFL didn't work out), Josh Dobbs, is a sustainable quarterback and even though he had a down week, he still gave you enough points to get the W. The running back situation is ugly, but I guess it's working. I'm not sure how Chandler is going to hold up going forward now that Mattison is healthy. Austin Eckler just looks like a shell of the guy he once was. He is slow and fat and has hardly managed to score over 10 points many times this season (probably because he was hurt like half the year). Your wide receivers are also a little bit shaky in the sense that Dhop and Kirk and Smith all depend on if their quarterback is in the mood to throw to them. They're all good receivers, however, they are definitely the second string on their team (except Dhop, he is first string but the Titans are ass and don’t throw the ball so he has to be dropped a tier). Even though I'm dragging on this team, they somehow get shit done and I don't see that stopping anytime soon. I gotta give some credit to you, you've been putting in work on the waivers and I think it's showing. I hope to see this team get a W this week and then I'm very curious to see where you land in the standings. Good luck, enjoy the pity win I gave you; you needed it.

9. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +5
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 4-7

In classic Ryan fashion, you played the high score yet again! You just somehow manage to always pull the short stick every week. I don't think there was much you could have done to win, however, there are for sure some players on your bench that I think you should start (Gus Edwards). He has been balling the last couple weeks and I don't know why you haven't been playing him. I think especially now with Mark Andrews out, they are going to rely on the running game a lot more and he's going to only continue to get a larger role. This team is definitely solid, it just seems that they always are lackluster or have some sort of injury concern. Allen is balling and Montgomery is consistently putting up good numbers, but that's about all you have. Derrick, Henry and James Cook are both in struggle city right now. Both their teams are using them, but they themselves aren't putting up great numbers week over week. Your wide receiver room also scares the fuck out of me. Kupp continues to be up and down and who knows if he's going to even play due to a couple minor injuries. Amari Cooper is a stud; however, the problem is that he doesn't really have a quarterback. I know I joke about Josh Dobbs being a make-a-wish kid because he's bald, but DTR for the Browns is literally a make-a-wish because there's no way he should be starting in the NFL, yet somehow, he managed to beat the Steelers. All that to say Cooper is not super reliable. Even on the bench you have Pickens and Meyers who are both solid, but I have no idea what you're going to do with them since both of them have shitty offensive coordinators and QBs it seems. This really isn't a bad team and looking at last week, you beat majority of the teams in terms of points, you just have the bad luck of the high scorer every week. Fortunately, you're still in it and if you manage to get a W this week, you have one of the higher “points for” totals so you would jump a couple of the teams that have the same record as you. I'm really curious to see how this league turns out next week and how that shakes up the standings. We're definitely in for a fun finish.

8. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -7
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 5-6

I honestly don't understand this team. I look at it every single week and I'm like “Oh this is good team”, and then they come out and put up like 70 points. You have one of the best QBs, one of the best wide receivers, one of the best tight ends, and what was argued as the next best running back since Adrian Peterson. Yet somehow when you combine all these forces, they shit the bed. I would argue that you have one of the most complete rosters in the sense that you have backup wide receivers who are all viable options and backup running backs who are all solid as well. But I guess some things just aren't meant to be. I think there's nothing you can really do besides hope and pray at this point that Arthur Smith stops throwing games for the Falcons and actually begins to use Bijan like he was intended. You can also hope that now that the Matt Canada era is done, Dionte Johnson actually has a role and can continue to put up over 15 a game. This is all wishful thinking, but if this team by some miracle puts the pieces together, this is a solid team that could make the playoffs. You just happened to have had some shortcomings in terms of injury and consistency.

7. CeeDeez Nutz (Bekah)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: +2
Record: 5-6

I think it's about time I finally put some respect on this team You have two very solid quarterbacks, one of the hottest wide receivers, and now you've just added a viable running back as well as the fact that the Seahawks running back got hurt. So now Zach Charbonnet is going to be number one in that offense. It seems things are all falling into place at the right time. I was hesitant to give up Tyler Lockett because he always seems to turn on the jets at the back half the season and I think now if he does that, this team is primed for the playoffs. I do think it's a bold move that every single week you continue to play two tight ends, but if it's working, it's working. I personally would sway away from that, but last week when you played Gabe Davis in your flex, he got you 0 points so I guess five or six is better than nothing at this point. As I've said before, my only suggestion is that you bulk up one of your positions, you need a better running back or wide receiver in general so that you can have a solid flex. And I think trading either Tua or Mahomes is the way to do that. I don't know what you can get for them, but I'm sure there is definitely someone better than Gabe Davis, Damion Pierce, Zeke, or Jake Bobo. Regardless, his team is finally putting it together and I'll be interested to see where it goes going forward.

6. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +3
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 5-6

This was the closest game of the week, separated by 0.12 points. That's literally a difference of 2 yards for any player. If any of your players had only run for two more yards, you would have won this game... See the crazy thing is that you did have this game won, that is except for the fact that the 49ers were beating the Buccaneers. Due to that, Brock Purdy took two knees at the end of the game to run time out. This resulted in a loss of 2 yards in his stat total and cost you the game. If they don't take those two knees, you win this game. And you are in a much better place in terms of fantasy. A damn shame to see you go down like that, but I think it's absolutely hilarious, especially since it was to Brin. I think you really needed that win too because after this week, your team is hurting. You lost Walker for God knows how long, Michael Thomas is out as well, and the eagles Star tight end has not played for a handful of weeks. Fortunately, you have a couple decent replacements in Kamara and Pittman, but I still think this team is going to struggle. For the first time this season Ridley actually had a good game, but I don't know if you can expect that to continue in the near future. It seems that when Zay Jones plays, Ridley has a solid game, but when he doesn't play, Ridley plays like trash. Definitely something for you to keep an eye on for this next week. I think this is a very solid team, it’s just they seem rather inconsistent sometimes and a lot of it comes down to whether Big Cock Brock can consistently put up 20 points. It definitely helps when he has all his weapons, but as soon as he loses one of them, he returns to mediocracy and looks like Daniel Jones or Zack Wilson. Fortunately for you, the niners are hitting their stride and they all seem relatively healthy for now. So, assuming that stays the way it is, this team should be in a position to make the playoffs as long as Brock party doesn't act like Colin Kaepernick or Riley Reid and stays off his knees.

5. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: 0
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 6-5

You find a way to win every single week and now, I have to watch my back because you have the exact same record as I do and it's making me sweat a little. Despite losing Joe Brrr, this team somehow managed to pull out a W. I think they were a handful of irl things that happened this past week that have helped your team in terms of fantasy. One being that the dolphins other RB, Devon Achane got hurt the second that he touched the grass. This will lead to Mostert getting more touches and hopefully continuing to produce enough points for you to win. Saquon finally had a breakout game and was definitely the main reason you won this past week. I think maybe this week isn't the time to do it because they're playing Cleveland, who is arguably one of the best defenses, but I think that going forward Cortland Sutton should be in your lineup every single week. He has been balling and even though he is 100% touchdown dependent, he has been getting those touchdowns and he is clearly Russell Wilson's favorite target in Denver. The broncos are for sure on a comeback from where they started and this team looks actually decent to the point where their starters should be starting in fantasy. I think overall you have a pretty solid team and there aren't many holes, it's just a couple hit or miss guys that are going to determine if you win or lose every single week. I would say your weakest point for sure is the wide receivers, but even so, they're not terrible compared to some other people in this league. A viable quarterback, a good running back, and at least one solid wide receiver…. that’s a lot more than a bunch of people in this league can say for their teams and I think that's definitely one of the reasons that you are 6-5 and they are behind you in the standings. Keep it up, but don't keep it up that well because I want to make the playoffs and I'm going to be tight if you beat me.

4. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 5-6

For all the holes that this team once had, it's actually coming together. The quarterback is for sure still a problem and I don't really see you fixing that anytime soon seeing that most of the ones on the waivers are booty cheeks. Unless you trade someone who makes a significant contribution to this team, I doubt that you're going to get a good quarterback. Nevertheless, you have CMC and AJ Brown who, 9 times out of 10, will cover your ass and make up for any loss of points that are result of poor QB play. Unfortunately, this past week AJ Brown dropped a stinker which cost you to lose your game. That's definitely out of the norm and I think next week he's going to want to have a revenge game so be on the lookout for that. You're definitely going to need it to because you're playing Gabe. Jaylen Warren has shown that he is the best Steelers fantasy option and he continues to put up unbelievable numbers for someone who only gets a handful of touches every game. Even though Mark Andrews did go down this past week, I don't think he was making all that much of a difference and I think Isaiah Likely will manage to fill that void to the same capacity that a bunch of other people’s TEs have filled the role in this league. I don't think Likely is going to win you any games, but he will definitely prevent you from having zero points every single week. I really do like this team; I think you just had some misfortunes. Fortunately, though, you're a single game back from 3rd and 4th place and you have the third highest scoring team in the league so I don't see you struggling to make the playoffs as long as you can continue to win.

3. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor)

Post Draft Change: +5

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 6-5

I got absolutely railed this past week by the Chiefs wide receiver who I shall not name. I had Justin Jefferson in my lineup, however he decided that he wasn't healthy last second which caused me to have to pick up and play a Chief’s receiver. I decided that I would pick up the one guy who has been relatively consistent all year and was still on the waivers, but of course I should have known that that meant he was not going to have a single catch in this game. Not only did he not have a catch, but he had one of the most atrocious drops of the year which cost the Chiefs the game. I'm definitely a little bit salty, but I'm going to say that it was charity because I wanted my girlfriend to not be handcuffed to Maggie. Regardless, this is still a solid team and following my most recent trade, I think I'm in good shape to have a solid playoff push. That being said, catch me at the bottom of the rankings next week when this team puts up 40 points. Sidenote, if anyone wants the trade, please hit me up, I will give you almost anyone on my team because they all piss me off.

2. Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 8-3

It happens every week, and it pisses me off every single week. You somehow win while majority of your players put up single digit numbers. Both you running backs had horrible games, your two wide receivers and your tight end also did terribly. The defense did mediocre in terms of defense, but for being the number one defense in the league, it kind of disappointed. But then here we go with your quarterback wide receiver and kicker all putting up unbelievable numbers. Trevor Lawrence has had a horrible year, but of course this week he wants to show off and go for four touchdowns. Tyreek, I guess I can't be too mad about that because he is arguably the best receiver in the league, but then of course your kicker puts up 17 fucking points. What the actual fuck?!?! How do you get a guy who puts up 17, when I get a guy who puts up two and cost me the game. If I had 17 from a kicker every week, I think I would be undefeated. No matter how much I bitch and moan, it's not going to change the fact that you're pretty much locked up for the playoffs as long as you don't have a catastrophic collapse. This team is definitely one of the best and I guess you deserve that first round by, but still go fuck yourself and your wonky ass team that continues to be unbelievably trash except for one or two of them. Eat a dick, I'm totally not mad at all.

1. Herbalicious (Gabe)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 9-2

I have nothing to say about this team. My mom always said if you have nothing nice to say, don't say anything at all. However, I'm going on the philosophy that is the complete opposite of this, this team is good and I don't want to admit it. I would love to talk shit, but I really don't see much shit that I can talk about. You have one of the best QBs, you have two of the best wide receivers. Even though Diggs is up and down, Allen will still cover that volatility. Even your flex wide receivers in Aiyuk and Rice are better than majority of the people in this league who are playing third stringers. The running backs also really piss me off because Mixon isn't good yet somehow, he consistently puts up over 15 points every single week. Swift is solid, but I don't understand how he puts up 18 every week either. He only ever runs for 4 yards at a time up the middle and then Jalen Hurts hogs all of the goal line work so he isn’t even scoring TDs like that. As if things weren't already going well enough, AJ Dillon is now going to be the starter due to the fact that Aaron Jones just got hurt. Looking at your team you have four solid, startable running backs, three top 10 receivers, one of the better tight ends, and two solid defenses. I don't know what chat GPT knows that I don't know, but I think it is from the future and this is some bullshit, there's no way this team should be stacked like this. I’m banning chat GPT next year.

posts.title: Week 12
blocks: Week 12 Rankings

Happy Thanksgiving to all which means a happy week and weekend full of football giving us four days in a row, kinda sounds like my drinking schedule this past week…and every other week. Unfortunately, on those 4 days we saw some real shitters played. The Jets, as expected, lost to the dolphins. As if it wasn't embarrassing enough, they threw a 99-yard interception on a Hail Mary, now being called the Fail Mary, which will for sure go down in the books as one of the worst plays in history on Thanksgiving. No matter how bad it was, it still will never top the butt fumble which also happened on thanksgiving and is arguably the most embarrassing play in football history. The Lions stay unable to win a Thanksgiving game. Apparently, they're 0-12 When the moon is in retrograde or some shit. I guess if we can take anything away from this, it’s that Leos are trash…sorry not sorry to you space girlies out there. The 49ers absolutely mollie-wopped the Seahawks. Now looking back on it, maybe the Seahawks should have kept Russ. Speaking of him, he beat the shit out of the Browns and don’t look now but the Broncos have low-key been looking nice and could be fighting for a playoff spot. I personally can finally be happy because the Steelers fired their offensive coordinator and for the first time in 3 years, they put up over 400 yards in the first game without him...coincidence? I think not. We're coming down the back stretch of the season and with that comes playoffs, The eagles were the first team to lock up a playoff spot and I expect over the next couple weeks things are going to fall into place and hearts will be broken.

 

Speaking of broken hearts, we still don't have any in our league. Everyone still has some chance to make the playoffs by some miracle. Liz is the lowest at the moment with a 4% chance, but that is still a miracle situation waiting to happen. On the opposite of heartbreak, both gave an Adrian clinched a playoff spot with Adrian winning and Gabe losing, but because Gabe was a game up, he's still clinched. I am still at a 98% chance which is worrisome because I was at 99% last week. Not to fear, if I win this week, it all but secures that spot for me. I think there's definitely a lot to be hopeful about and this week is one of the most important since next week we are most definitely going to see people being eliminated. It's essentially win or go home right now for a lot of you. Let's dive into these rankings and see how things shake up.

12. Back dat Pass Up (Jess)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 5-7

As much hope as I had had for this team in the past, it is slowly falling apart. Your quarterback situation is less than desirable with Josh Dobbs who is playing worse now that he actually knows his teammates names and now Will Levis is your only hope. Better hope he balls out like he did in his first game. Fortunately for you, against Indianapolis there is hope. There's a possibility, but it is slim. Both you're running backs have been pretty brutally bad recently. However, they are playing each other this week and both of their defenses are abysmal so I wouldn't be surprised if they both put up decent numbers. On that subject. Austin Eckler is actually garbanzo beans, he has not been fast, he hasn't been good at catching, he has not been the guy that I thought he was and especially not the guy who you expected at the fourth pick. I think the wide receiver situation is honestly pretty solid, DeAndre Hopkins definitely depends on if Levis has a good game, but the two of them together could be quite troublesome for you opponents especially on a week against the Indianapolis secondary. As well, both Smith and Kirk are decent options who are always hit or miss, but let's just pray that they hit big (like you were hitting that slots button last week). I think overall, this week is set up for success, but how they play is a different story. I wish you the best of luck, but if you lose this week, I think the handcuffs are pretty much guaranteed at this point.

11.  CeeDeez Nutz (Bekah)
Post Draft Change: -5
Weekly Change: -4
Record: 5-7

I still think this is a decent team, but it has been falling apart recently and they just haven't been producing. I think also the fact that you have the second lowest points total in the League really hinders your ability to advance in these rankings. I think I would switch a lot of players in this lineup, especially seeing that two of them are on a bye and the Seahawks are playing arguably one of the best offenses. I'll let you figure that out though. Best of luck!

10. Waddling Back From The Bar (Liz)
Post Draft Change: -8
Weekly Change: +1
Record: 4-8

My little 4% dream stays alive. I like this team, and I think that if anyone is to make the playoffs it's going to be you. There's a lot of hope, especially this week. You do play Max; however, I think he is one of the easier top tier teams. A lot of stuff is in your favor this week, mainly being that Jonathan Taylor went down and now Zack Moss should pop off again. I would 100% play him, but I'm not sure who I would replace between James Connor or Brian Robinson. My gut says replace Robinson, but when has my gut ever been right? Aside from that I think your lineup looks good and then it just comes down to if your team puts out. You better hope they put out more than you do lol. I think most of your players actually have a really good matchup this weekend. If ever is a time for your team to clutch up, it's this week. May the odds ever being your favor, let's get it!

9. CheckYourNails (Maggie)
Post Draft Change: -4
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 5-7

I'm starting to love this team. Yeah, you suck, but I think it's hilarious how you manage to beat all the high ranked teams every once in a while. It’s even better that you win while playing handicapped. Last week you played a defense who got you negative points and your tight end didn't even play and yet you somehow you still won. That's hilarious! I think it clearly all falls on the shoulders of CJ Stroud, you by some miracle managed to grab a good one there way back in week 4 or whenever it was. I think your playoff hopes are over, but trading your QB might help survive on that slim chance you have at the playoffs. You honestly have a lot of favorable matchups this week and I wouldn't be surprised to see you get another W and finish the year in the middle of the pack which would be absolutely hysterical. I think some of the moves you've been making are definitely logical and hopefully will make this a better team, but my only concern would be watch out for Devon Achane who is questionable to play this Sunday. It is truly a miracle that you still have a decent number of points compared to others and I think that will definitely go a long way to keeping you out of last place if you do happen to have the same record as a bunch of other people. Overall, I think you actually have a genuinely good chance to avoid the handcuffs which is a complete 180 from what I've been saying all season. I guess this team just knows when clutch time is

8. Drop and Give Me Purdy (Matte)
Post Draft Change: +1
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 5-7

I don't know what to say about this team, they seem like they're hot and cold. Big cock Brock is looking like medium shcmeet Pete recently and not really putting out the points that he was at the beginning of the year. Fortunately for you, you have Alvin Kamara who is consistently one of the best in the business and Jerome Ford who is serviceable at best. The wide receivers are finally getting it together, though they have each still have their struggles. Chase is now playing with a community college quarterback and Ridley has only had two good games in a row, I don't know if they're flukes or if the Jags are finally learning how to use him. Regardless, I wouldn't be too sure to count on him week after week. I think I can also partially blame your loss last week on you. You lost by three points, yet you started the Bills defense against the Eagles. I guarantee if you would have picked up any other defense you probably would have won that game, but instead you were ignorant and I have very low remorse for that loss. In fact, I'm kind of happy you lost because it definitely gives me a little bit more breathing room. I think honestly that could be the nail in your coffin, what a way to go out, playing the Bills against the best offense. So, reflect on that all off season long and stock up on 15 more dollars for next year that I will gladly take from you.

7. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)
Post Draft Change: -2
Weekly Change: -2
Record: 6-6

This is an extremely crucial week for you. You need this win or else you probably miss the playoffs. I think you have a solid line up and I'm not going to complain about any of these players. Najee has been playing well and Sutton and Dell have been extremely consistent wide these past few weeks and majority of the season. I do worry slightly about the quarterback situation, especially this week against Kansas City. I also think Mostert could also be troublesome due to the fact that the other running back (Achane) is coming back this week and his touches could be halved. I like Garrett Wilson, but he is also on the Jets and they have the worst quarterback in the league so his upside is really limited right now. That being said, you don't really have much of an option this week. You should have a free win against Maggie this week, however, she somehow manages to win while not even playing half her line up. You better hope that she sets a full lineup because that’s when she'll lose. If she's missing two or three players, you're probably screwed and she's going to get a W and ruin your season. For the first time all year, maybe you should remind her to set her lineup hahaha

6. Buckle Up, Butter Kupp (Ryan)
Post Draft Change: +8
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 5-7

Having the best quarterback in the league sure does help when he puts up 40 points and covers the rest of your team's asses who all are below average on a weekly basis. It's funny, this past week it seems that your whole bench outperformed your starting lineup, but by some miracle you still won. You literally made every wrong decision possible (except QB) and still got a win. Fortunately for you, Kyren Williams is back and a huge part of the Rams’ offense. I think this week you're definitely set up for a solid performance, assuming everyone plays to their potential. At the same time, I could see you dropping a fat 60 burger this week and falling out of the playoffs due to everyone playing like trash. Trust me there is nothing I would love more, especially since you’re playing me. But at the same time, I have no faith in my team to beat yours, so it's really a crap shoot at this point. I think if anything's in my favor, it's the fact that the Bills are on a bye week this week. Good luck, I would love to be the one to end your playoff chances in your first year of fantasy, but regardless, I say we put a little friendly wager on this game and the loser of this game should give the other a little sucky...

5. Picksburgh (Max)
Post Draft Change: -4
Weekly Change: +3
Record: 6-6

A big win last week keeps you in playoff contention. The Atlanta falcons finally realized how to utilize the running back position which is perfect timing for you. That paired with the Chiefs also picking one RB rather than running a committee like usual, really helped you secure the win. Even with mediocracy across the board, this team is still really solid and you can never really count them out. I think you might struggle this week due to the fact that Lamar is on a bye. I don't hate the Kenny picket pickup, maybe it's because I'm a Steelers fan as well, but I think this is a revitalized offense and I have high hopes. At worst, I think he's going to put up 15 points against a subpar Arizona defense. That should definitely be enough for you to skate by, especially seeing that you're playing Liz, who is the last place team in the league. Are you really going to let your season end by losing the worst team in the League? Doubt it, but then again, this team is very sketchy and very well could only put up 50 points this week. I would hate to see that, but who knows what the fantasy gods have in store.

4. JockStraps (Haley)
Post Draft Change: -1
Weekly Change: 0
Record: 6-6

Beating Gabe is for sure your crowning achievement, but I don't really know how much it should count seeing that he only put up 85 points. CMC is forever and always will carry this team. Another 28 piece helped you secure the W, especially when other players such as Jaylen Warren and Alexander Mattison both put up under 10 points. Your quarterback situation is an absolutely mess, but I think the rest of your team can make up for it. I definitely think this team should make the playoffs, especially since you were balling in the first half of the year (RIP Kirko-bango) and racking up the points like no one’s business. However, this team is not so much of a threat as it once was. In all honesty, I'm kind of hoping you make the playoffs because I feel like this could be an easy W as long as CMC and AJ Brown don't both pop off on the same week. That being said, I'm going to have to face you and they're both going to put up a 40 piece and I'm going to lose by 60. Wishing you the best of luck, but also this team is abysmal, I think it's a little too late to pick anyone up on waivers and fix it, but good luck nonetheless!

3. Jacking Goff Hurts (Trevor)

Post Draft Change: +5

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 7-5

I think I got a solid thing going here, most of my players are going to put decent numbers, but I really do not trust the wide receivers at all. Justin Jefferson needs to come back ASAP because Puka and Devante are not doing it. The running backs seem to consistently put-up decent numbers and I am doing a solid job at picking up a defense that pops off week to week. Hopefully I can keep this up into the playoffs.

2. Massachusetts Meatheads (Adrian)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 9-3

What is solid week you had last week; it seems all of your players are finally putting it together as a team rather than just individually week to week. Josh Jacobs, who had a horrible start to the season is managing to string together a few good games and if this continues the playoffs will be relatively easy for you. I would say I'm worried about your wide receiver situation, but Tyreek Hill should cover any slack you have in the WR2 or flex department. I'm surprised that Travis Etienne has kind of been struggling recently seeing that he was one of the best running backs for the first half of the year. Aside from that, this whole team looks pretty strong and I think the first-round bye is all but yours. Even though you play Gabe this week, a win or loss doesn't really affect you one way or the other. You're in the playoffs and as long as you don't choke these next two games you should be fine.

1. Herbalicious (Gabe)

Post Draft Change: +9

Weekly Change: 0

Record: 9-3

Yikes! Tough loss last week, I guess your team isn't really all that good when Justin Herbert doesn't play well. You are 1-3 in games where he puts up under 15 points, he truly is the backbone of this team. That being said, I don't think you have too much to worry about seeing that the Chargers are playing New England this week, who is arguably one of the worst defenses. I would say the only spot that your team really struggles is your flex (I'm counting Aiyuk as your WR2 while Diggs is out) but realistically I don't know else who you would throw in the flex this week, no one you have on your bench would be too influential one way or another. It'll be interesting to see how this goes. Since you're playing Adrian this week. I don't think it makes too much of a difference since you're both going to have a first round bye, but it's always nice to have bragging rights and say you won compared to him. Having the first seed compared to the second does have its benefits though, you kind of get the easier side of the bracket as well. So, this game isn't that important, but then again it might be.
